zh.tag: 让编程 Agent 先给答案、别绕弯子的输出规范技能
zh.what: 这是一个给编程助手（coding agent）用的输出风格技能，强制它先给行动、再给解释，用编号步骤代替长篇铺垫。它不改变模型能力，只改变回答的组织方式，让结果像给 ADHD 用户看的一样直接。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 里的 10 条规则，外加 INSTALL.md 安装说明、AGENTS.md 给 agent 的指引，以及多语言 README 和 logo。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，本质是 Markdown 技能文件，通过 Claude 插件市场（claude plugin marketplace）安装，可 fork 后自行改规则。
zh.hot: 它精准戳中「AI 回答又长又绕」的痛点，用极简规则给出可感知的前后对比，今日新增 4650 star、总数 34632，直接冲上 GitHub 日榜第一。
uses: 每天被 AI 长回复淹没、只想快速拿到下一步操作的开发者
用 Claude 等 coding agent 写代码、希望输出更紧凑的团队
想自定义 agent 输出规范、愿意 fork 改 SKILL.md 的进阶用户

en.tag: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer
en.what: It's an output-style skill for coding agents that forces action-first answers with numbered steps instead of long preambles. It doesn't change model capability, only how responses are organized, making them ADHD-friendly and to the point.
en.content: The core is a 10-rule SKILL.md under skills/i-have-adhd/, plus INSTALL.md, an AGENTS.md for agents, multilingual READMEs, and a logo.
en.stack: Python is the listed language, but it's essentially a Markdown skill file installed via the Claude plugin marketplace and forkable for custom rules.
en.hot: It nails the pain of bloated AI answers with a simple rule set and a clear before/after demo, gaining 4,650 stars today to 34,632 total and hitting #1 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers drowning in long AI replies who just want the next action
Teams using coding agents like Claude who want tighter, more actionable output
Advanced users who want to fork and customize the SKILL.md rules

zh.tag: 腾讯出品的团队级 AI 代理配置与知识同步 CLI
zh.what: TeamAI 是一个命令行工具，用于在团队内统一管理 AI 代理的技能、规则、MCP 配置与知识库。它让 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等不同 AI 代理共享同一套团队规范，实现「让每个团队都 AI 原生」的目标。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 源码、npm 包配置、CI 工作流、多语言 README 与使用文档，并提供 teamai-hub 模板组织用于快速初始化团队仓库。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Node.js 开发，通过 npm 全局安装，依赖 Git 托管服务（GitHub、GitLab、GitCode、CNB、TGit 等）作为团队共享仓库。
zh.hot: 作为腾讯开源的团队 AI 协作工具，它切中了多代理配置碎片化的痛点，上线即获 2981 星、单日新增 556 星，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2。
uses: 需要统一团队内多个 AI 代理配置规范的研发团队
使用 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等工具的开发者个人或小组
希望把技能、规则与知识沉淀为可复用资产的工程组织
想快速搭建 AI 原生工作流的团队管理员

en.tag: Tencent's CLI for syncing team-wide AI agent skills, rules and knowledge
en.what: TeamAI is a CLI that centrally manages a team's skills, rules, MCP configs and knowledge across AI agents. It lets tools like Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy and Cursor share one team-wide standard, aiming to make every team AI-native.
en.content: The repo ships the TypeScript CLI source, npm packaging, CI workflows, bilingual READMEs and usage docs, plus a teamai-hub template org for bootstrapping team repos.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Node.js, installed globally via npm, and relies on Git hosts (GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, CNB, TGit, etc.) as the shared team repository.
en.hot: As Tencent's open-source team AI collaboration tool, it tackles fragmented multi-agent configs, quickly reaching 2,981 stars with 556 added today and ranking #2 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Engineering teams needing unified config across multiple AI agents
Individual developers or small groups using Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.
Organizations wanting to codify skills, rules and knowledge as reusable assets
Team admins aiming to bootstrap an AI-native workflow quickly

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的技能框架与软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套面向编码代理的完整软件开发方法论，建立在可组合的 skills 之上，并配有初始指令确保代理自动调用这些技能。它让代理在动手写代码前先厘清需求、产出规格与实现计划，再以子代理驱动的方式逐项完成任务。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本和技能定义文件为主，包含安装与集成说明、基础工作流文档、技能目录（What's Inside）以及哲学与贡献指南等部分。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主要语言，围绕 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot CLI 等多种编码代理 harness 提供插件式安装与技能触发机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 28.4 万 star、日增 688 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，说明开发者对「让编码代理真正按工程方法论工作」的需求极为强烈。
uses: 希望让编码代理遵循 TDD、YAGNI、DRY 等工程规范的开发团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等代理工具并想提升自主开发可靠性的个人开发者
需要在企业环境中引入代理开发流程与商业支持的技术负责人

en.tag: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills plus initial instructions that make sure the agent actually uses them. Instead of jumping straight into code, the agent teases out a spec, produces an implementation plan, then runs a subagent-driven development loop task by task.
en.content: The repo is mostly Shell scripts and skill definition files, including install/integration docs, the basic workflow, a skills catalog (What's Inside), plus philosophy and contributing sections.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, with plugin-style installation and skill-triggering mechanisms across many coding-agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI.
en.hot: With 284k stars, +688 today and #3 on the GitHub Trending daily chart, it shows huge demand for making coding agents actually follow a real engineering methodology.
uses: Dev teams that want coding agents to follow engineering practices like TDD, YAGNI and DRY
Individual developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor who want more reliable autonomous coding
Tech leads looking to adopt agent-driven development workflows with enterprise support

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器，支持分享与本地运行。
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个使用 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 构建的 3D 建筑编辑器，允许用户创建和分享建筑项目。它提供了完整的编辑工具、3D 渲染运行时，并支持通过 CLI 在本地运行。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo monorepo，包含 Next.js 应用、核心包（core）、查看器（viewer）、编辑器（editor）、节点定义（nodes）、CLI 和 MCP 服务器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，采用 Turborepo 管理 monorepo，并发布多个 npm 包。
zh.hot: 凭借 WebGPU 带来的高性能 3D 渲染和便捷的本地运行方式，项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 22k+ 星标，今日新增 168 星。
uses: 建筑师和设计师：快速创建和分享 3D 建筑概念模型。
开发者：在 React 应用中集成 3D 编辑器或查看器。
教育工作者：用于教学演示或学生项目。

en.tag: A WebGPU-powered 3D architectural editor for creating and sharing projects.
en.what: Pascal Editor is a 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU, enabling users to create and share architectural projects. It offers a full editing toolset, a 3D rendering runtime, and can be run locally via CLI.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo containing a Next.js app, core packages (core, viewer, editor, nodes), CLI, and MCP server.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on React Three Fiber and WebGPU, managed as a Turborepo monorepo, and published as multiple npm packages.
en.hot: With high-performance 3D rendering via WebGPU and easy local setup, the project has gained 22k+ stars, including 168 today.
uses: Architects and designers: quickly create and share 3D architectural concepts.
Developers: integrate the 3D editor or viewer into React applications.
Educators: use for teaching demonstrations or student projects.

zh.tag: 面向CAD/CAE/CAM的AI代理技能库，用自然语言生成工程模型
zh.what: text-to-cad 是一个代理技能库，让 AI 代理能够从本地项目文件生成、检查、获取、切片和交接 CAD 及机器人描述工件。它支持通过自然语言指令创建和预览 CAD 几何体，并输出 STEP、STL、3MF 等格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块，如 CAD、URDF、SDF、SRDF 等，每个技能有 SKILL.md 文档和 Python 实现，还提供演示 GIF 和测试工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11+，依赖相关 CAD 库，支持导出 STEP、STL、3MF 等格式，并集成 URDF、SDF、SRDF 用于机器人描述和仿真。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 124 星，总星数达 15032，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5 名，因其将 AI 代理与 CAD 工程结合，降低了 3D 建模门槛而备受关注。
uses: 机械工程师和产品设计师 —— 通过自然语言快速生成和迭代 CAD 模型。
机器人开发者 —— 利用 URDF/SDF/SRDF 技能生成机器人描述文件，用于仿真和运动规划。
AI 代理开发者 —— 将 CAD 技能集成到代理工作流中，实现自动化设计任务。
3D 打印爱好者 —— 通过文本描述生成可打印的 STL/3MF 模型。

en.tag: A library of AI agent skills for CAD/CAE/CAM, generating engineering models from natural language
en.what: text-to-cad is a library of agent skills that enables AI agents to generate, inspect, source, slice, and hand off CAD and robot-description artifacts from local project files. It supports creating and previewing CAD geometry via natural language instructions, exporting to formats like STEP, STL, and 3MF.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill modules such as CAD, URDF, SDF, SRDF, each with SKILL.md documentation and Python implementation, along with demo GIFs and test workflows.
en.stack: Primarily uses Python 3.11+, depends on relevant CAD libraries, supports exporting STEP, STL, 3MF formats, and integrates URDF, SDF, SRDF for robot description and simulation.
en.hot: The project gained 124 stars today, reaching 15,032 total stars and ranking 5th on GitHub Trending daily, attracting attention for combining AI agents with CAD engineering to lower the barrier to 3D modeling.
uses: Mechanical engineers and product designers — quickly generate and iterate CAD models via natural language.
Robotics developers — use URDF/SDF/SRDF skills to generate robot description files for simulation and motion planning.
AI agent developers — integrate CAD skills into agent workflows for automated design tasks.
3D printing enthusiasts — generate printable STL/3MF models from text descriptions.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi）设计的技能包，提供 38 种编辑级质量的图表类型。它生成自包含的 HTML+SVG 文件，无需构建步骤或外部依赖，并强调无阴影、无 Mermaid 风格的设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 38 种图表类型的定义，每种都有浅色、深色和全编辑三种静态变体，以及文档和截图。还包含语义模式系统，可将行为与布局分离，并支持从 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源重绘图表。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript 或外部图像依赖。设计为与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 AI 代理兼容，并支持 Agent Skills 标准。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.
en.content: The repo contains definitions for 38 diagram types, each with minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial static variants, plus docs and screenshots. It also includes a semantic pattern system that separates behavior from layout, and can redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

zh.tag: 多智能体 LLM 金融交易决策框架
zh.what: TradingAgents 用多个 LLM 智能体模拟真实交易团队，分工完成基本面、情绪、新闻与宏观分析，再由研究员、交易员和风控角色辩论并输出交易决策。它把大模型编排成可复现的投研流水线，而非单一提示词预测涨跌。
zh.content: 仓库包含智能体角色定义、图式工作流编排、数据供应商注册表、决策日志记忆、CLI 与回测/检查点恢复逻辑，并附 arXiv 论文与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 Python，依赖 LangGraph 类图编排与多家 LLM 接口（OpenAI、Claude、GLM、Qwen、Groq、Bedrock 等），数据源涵盖 Alpha Vantage、FRED、Polymarket 与社交情绪。
zh.hot: 以 10.3 万 star、日增 367 登上 GitHub 日榜第 7，多智能体加金融交易的组合切中量化与 AI 交叉热点，且持续高频发版修复前视偏差等实盘痛点。
uses: 量化研究员与 AI 工程师，用于搭建可复现的多智能体投研实验
金融科技团队，评估 LLM 在交易决策链路中的可行性与风险
高校师生与论文读者，学习多智能体协作与金融 LLM 应用
个人开发者，基于 CLI 与数据供应商快速做策略原型验证

en.tag: Multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading decisions
en.what: TradingAgents orchestrates multiple LLM agents that mimic a real trading desk, splitting work across fundamentals, sentiment, news and macro analysts before researchers, traders and risk managers debate and produce a decision. It turns LLM prompting into a reproducible investment-research pipeline rather than a single-shot price prediction.
en.content: The repo ships agent role definitions, a graph-based workflow orchestrator, a data-provider registry, decision-log memory, a CLI with checkpoint resume, plus the arXiv paper and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on graph-style orchestration and multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, GLM, Qwen, Groq, Bedrock, etc.), with data from Alpha Vantage, FRED, Polymarket and social sentiment sources.
en.hot: With 103,956 stars and 367 added today, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending; the multi-agent-plus-trading combo hits the quant/AI intersection, and frequent releases fixing look-ahead bias address real trading pain points.
uses: Quant researchers and AI engineers building reproducible multi-agent investment-research experiments
Fintech teams assessing the feasibility and risk of LLMs in trading decision pipelines
Students and paper readers studying multi-agent collaboration and financial LLM applications
Individual developers prototyping strategies quickly via the CLI and data providers

zh.tag: 《系统设计面试》一书的完整学习笔记与章节索引

zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档，无特定编程语言或框架依赖，适合任何文本编辑器阅读。
zh.hot: 系统设计面试是技术面试的热门话题，该仓库因内容全面、结构清晰而广受关注，今日新增 1397 star，总 star 数达 18002，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 准备系统设计面试的软件工程师，可系统复习核心概念与设计题。
计算机专业学生，用于补充分布式系统与架构设计知识。
技术面试官，可作为出题和评估参考。
对大型系统架构感兴趣的开发者，用于日常学习与查阅。

en.tag: Complete study notes and chapter index for System Design Interview books
en.what: These are study notes for Alex Xu's System Design Interview Vol 1 and Vol 2, organized by chapter covering fundamentals like scaling and estimation to various system design problems. It spans 28 chapters and includes additional learning resources.
en.content: The repo organizes Markdown files by chapter, with each chapter in its own directory containing notes and diagrams; the README provides a full table of contents and external resource links.
en.stack: Pure Markdown documentation with no specific programming language or framework dependencies, readable in any text editor.
en.hot: System design interviews are a hot topic in tech interviews, and this repo is widely noticed for its comprehensive content and clear structure, gaining 1,397 stars today and reaching 18,002 total stars, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Software engineers preparing for system design interviews to review core concepts and design problems.
Computer science students supplementing knowledge in distributed systems and architecture design.
Technical interviewers as a reference for questions and evaluation.
Developers interested in large-scale system architecture for daily learning and reference.

zh.tag: 523 节课、20 阶段的 AI 工程从零到上线开源课程

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程代理桌面工作台，自带模型、插件可扩展

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. zh.tag: 聚合 50 家免费模型源，为 10 款编码代理统一供能的终端代理网关
zh.what: 这是一个把多家模型提供商的免费额度聚合成统一模型目录的代理层，让 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等编码代理都能调用同一批模型。它宣称每月可提供 13 亿以上免费 token，并在服务商故障时自动切换到下一个已配置模型。

en.tag: A terminal agent gateway aggregating 50 free model providers for 10 coding agents
en.what: It is a proxy layer that aggregates free quotas from many model providers into one unified model catalog, so coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode can all use the same pool. en.stack: Built on Python 3.14 with uv for dependency management, Pytest for testing, ty for type checking, Ruff for formatting, and Loguru for logging under the MIT license.
en.hot: With 54.2k stars and +214 today, it hits the demand for using paid agents like Claude Code for free while stressing ToS compliance, easing fears of account bans.

Engineering teams needing unified quota management and failover across multiple model providers
Power users who switch between coding agents across terminal, IDE, or phone

zh.what: Experiential 是一个面向 agent 工作流的开源网关与路由器，用统一的 OpenAI 兼容 API 接入托管、BYOK 和本地模型。它能按用户、agent、用途和预算精细管控模型调用，并把生产流量转化为专属的路由策略或定制模型。

希望用 BYOK 直连自有 API key、避免中间加价的开发者

en.tag: Open-source zero-markup LLM gateway and router that learns from your traffic to cut costs
en.what: Experiential is an open-source gateway and router for agent workflows that exposes hosted, BYOK, and local models through one OpenAI-compatible API. en.hot: It gained 686 stars today for a total of 3,753, landing at #7 on GitHub Trending (Python). The zero-markup gateway plus 'train your own model from your traffic' pitch hits the cost and model-governance anxiety of the agent era.

Developers who want BYOK pass-through with their own API keys and no markup
Platforms needing per-user/per-agent model permissions and budget governance
Data/ML teams wanting to turn production traffic into a custom router or model

zh.tag: 开源 OSINT 自动化引擎，200+ 模块绘制攻击面
zh.what: SpiderFoot 是一款开源情报（OSINT）自动化工具，能对接几乎所有公开数据源，自动收集并关联目标域名、IP、邮箱等信息。它用于威胁情报分析和攻击面测绘，帮助安全团队发现暴露在外的资产与风险。

uses: 渗透测试人员与红队成员，用于目标侦察和攻击面梳理
企业安全团队，用于持续监控自身暴露的资产与信息泄露
威胁情报分析师，用于关联多源数据并生成情报报告
安全学习者与 CTF 玩家，用于练习 OSINT 技术与工具链

en.tag: Open-source OSINT automation engine mapping your attack surface with 200+ modules
en.what: SpiderFoot is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) automation tool that integrates with virtually every available data source to gather and correlate information on targets such as domains, IPs and emails. It is used for threat intelligence and attack surface mapping, helping security teams uncover exposed assets and risks.
en.content: The repo ships 200+ scanning modules, a YAML-configurable correlation engine with 37 built-in rules, a SQLite storage backend, and an embedded web server providing both a GUI and a CLI entry point.
en.stack: Written in Python 3.7+ under the MIT license, it relies on SQLite for storage, supports Docker deployment, and can invoke external tools like DNSTwist, Whatweb, Nmap and CMSeeK.
en.hot: Actively maintained since 2012, it has accumulated 21,988 stars and gained 51 more today, ranking 8th on the Python daily trending list, reflecting sustained demand for attack surface management and OSINT.

Enterprise security teams for continuous monitoring of exposed assets and data leaks

Security learners and CTF players for practicing OSINT techniques and tooling

需要持久化上下文和可复用子代理的复杂任务场景。

en.tag: Self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks
en.what: Prime Agent is an open-source coding and research agent designed for general and long-running tasks. It is built around two core abstractions: the Recursive Language Model (RLM) and the Continual Harness, enabling self-improvement within persistent sessions.
en.content: The repository contains core agent packages, documentation, CI configs, and binary build scripts. The core is a persistent Python REPL environment supporting file operations, shell commands, subagent calls, and context management.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript, but the core control environment is Python. Dependencies include the Continual Harness, RLM implementation, and related verifiers.
en.hot: With nearly 20k stars added this month, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending monthly, it gains attention for its innovative self-improvement mechanism and practicality for long-running tasks.
uses: Developers automating coding workflows like code generation, refactoring, and testing.
Researchers conducting long-running autonomous tasks such as data gathering and experiment runs.
Complex scenarios requiring persistent context and reusable subagents.

zh.tag: 高性能响应式 UI 库，无虚拟 DOM
zh.what: Solid 是一个声明式 JavaScript 库，用于构建用户界面。它不使用虚拟 DOM，而是将模板编译为真实 DOM 节点，并通过细粒度的响应式更新来高效管理状态变化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 solid-js 的源代码、文档、示例和测试。主要提供响应式原语（如 createSignal）、渲染器以及 JSX 编译支持。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 JSX 和现代 JavaScript 特性，支持浏览器和服务器端渲染。
zh.hot: Solid 以其卓越的性能和细粒度响应式著称，star 数高达 35.9k，本月新增 208，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 适合追求极致性能、希望避免虚拟 DOM 开销的前端开发者
适用于需要高效更新复杂界面的单页应用或交互组件
适合喜欢响应式编程范式、熟悉 React 但想尝试新思路的团队

en.tag: High-performance reactive UI library without Virtual DOM
en.what: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, docs, examples, and tests for the core library solid-js. It provides reactive primitives (like createSignal), a renderer, and JSX compilation support.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, relies on JSX and modern JavaScript features, supports browser and server-side rendering.
en.hot: Solid is renowned for its excellent performance and fine-grained reactivity, with 35.9k stars and 208 added this month, continuously attracting developers.
uses: For frontend developers seeking top performance and avoiding Virtual DOM overhead
For building single-page apps or interactive components with efficient updates
For teams familiar with React but interested in a reactive paradigm without Virtual DOM

zh.tag: 开放代理技能生态的 CLI 工具，让技能即插即用
zh.what: skills 是一个命令行工具，用于安装、使用和管理 AI 编码代理的技能（skills）。它支持 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 80 多种代理，通过 npx 即可快速添加或直接运行技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 源码、CLI 入口、技能解析与安装逻辑，以及文档和示例。核心是 skills 命令行工具，支持从 GitHub、GitLab、本地路径等多种来源添加技能。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Node.js 构建，通过 npx 分发。依赖 Git 进行仓库操作，并集成 GitHub CLI 等认证方式。
zh.hot: 凭借 Vercel 品牌影响力和对多代理生态的广泛支持，该项目迅速获得 30k+ stars。今日新增 125 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 10，反映出开发者对标准化代理技能管理的强烈需求。
uses: AI 编码代理用户 —— 快速为 Claude Code、Cursor 等代理添加新技能
技能开发者 —— 发布和分享可复用的代理技能包
团队协作 —— 统一管理项目所需的代理技能，确保环境一致
探索者 —— 无需安装即可试用技能，通过 npx skills use 生成提示

en.tag: The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem, making skills plug-and-play
en.what: skills is a CLI tool for installing, using, and managing skills for AI coding agents. It supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 80+ other agents, enabling quick addition or direct execution of skills via npx.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, CLI entry points, skill resolution and installation logic, plus documentation and examples. At its core is the skills CLI, supporting skill addition from GitHub, GitLab, local paths, and more.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Node.js, distributed via npx. It relies on Git for repository operations and integrates authentication methods like GitHub CLI.
en.hot: With Vercel's brand influence and broad support for multiple agent ecosystems, the project quickly gained 30k+ stars. Adding 125 stars today and ranking 10th on the TypeScript daily chart, it reflects strong developer demand for standardized agent skill management.
uses: AI coding agent users — quickly add new skills to agents like Claude Code and Cursor
Skill developers — publish and share reusable agent skill packages
Team collaboration — uniformly manage project-required agent skills for consistent environments
Explorers — try skills without installation by generating prompts via npx skills use

zh.tag: 为 AI 提供记忆与上下文引擎，可完全本地运行
zh.what: Supermemory 是面向 AI 的记忆与上下文层，能从对话中自动抽取事实、构建用户画像、处理知识更新与矛盾并遗忘过期信息。它整合了完整 RAG、连接器与文件处理，在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo、ConvoMem 三大记忆基准上均排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含记忆引擎核心、Web 应用（apps/web）、插件与工具链，并提供 npm 与 PyPI 包、自托管文档和在线 Dashboard。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，提供 npm 与 PyPI 双端 SDK，支持自托管部署，并集成 Google Drive、Gmail、Notion、OneDrive、GitHub 等连接器。
zh.hot: 凭借三大记忆基准第一、95% Recall@15 与 99.4% 上下文压缩的硬指标，加上可完全本地运行，项目已积累近 3 万 star，今日再涨 276。
uses: 为聊天机器人与 AI 助手添加长期记忆的开发者
需要个性化用户画像与上下文注入的 AI 应用团队
希望自托管、数据不出本地的隐私敏感型企业
构建 RAG 与知识库、需处理多模态文档的工程师

en.tag: Memory and context engine for AI, fully self-hostable
en.what: Supermemory is the memory and context layer for AI: it learns from conversations, extracts facts, builds user profiles, handles knowledge updates and contradictions, and forgets expired information. It bundles full RAG, connectors and file processing, and ranks #1 on LongMemEval, LoCoMo and ConvoMem.
en.content: The repo contains the core memory engine, a web app (apps/web), plugins and tooling, plus npm and PyPI packages, self-hosting docs and a hosted dashboard.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript with both npm and PyPI SDKs, self-hosting support, and connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive and GitHub.
en.hot: With #1 rankings on three memory benchmarks, 95% Recall@15 and 99.4% context reduction, plus fully local operation, it has reached nearly 30k stars and gained 276 today.
uses: Developers adding long-term memory to chatbots and AI assistants
AI product teams needing personalized user profiles and context injection
Privacy-sensitive enterprises that want self-hosted, local-only data
Engineers building RAG and knowledge bases with multi-modal documents

zh.tag: 免费开源的屏幕录制与产品演示制作工具
zh.what: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，用于录制屏幕并将录制内容转化为精美的产品演示和讲解视频。它支持窗口或全屏录制、麦克风和系统音频、摄像头画中画、自动缩放、自定义光标效果以及自动字幕等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源代码，基于 TypeScript 构建，提供图形界面用于录制和编辑，支持导出为视频。项目处于积极开发中，包含 CLI 工具和项目文件格式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，可能基于 Electron 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用。依赖 GPU 加速，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 作为 Screen Studio 的开源替代品，完全免费且无水印，吸引了大量用户。今日新增 58 星，总星数达 2486，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜，表明社区对免费演示录制工具的需求旺盛。
uses: 开发者或产品经理需要快速制作产品演示视频，用于社交媒体或文档。
内容创作者希望录制教程或讲解，无需付费软件或水印。
团队需要内部培训或客户演示，希望使用开源工具保证数据安全。

en.tag: Free open-source screen recorder for polished product demos
en.what: OpenScreen is a free, open-source desktop app for recording your screen and turning the result into polished product demos and walkthroughs. It supports window or full-screen recording, mic and system audio, webcam overlay, auto-zoom, custom cursor effects, and automatic captions.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop app, built with TypeScript, featuring a GUI for recording and editing, and export capabilities. The project is actively developed, including a CLI and a project file format.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, likely built on Electron or similar for cross-platform desktop. GPU-accelerated, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As a free open-source alternative to Screen Studio with no watermarks, it attracts many users. Gaining 58 stars today, reaching 2486 total, and trending on GitHub, reflecting high demand for free demo recording tools.
uses: Developers or product managers needing quick product demo videos for social media or docs.
Content creators wanting to record tutorials without paid software or watermarks.
Teams requiring internal training or client demos with open-source tooling for data security.

zh.tag: GitHub Actions 官方仓库检出动作，CI 流水线的第一步
zh.what: actions/checkout 是 GitHub 官方提供的 Action，用于在 workflow 运行时把仓库代码检出到 $GITHUB_WORKSPACE，让后续步骤能访问源码。默认只拉取触发 workflow 的那一个 commit，可通过 fetch-depth 等参数调整。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 TypeScript 编写的 Action 实现，包含 src 源码、编译产物 dist、测试与构建 workflow，以及记录 v4 到 v7 各版本变更的 README。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Node.js 运行时（v5 起用 node24），依赖 @actions/* 工具包，v7 已迁移到 ESM；底层调用 git 命令，缺少 Git 2.18+ 时回退到 REST API 下载。
zh.hot: 作为几乎所有 GitHub Actions workflow 的第一个步骤，它被数百万仓库隐式依赖，8859 颗星与日榜第 13 名反映的是这种基础设施级刚需，而非短期热度。
uses: 任何在 GitHub Actions 上跑 CI/CD 的开发者，几乎每个 workflow 都要先调用它
需要检出完整提交历史做版本对比或语义化发布的团队，可设置 fetch-depth: 0
关注供应链安全、想规避 pull_request_target 下 fork 代码执行风险的维护者
想学习官方 Action 如何用 TypeScript 封装 git 与凭据管理的工程师

en.tag: The official GitHub Actions step that checks out your repo in CI
en.what: actions/checkout is GitHub's official Action that checks out your repository into $GITHUB_WORKSPACE so later workflow steps can access the code. By default it fetches only the single commit that triggered the workflow, with inputs like fetch-depth to change that.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript Action implementation with src sources, compiled dist output, tests and build workflows, plus a README documenting changes from v4 through v7.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript on the Node.js runtime (node24 since v5), depending on the @actions/* toolkit and migrated to ESM in v7; it shells out to git and falls back to the REST API when Git 2.18+ is unavailable.
en.hot: As the first step in nearly every GitHub Actions workflow, it is implicitly depended on by millions of repos; its 8,859 stars and No.13 trending spot reflect infrastructure-level necessity rather than a short-lived spike.
uses: Any developer running CI/CD on GitHub Actions, since nearly every workflow calls it first
Teams needing full history for changelogs or semantic releases by setting fetch-depth: 0
Maintainers worried about supply-chain risk from fork code under pull_request_target
Engineers studying how an official Action wraps git and credential handling in TypeScript

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，削减 98% 工具输出
zh.what: Context Mode 是专为 AI 编码代理设计的上下文窗口优化工具。它通过沙箱化工具输出（减少 98% 的 token 占用）、持久化会话记忆，并借助 MCP 和 hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由，从而解决 AI 编程中的“上下文另一半”问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 核心库、MCP 服务器、编辑器/平台扩展（如 VS Code、JetBrains）、CLI 工具、hooks 示例及文档。提供 npm 包、GitHub Marketplace 集成，并附带统计徽章与使用指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与平台 hooks，支持 npm 分发与 GitHub Marketplace 安装。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 2 万，今日新增 35，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。因解决 AI 编码代理的上下文溢出痛点，且被 Microsoft、Google 等大厂团队采用，并登上 Hacker News 榜首。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，希望减少上下文浪费、提升长任务稳定性。
团队需要跨平台统一管理 AI 代理的上下文与记忆，适用于多 IDE 或 CI 环境。
对 MCP 生态感兴趣，想通过 hooks 定制工具输出过滤与路由的进阶用户。

en.tag: Context optimization layer for AI coding agents, cutting tool output by 98%
en.what: Context Mode is a context window optimization tool for AI coding agents. It sandboxes tool output (98% token reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, addressing the 'other half' of the context problem in AI coding.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript core library, MCP server, editor/platform extensions (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.), CLI tools, hooks examples, and docs. Includes npm package, GitHub Marketplace integration, with stats badges and usage guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP (Model Context Protocol) and platform hooks, distributed via npm and GitHub Marketplace.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and +35 today, ranking #6 on TypeScript daily trending. It solves context overflow for AI coding agents, adopted by teams at Microsoft, Google, etc., and hit #1 on Hacker News.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor who want to reduce context waste and improve long-task stability.
Teams needing unified context and memory management across platforms, suitable for multi-IDE or CI environments.
Advanced users interested in MCP ecosystem, wanting to customize tool output filtering and routing via hooks.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台影视聚合播放器，多源搜索与在线播放
zh.what: MoonTV 是一个基于 Next.js 14 构建的影视聚合播放器，支持多资源搜索、在线播放、收藏同步、播放记录和云端存储。它提供 PWA 支持，可安装到桌面或移动端，并具备响应式布局和智能去广告功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Next.js 应用源码，包括前端界面、API 路由、播放器集成（ArtPlayer/HLS.js）、存储适配（Kvrocks/Redis）以及 Docker 部署配置。项目还提供 Zeabur 一键部署模板和详细的配置文件示例。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Next.js 14 (App Router)、Tailwind CSS 3、TypeScript 4，播放器使用 ArtPlayer 和 HLS.js，存储支持 Kvrocks/Redis/Upstash，部署依赖 Docker。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 日榜排名第 5，今日新增 197 星，总星数近万，因其功能全面、部署便捷且完全开源，吸引了大量影视爱好者和自托管用户。
uses: 适合喜欢自托管影视服务的用户，可自行部署并收集播放源。
适合开发者学习 Next.js 14 全栈开发、PWA 及流媒体播放器集成。
适合希望拥有跨平台（桌面/移动/Android TV）统一观影体验的个人用户。

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform movie/TV aggregator player with multi-source search and online playback
en.what: MoonTV is a movie/TV aggregator player built with Next.js 14, supporting multi-source search, online playback, favorites sync, watch history, and cloud storage. It offers PWA support for installation on desktop/mobile, responsive layout, and smart ad-blocking.
en.content: The repository contains the full Next.js application source code, including frontend UI, API routes, player integration (ArtPlayer/HLS.js), storage adapters (Kvrocks/Redis), and Docker deployment configs. It also offers a Zeabur one-click deploy template and detailed config file examples.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Next.js 14 (App Router), Tailwind CSS 3, TypeScript 4, players ArtPlayer and HLS.js, storage via Kvrocks/Redis/Upstash, and deployment via Docker.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 197 stars today to reach ~9.7k total, this project attracts movie enthusiasts and self-hosters due to its comprehensive features, easy deployment, and full open-source nature.
uses: Ideal for users who prefer self-hosting media services and want to deploy their own aggregator with custom sources.
Great for developers learning Next.js 14 full-stack development, PWA implementation, and streaming player integration.
Perfect for individuals seeking a unified cross-platform viewing experience (desktop, mobile, Android TV) with sync features.

zh.tag: 插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
zh.what: MusicFree 是一款插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，目前支持 Android 和 Harmony OS。它本身不集成任何音源，所有搜索、播放、歌单导入等功能均通过插件实现，用户可自由安装第三方插件来扩展功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含播放器的完整源代码，采用 TypeScript 编写，包含 UI 组件、播放核心、插件管理模块等。同时提供插件开发文档和示例插件，方便开发者二次开发。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源。依赖包括 React Native 或类似跨平台框架（根据项目结构推测），以及用于插件加载的 CommonJS 模块系统。
zh.hot: 凭借插件化设计实现高度定制和无广告体验，吸引了大量用户。本月新增 802 个 star，总 star 数达 26643，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（TypeScript）第 14 名，反映出社区对自由音乐播放器的强烈需求。
uses: 适合追求无广告、可定制音乐播放体验的 Android 或 Harmony OS 用户。
适合希望自行控制音源、通过插件扩展功能的音乐爱好者。
适合对音乐播放器开发感兴趣的开发者，可参考其插件架构。

en.tag: A plugin-based, ad-free, free music player
en.what: MusicFree is a plugin-based, customizable, ad-free free music player that currently supports Android and Harmony OS. It does not integrate any music sources itself; all functions like search, playback, and playlist import are implemented via plugins, allowing users to freely install third-party plugins to extend functionality.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the player, written in TypeScript, including UI components, playback core, plugin management modules, etc. It also provides plugin development documentation and example plugins for developers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, open-sourced under AGPL 3.0. Dependencies include a cross-platform framework like React Native (inferred from project structure), and CommonJS module system for plugin loading.
en.hot: With its plugin-based design enabling high customization and ad-free experience, it has attracted many users. Gaining 802 stars this month, reaching 26,643 total, and ranking 14th on GitHub Trending monthly (TypeScript), reflecting strong community demand for a free music player.
uses: Ideal for Android or Harmony OS users seeking an ad-free, customizable music playback experience.
Suitable for music enthusiasts who want to control their music sources and extend functionality via plugins.
Great for developers interested in music player development, offering insights into plugin architecture.

zh.tag: 把各类 AI 编程工具接到 40+ 免费/廉价模型上的智能路由与省 token 网关
zh.what: 9Router 是一个本地运行的 AI 路由网关，把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline、Copilot 等编程工具统一接到 40+ 家供应商、100+ 模型上。它通过订阅→廉价→免费的自动降级、多账号轮询和 RTK token 压缩，让开发者尽量不撞限额、少花钱。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 JavaScript 项目，核心是本地路由服务（默认 http://localhost:20128/v1）与 Web 仪表盘，包含 RTK token 压缩、格式转换（OpenAI ↔ Claude）、配额追踪与自动刷新等模块，并提供 npm 包、Docker 镜像与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 JavaScript，以 npm 包和 Docker/ GHCR 镜像分发，对外暴露 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 接口，依赖各 AI 供应商的 API 与订阅凭证。

en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary supporting over 100 commands like ls, cat, grep, git, cargo test, etc. It also includes installation scripts, documentation (including architecture), and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, zero dependencies, single binary, overhead under 10ms.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become popular, token costs are a pain point. RTK significantly cuts costs, is easy to install, and performs well, hence its rapid rise.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex who want to reduce token usage and costs.
DevOps engineers dealing with large command outputs, improving efficiency by compressing logs and status info.
