zh.tag: 跨 AI 编码代理的长期记忆与交接协议
zh.what: ai-memory 为 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆，支持在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20+ 代理间无缝切换，无需重新解释架构或未决问题。它通过 git 备份的 markdown 文件存储记忆，并内置多用户认证与审计日志，适合个人及团队使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单一二进制文件，提供捕获、整合、召回和交接功能。包含生命周期钩子、隐私边界、审计日志，以及可重建的索引数据库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.95+，依赖 git 作为存储后端，支持 markdown 文件操作，无需向量数据库。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4490 星，总星数达 5887，因其解决了 AI 编码代理切换时的记忆丢失痛点，且零 LLM 调用即可工作，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 个人开发者：在不同 AI 编码代理间切换时保留上下文，避免重复解释项目细节。
团队协作：共享项目记忆，让团队成员的代理都能访问集体知识。
自托管用户：在自有服务器上运行，实现跨机器同步和隐私控制。

en.tag: Cross-agent long-term memory and handoff protocol for coding CLIs
en.what: ai-memory provides long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling seamless switching between 20+ agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor without re-explaining architecture or open questions. It stores memory as git-backed markdown files and includes multi-user auth and audit logs for team use.
en.content: The repo contains a single Rust binary offering capture, consolidate, recall, and handoff features. It includes lifecycle hooks, privacy boundaries, audit logs, and a rebuildable index database.
en.stack: Primarily Rust 1.95+, uses git as storage backend, supports markdown file operations, no vector database required.
en.hot: Gained 4490 stars this month (total 5887), trending #18 on GitHub. It solves the pain of memory loss when switching AI coding agents and works with zero LLM calls, attracting developers.
uses: Individual developers: preserve context when switching between different AI coding agents, avoiding re-explaining project details.
Team collaboration: share project memory so all team members' agents can access collective knowledge.
Self-hosters: run on your own server for cross-machine sync and privacy control.

zh.tag: 开源软件工厂：把常规工程任务自动变成可评审的 PR
zh.what: SuperPlane 是一个开源的「软件工厂」，把高置信度的 backlog issue 自动转化为经过验证、可直接评审的 pull request。它协调编码代理、源码管理、CI、评审与审批流程，让工程师专注在真正需要判断力的工作上。
zh.content: 仓库包含工厂引擎核心代码（Go）、work order 与 automation line 等资源模型、策略与护栏机制，以及 docs 目录下的架构图、演示图片和官网/文档/贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，支持自选模型、云端或本地部署，并集成源码控制、CI 与评审系统。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 1，今日新增 251 star、累计 6577，说明「代理自动干活」的工程化落地正被大量开发者关注。
uses: 希望用 AI 代理自动消化常规 backlog 的工程团队
想搭建内部自动化研发流水线的平台/DevOps 工程师
关注 AI 代理与 CI/CD 深度集成的开源爱好者
需要可自托管、模型可替换方案的合规敏感企业

en.tag: Open-source factory turning routine engineering work into reviewed pull requests
en.what: SuperPlane is an open-source software factory that turns high-confidence backlog issues into verified, review-ready pull requests. It coordinates coding agents, source control, CI, review and approvals in one visible system so engineers can focus on work that needs judgment.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based factory engine, resource models such as work orders and automation lines, policy and guardrail logic, plus docs with architecture diagrams, demo images and contribution guides.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go under Apache 2.0, it supports bring-your-own models, cloud or on-prem deployment, and integrates with source control, CI and review systems.
en.hot: It hit #1 on GitHub Trending (Go) with 251 stars added today and 6,577 total, showing strong demand for productionizing agent-driven engineering work.
uses: Engineering teams wanting AI agents to burn down routine backlog work
Platform/DevOps engineers building internal automated delivery pipelines
Open-source enthusiasts tracking deep agent + CI/CD integration
Compliance-sensitive enterprises needing self-hosted, model-agnostic setups

zh.tag: 穿透一切的模块化网络代理平台，v2ray-core 的进化版
zh.what: Xray-core 是 Project X 出品的开源网络工具核心，源自 XTLS 协议，提供 VLESS、XTLS、REALITY 等新一代代理与传输方案。它可作为通用网络平台，用于构建各类穿透、转发与隐私通信场景。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的核心引擎，包含 app、proxy、transport、common 等模块化目录，并附有官方文档链接、安装脚本与 Docker 镜像说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，遵循 Mozilla Public License 2.0，依赖标准库与少量第三方网络库，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 等多平台及 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 已积累 41493 颗星，今日再增 26 星并登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 2，说明这款老牌代理核心在隐私与网络自由需求下持续保持高关注度。
uses: 需要自建代理或穿透服务的开发者与运维人员
关注网络隐私、研究传输协议与加密方案的技术爱好者
希望基于 Xray 二次开发或集成到自有产品的团队

en.tag: A modular network proxy platform that penetrates everything, the evolved v2ray-core
en.what: Xray-core is the open-source networking core from Project X, originating from the XTLS protocol and offering next-gen proxy and transport schemes like VLESS, XTLS and REALITY. It serves as a general-purpose platform for building tunneling, forwarding and privacy-oriented communication setups.
en.content: The repo centers on a Go-based core engine with modular directories such as app, proxy, transport and common, plus links to official docs, install scripts and Docker images.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, relying on the standard library and a few third-party networking packages, with multi-platform support including Linux, Windows, macOS and Docker.
en.hot: With 41,493 stars and 26 added today, it ranks #2 on GitHub Trending (Go), showing this veteran proxy core keeps drawing attention amid ongoing demand for privacy and open networking.
uses: Developers and operators who need to build their own proxy or tunneling services
Tech enthusiasts focused on network privacy and transport/encryption protocol research
Teams looking to build on Xray or integrate it into their own products

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）功能。它可作为反向代理的认证层，支持 LDAP、OIDC 等集成，并已通过 OpenID 认证，且为后量子密码学做好准备。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心服务、命令行工具、配置示例、文档站点（authelia.com）以及用于构建和测试的 CI/CD 配置。代码结构清晰，包含认证、授权、会话管理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种 Go 库，支持 LDAP、OIDC、TOTP、U2F 等协议。前端可能涉及少量 JavaScript，用于登录页面。
zh.hot: 本月新增 359 星，总星数达 2.88 万，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10。其安全性和对现代认证标准的支持吸引了大量自托管和隐私敏感用户。
uses: 自托管服务（如 Nextcloud、Grafana）的统一登录与二次验证
企业或团队内部应用的单点登录，集成现有 LDAP 或 OIDC
希望为 Web 应用添加安全认证层，但不希望使用商业 SSO 的开发者
对后量子密码学感兴趣，希望提前适配未来安全标准的技术团队

en.tag: Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor Authentication portal for web apps
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication layer for reverse proxies, integrates with LDAP and OIDC, and is OpenID Certified and Post-Quantum Cryptography Ready.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, command-line tools, configuration examples, documentation site (authelia.com), and CI/CD setup for building and testing. The code is well-organized into modules for authentication, authorization, session management, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various Go libraries. Supports LDAP, OIDC, TOTP, U2F, and other protocols. The frontend may include minimal JavaScript for the login page.
en.hot: With 359 new stars this month and a total of 28.8k stars, it ranks 10th on the Go trending list. Its security focus and support for modern auth standards attract many self-hosters and privacy-conscious users.
uses: Centralized login and 2FA for self-hosted services like Nextcloud and Grafana
SSO for internal enterprise apps, integrating with existing LDAP or OIDC
Developers wanting to add secure auth to web apps without commercial SSO
Tech teams interested in post-quantum cryptography readiness

zh.tag: 把多家 AI 订阅额度统一转成 API 的中转网关
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，把 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅账号统一接入成标准 API 接口。它支持多人拼车共享订阅额度，让原生客户端工具无缝调用，从而更高效地分摊使用成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端服务、Vue 管理面板，以及 Docker 部署配置和 logo、赞助商等资源文件，并附中英日多语言 README。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 1.27，前端为 Vue 3.4+，数据层依赖 PostgreSQL 15+ 与 Redis 7+，并提供 Docker 一键部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.1 万 star、日增 136 并登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 4，它切中了订阅额度共享与统一接入的真实痛点，因此持续走热。
uses: 想用一份订阅额度供多人或团队共享的开发者
需要把多家模型统一成 OpenAI 兼容接口的自建网关用户
希望用 Claude Code、Codex 等原生工具低成本接入的工程师
研究 AI API 中转与配额分发架构的技术学习者

en.tag: An open-source gateway that turns multi-vendor AI subscriptions into unified APIs
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway that unifies Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok subscription accounts behind standard API endpoints. It supports shared/carpool quota distribution so native client tools work seamlessly while splitting costs more efficiently.
en.content: The repo ships a Go backend service, a Vue admin panel, Docker deployment configs, plus logo and sponsor assets, with READMEs in Chinese, English and Japanese.
en.stack: Backend is Go 1.27, frontend is Vue 3.4+, with PostgreSQL 15+ and Redis 7+ for data, and Docker-ready deployment.
en.hot: With 41k stars, +136 today and a #4 spot on the GitHub Go daily trending list, it hits the real pain of shared subscription quota and unified access.
uses: Developers who want to share one subscription quota across a team
Self-hosters needing a unified OpenAI-compatible gateway for multiple models
Engineers using Claude Code, Codex and similar tools at lower cost
Learners studying AI API relay and quota-distribution architecture

zh.tag: Go 语言极简 HTTP/REST/SSE 客户端库
zh.what: Resty 是 Go 生态中广受欢迎的 HTTP 客户端封装库，在标准库 net/http 之上提供更简洁流畅的链式 API。它支持 REST 请求、自动 JSON/XML 序列化、文件上传下载、重试、超时、代理以及 SSE 流式响应等常见需求。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 源码为主体，包含核心客户端实现、中间件/重试逻辑、SSE 支持、大量单元测试与示例，并配有 resty.dev 官方文档站与 CI/覆盖率徽章。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 实现，最低要求 go1.23，模块路径为 resty.dev/v3，遵循语义化版本，几乎无第三方运行时依赖。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 社区最成熟的 HTTP 客户端之一，Resty 已积累 11793 颗星，今日再登 Go 日榜第 5，说明其在 API 调用与微服务场景中仍是刚需工具。
uses: Go 后端开发者需要快速调用第三方 REST API 时
微服务架构中统一封装 HTTP 客户端、重试与超时策略
需要处理 SSE 流式响应或文件上传下载的 Go 项目
希望减少样板代码、提升 HTTP 调用可读性的团队

en.tag: Simple HTTP, REST, and SSE client library for Go
en.what: Resty is a widely used HTTP client wrapper for Go that offers a fluent, chainable API on top of the standard net/http package. It supports REST calls, automatic JSON/XML serialization, file upload/download, retries, timeouts, proxies, and SSE streaming responses.
en.content: The repo is primarily Go source code, containing the core client implementation, middleware/retry logic, SSE support, extensive unit tests and examples, along with the resty.dev documentation site and CI/coverage badges.
en.stack: Pure Go implementation requiring go1.23+, module path resty.dev/v3, following semantic versioning with virtually no third-party runtime dependencies.
en.hot: As one of the most mature HTTP clients in the Go community, Resty has accumulated 11,793 stars and ranks 5th on today's Go trending list, showing it remains essential for API calls and microservices.
uses: Go backend developers who need to call third-party REST APIs quickly
Microservice architectures needing unified HTTP client, retry, and timeout policies
Go projects handling SSE streaming responses or file uploads/downloads
Teams wanting less boilerplate and more readable HTTP calls

zh.tag: 阿里内部打磨两年的 AI 代码审查 CLI，混合架构精准定位行级缺陷
zh.what: Open Code Review 是阿里巴巴开源的 AI 代码审查命令行工具，源自集团内部官方 AI 代码评审助手。它采用「确定性流水线 + LLM Agent」的混合架构，能给出精确到行的评论，并内置 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等多语言规则集。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写，提供 CLI 与 npm 包（@alibaba-group/open-code-review），含多语言 README、规则集、Agent 适配层与 CI 集成配置。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，通过 npm 分发；兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口，可接入 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux。
zh.hot: 背靠阿里内部两年、数万开发者与数百万缺陷的实战验证，加上 2.2 万 star 与日榜 Go 第 6 的成绩，可信度与话题度兼具。
uses: 企业研发团队 —— 在 CI 中自动审查 PR，拦截 NPE、SQL 注入等常见缺陷
个人开发者 —— 本地 CLI 快速自查代码，获得行级修改建议
安全与合规工程师 —— 借助内置多语言规则集做静态安全扫描
Agent 工具链玩家 —— 把审查能力接入 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码助手

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with hybrid pipeline + LLM agent architecture
en.what: Open Code Review is Alibaba's open-source AI-powered code review CLI, born from the company's internal AI review assistant. It combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent to produce precise line-level comments, backed by a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection.
en.content: Written in Go, the repo ships a CLI plus an npm package (@alibaba-group/open-code-review), with multilingual READMEs, rulesets, agent adapters and CI integration configs.
en.stack: Primarily Go, distributed via npm; compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, integrates with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.
en.hot: It rides on two years of Alibaba-internal validation across tens of thousands of developers and millions of defects, and with 22k+ stars and a #6 spot on the Go daily trending list, it blends credibility with buzz.
uses: Enterprise dev teams — auto-review PRs in CI to catch NPE, SQL injection and similar defects
Individual developers — run the local CLI for quick self-review with line-level suggestions
Security and compliance engineers — use the built-in multi-language ruleset for static security scanning
Agent toolchain builders — plug review capabilities into Claude Code, Cursor and similar coding assistants

zh.tag: 飞书官方 CLI，为人类与 AI Agent 打造，覆盖 200+ 命令与 26 项 Agent 技能。
zh.what: lark-cli 是飞书官方维护的命令行工具，让开发者和 AI Agent 在终端直接操作飞书核心业务域。它覆盖 Messenger、Docs、Base、Sheets、Calendar、Mail、Tasks、Meetings 等 18 个域，提供 200+ 精选命令和 26 个 AI Agent Skills。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、三层命令系统（快捷命令/API 命令/原始 API）、skills/ 目录下的 26 个 Agent 技能定义，以及 extension/ 企业嵌入包和完整文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 1.23+ 开发，通过 npm 分发（@larksuite/cli），MIT 许可，依赖飞书开放平台 API，支持 OS 原生钥匙串存储凭证。
zh.hot: 作为飞书官方 CLI，它同时服务人类和 AI Agent，填补了 Agent 操作飞书的工具空白，今日新增 23 星，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 7 名，总星数达 17098。
uses: 个人开发者：在终端或自有 AI Agent 中快速调用飞书 API，3 分钟完成安装到首次调用。
企业 IT/ISV：将 lark-cli 嵌入自有 Agent 或平台，实现集中凭证管理、统一审计和受限命令面。
AI Agent 开发者：利用 26 个开箱即用的 Skills，让 Agent 零额外配置操作飞书。
自动化运维：通过 200+ 命令覆盖 Messenger、Docs、Base 等 18 个业务域，实现流程自动化。

en.tag: Official Lark/Feishu CLI for humans and AI Agents, with 200+ commands and 26 Agent Skills.
en.what: lark-cli is the official Lark/Feishu CLI tool maintained by the larksuite team, enabling developers and AI Agents to operate Lark's core business domains directly from the terminal. It covers 18 domains including Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks, and Meetings, with 200+ curated commands and 26 AI Agent Skills.
en.content: The repo contains Go source code, a three-layer command system (shortcuts, API commands, raw API), 26 Agent Skill definitions under skills/, enterprise embedding packages in extension/, and full documentation.
en.stack: Built in Go 1.23+, distributed via npm (@larksuite/cli), MIT licensed, depends on Lark Open Platform APIs, and uses OS-native keychain for credential storage.
en.hot: As the official Lark CLI serving both humans and AI Agents, it fills the gap for Agent-driven Lark operations. It gained 23 stars today, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending (Go daily), with 17,098 total stars.
uses: Individual developers: quickly call Lark APIs from the terminal or their own AI Agent, from install to first call in 3 minutes.
Enterprise IT/ISV: embed lark-cli into their own Agent or platform for centralized credentials, unified audit logging, and a restricted command surface.
AI Agent developers: leverage 26 out-of-the-box Skills to let Agents operate Lark with zero extra setup.
Automation engineers: automate workflows across 18 business domains like Messenger, Docs, and Base via 200+ commands.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上的异构 GPU 虚拟化与共享调度中间件
zh.what: HAMi 是面向 AI 基础设施的 Kubernetes 异构算力虚拟化中间件，前身是 k8s-vGPU-scheduler。它让平台团队在 Kubernetes 中共享昂贵的 GPU 及其他 AI 加速器，对显存和算力做隔离，并在无需改动应用代码的前提下按设备感知策略调度 Pod。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写的调度器、设备插件与 Webhook 等核心组件为主，配套 Helm Chart、部署清单、文档与多语言 README（中/英/日），并包含架构图与 CI、代码覆盖率等工程配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 开发，深度集成 Kubernetes 调度框架与 Device Plugin 机制，通过 Helm 部署，并接入 CNCF 生态与 Slack、Discord 社区协作。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 孵化项目，HAMi 切中 AI 集群 GPU 利用率低、多厂商加速器难以统一调度的痛点，已积累 4563 颗星，今日新增 23 星并登上 Go 日榜第 8 名。
uses: AI 平台工程师：需要在 Kubernetes 上提升 GPU 利用率并做显存隔离
云原生基础设施团队：希望统一调度 NVIDIA 及其他异构加速器
MLOps/运维人员：想在不改应用代码的情况下共享与配额管理 GPU
成本敏感型企业：用 GPU 切分降低小任务独占整卡的浪费

en.tag: Kubernetes GPU virtualization and heterogeneous accelerator sharing middleware
en.what: HAMi is a Kubernetes-native middleware for heterogeneous AI computing virtualization, formerly known as k8s-vGPU-scheduler. It lets platform teams share expensive GPUs and other AI accelerators across workloads, isolate device memory and compute, and schedule pods with device-aware policies without changing application code.
en.content: The repo centers on Go-based scheduler, device plugin and webhook components, plus Helm charts, deployment manifests, docs and multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/JA), along with architecture diagrams and CI/coverage configuration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it deeply integrates with the Kubernetes scheduling framework and Device Plugin mechanism, deploys via Helm, and participates in the CNCF ecosystem with Slack and Discord community support.
en.hot: As a CNCF incubating project, HAMi addresses the pain of low GPU utilization and fragmented multi-vendor accelerator scheduling in AI clusters, accumulating 4,563 stars with 23 added today and ranking 8th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: AI platform engineers who need to boost GPU utilization and isolate device memory on Kubernetes
Cloud-native infra teams looking to unify scheduling across NVIDIA and other heterogeneous accelerators
MLOps and operators who want GPU sharing and quota management without changing app code
Cost-sensitive organizations reducing waste from small jobs occupying whole GPUs

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 提供上下文层
zh.what: RAGFlow 是一个开源的检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将先进的 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力相结合，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量的上下文层。它支持深度文档理解、基于知识的问答和自动化工作流，帮助企业构建可靠的 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RAGFlow 源代码，包括后端服务（Go）、前端界面（React）、文档和部署配置。支持多种文档格式解析、知识库管理、Agent 编排和 API 接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发后端，前端采用 React，依赖 Docker 进行部署。集成了深度学习模型和向量数据库，支持多种 LLM 接口。
zh.hot: 凭借近 9 万 Star 和月增 3530 的热度，RAGFlow 成为 RAG 领域的明星项目。其融合 Agent 的创新设计和对企业级应用的专注，吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 企业知识库问答：利用 RAGFlow 构建基于内部文档的智能问答系统，提升信息检索效率。
AI 应用开发：开发者可基于 RAGFlow 快速搭建具备 RAG 和 Agent 能力的应用，减少重复工作。
文档智能处理：适用于需要深度解析 PDF、Word 等格式并提取结构化信息的场景。
研究实验：学术研究者可借助其开源特性进行 RAG 相关算法的验证与改进。

en.tag: Open-source RAG engine fusing RAG with Agent capabilities for LLM context
en.what: RAGFlow is an open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that combines advanced RAG techniques with Agent capabilities to provide a superior context layer for LLMs. It enables deep document understanding, knowledge-based Q&A, and automated workflows for building reliable AI applications.
en.content: The repository contains the full RAGFlow source code, including backend services (Go), frontend interface (React), documentation, and deployment configs. It supports multiple document formats, knowledge base management, agent orchestration, and API endpoints.
en.stack: Backend is primarily in Go, frontend uses React, and deployment is Docker-based. It integrates deep learning models and vector databases, supporting multiple LLM interfaces.
en.hot: With nearly 90k stars and 3,530 new stars this month, RAGFlow is a star project in the RAG domain. Its innovative Agent fusion and enterprise focus attract many developers.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base Q&A: Build intelligent Q&A systems on internal documents to boost information retrieval efficiency.
AI application development: Developers can quickly build apps with RAG and Agent capabilities, reducing repetitive work.
Intelligent document processing: Ideal for deep parsing of PDFs, Word, and other formats to extract structured information.
Research experiments: Academics can leverage its open-source nature to validate and improve RAG algorithms.

zh.tag: 开源MCP服务器，让AI代理直连企业数据库
zh.what: MCP Toolbox for Databases 是一个开源 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，让 AI 代理、IDE 和应用直接连接企业数据库。它既提供开箱即用的通用工具，也支持构建自定义的安全 AI 工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言实现的 MCP 服务器核心、多语言 SDK（Python、JS/TS、Go、Java）、预置工具集以及详细文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，提供 Python、JavaScript/TypeScript、Go 和 Java 的 SDK，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方开源项目，它解决了 AI 代理连接数据库的痛点，获得 16353 颗星，今日新增 12 星，位列 Go 日榜第 10。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 快速为代理添加数据库访问能力，无需编写样板代码。
数据工程师 —— 安全地构建生产级 AI 工具，支持结构化查询和 NL2SQL。
IDE 用户 —— 在 Gemini CLI、Claude Code 等工具中直接与数据库交互。

en.tag: Open-source MCP server connecting AI agents to enterprise databases
en.what: MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects AI agents, IDEs, and applications directly to enterprise databases. It offers both ready-to-use generic tools and a framework for building custom, secure AI tools.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based MCP server core, multi-language SDKs (Python, JS/TS, Go, Java), prebuilt tools, and comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, with SDKs for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java, licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: As an official Google open-source project, it addresses the pain point of connecting AI agents to databases, earning 16,353 stars with 12 new today, ranking 10th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: AI agent developers — quickly add database access to agents without boilerplate.
Data engineers — securely build production AI tools with structured queries and NL2SQL.
IDE users — interact directly with databases in tools like Gemini CLI or Claude Code.

zh.tag: 自托管 WAF 与反向代理，为 Web 应用提供攻击防护
zh.what: SafeLine 是一款可自托管的 Web 应用防火墙（WAF），以反向代理方式部署在 Web 应用与互联网之间。它通过过滤和监控 HTTP 流量，拦截 SQL 注入、XSS、RCE、SSRF、路径穿越、暴力破解、HTTP 洪泛等常见攻击。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 WAF 核心与反向代理引擎、Docker 部署配置、Web 管理界面以及中英文文档和演示入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通常以 Docker 容器方式部署，前端管理面板与后端引擎分离，依赖较少、开箱即用。
zh.hot: 已获约 2.25 万 Star，今日新增 22，位列 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 11 名，并曾登上 Trendshift 日榜/周榜第一，安全自托管需求持续推高热度。
uses: 运维与安全工程师为自建网站、API 网关快速加装 WAF 防护
中小团队或个人开发者用 Docker 一键部署，替代昂贵的商业 WAF
需要在自有服务器上满足数据合规、避免流量经过第三方云 WAF 的场景
想学习反向代理与 Web 攻击拦截原理的开发者

en.tag: Self-hosted WAF and reverse proxy protecting web apps from attacks
en.what: SafeLine is a self-hosted Web Application Firewall (WAF) deployed as a reverse proxy between your web apps and the Internet. It filters and monitors HTTP traffic to block SQL injection, XSS, RCE, SSRF, path traversal, brute force, HTTP floods and more.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based WAF core and reverse proxy engine, Docker deployment configs, a web management UI, plus bilingual docs and a live demo link.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go and typically deployed via Docker, with a separate web admin panel and a lightweight, ready-to-run setup.
en.hot: With ~22.5k stars and 22 added today, it ranks #11 on GitHub Trending (Go daily) and has topped Trendshift daily/weekly charts, driven by growing demand for self-hosted security.
uses: DevOps and security engineers adding WAF protection to self-hosted sites or API gateways
Small teams or solo developers wanting a one-click Docker alternative to costly commercial WAFs
Scenarios requiring on-prem data compliance without routing traffic through third-party cloud WAFs
Developers curious about reverse proxies and how web attack interception works

zh.tag: 云原生监控系统与时序数据库
zh.what: Prometheus 是一个开源的系统与服务监控系统，定期从配置的目标采集指标，评估规则表达式，展示结果，并在满足条件时触发告警。它内置时序数据库，采用多维数据模型和强大的 PromQL 查询语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prometheus 服务端核心代码、PromQL 查询引擎、时序存储引擎（TSDB）、服务发现、告警规则管理、内置 Web UI 以及完整的文档和部署示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖较少，可独立部署。支持多种服务发现机制，并提供与 Kubernetes、Consul 等系统的集成。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Prometheus 是云原生监控的事实标准，拥有超过 66,000 颗星，今日新增 19 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 运维和 SRE 团队用于监控云原生应用和基础设施
开发者用于采集和查询应用自定义指标
企业用于构建告警和可视化仪表板

en.tag: The cloud-native monitoring system and time series database
en.what: Prometheus is an open-source systems and service monitoring system that collects metrics from configured targets at given intervals, evaluates rule expressions, displays results, and triggers alerts when conditions are met. It includes a built-in time series database with a multi-dimensional data model and the powerful PromQL query language.
en.content: The repository contains the core Prometheus server code, the PromQL query engine, the time series storage engine (TSDB), service discovery, alerting rule management, a built-in web UI, and comprehensive documentation and deployment examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go with minimal dependencies, it can be deployed standalone. It supports multiple service discovery mechanisms and integrates with systems like Kubernetes and Consul.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Prometheus is the de facto standard for cloud-native monitoring, with over 66,000 stars and 19 new stars today, maintaining continuous attention.
uses: Ops and SRE teams for monitoring cloud-native applications and infrastructure
Developers for collecting and querying custom application metrics
Enterprises for building alerting and visualization dashboards

zh.tag: 把本地 AI 编程助手桥接到主流即时通讯平台
zh.what: cc-connect 是一个用 Go 编写的桥接工具，把本机运行的 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Codex、Kimi CLI 等 AI 编程代理接入飞书/Lark、钉钉、Slack、Telegram、Discord、LINE、企业微信等聊天平台。用户可以在任意地点通过聊天窗口让 AI 检查或修改代码、排查问题、执行命令和自动化任务，多数平台无需公网 IP。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的核心桥接服务、各 IM 平台与各 AI CLI 的适配层、配置与部署文档，以及 docs 下的 banner 等资源；同时提供 npm 包与 GitHub Release 分发，并配有 CI、Go Report Card 和 Discord/Telegram 社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 npm 包与 GitHub Release 分发，使用 GitHub Actions 做 CI，并集成多种 IM 平台 SDK 与 AI CLI 的调用接口。
zh.hot: 项目已获约 1.5 万 star，今日新增 26，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 13 名；它切中了开发者希望随时随地用聊天工具驱动本地 AI 编程代理的刚需，且多平台免公网 IP 的卖点降低了部署门槛。
uses: 需要在手机或聊天软件里远程操控本地 AI 编程代理的开发者
希望把 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等接入团队 IM 的工程团队
想用飞书、钉钉、Slack 等平台做 AI 自动化任务和运维的团队
关注 AI 代理工具链、想快速体验多平台桥接方案的极客

en.tag: Bridge local AI coding agents to mainstream messaging platforms
en.what: cc-connect is a Go-based bridge that connects locally running AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex and Kimi CLI to messaging platforms including Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE and WeChat Work. From anywhere, users can chat with their AI dev assistant to inspect or modify code, debug issues, run commands and automate tasks, with no public IP required for most platforms.
en.content: The repo contains the core Go bridge service, adapters for each IM platform and AI CLI, configuration and deployment docs, plus assets like the banner under docs; it also ships via npm and GitHub Releases, with CI, Go Report Card and Discord/Telegram community links.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, distributed via npm package and GitHub Releases, using GitHub Actions for CI and integrating multiple IM platform SDKs with AI CLI invocation interfaces.
en.hot: With about 15.4k stars and 26 added today, it ranks 13th on GitHub Trending (Go) daily; it hits a real need for developers to drive local AI coding agents from any chat app, and its no-public-IP support for most platforms lowers the deployment barrier.
uses: Developers who want to remotely control local AI coding agents from a phone or chat app
Engineering teams looking to connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and similar tools to team IM
Teams wanting to run AI automation and ops tasks via Feishu, DingTalk, Slack and more
Geeks following the AI agent toolchain who want to try a multi-platform bridge quickly

zh.tag: Kubernetes 原生批处理调度系统，CNCF 项目
zh.what: Volcano 是 Kubernetes 原生的批处理调度系统，在标准 kube-scheduler 基础上扩展并增强调度能力。它面向 AI/ML/DL、生物信息、基因组学和大数据等批处理与弹性工作负载，提供作业管理、队列、公平调度等完整功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含调度器、控制器、Webhook、CLI（vcctl）等核心组件，以及大量文档、设计提案和示例配置，整体是一个可独立部署的 Go 项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，深度依赖 Kubernetes API 与客户端库，并集成 Spark、Flink、Ray、TensorFlow、PyTorch、Kubeflow、MPI 等主流框架。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Volcano 在 AI 与大数据批处理调度领域被广泛采用，拥有近 6000 star，今日登上 Go 日榜第 14 名，说明社区关注度持续稳定。
uses: AI/ML 平台工程师：需要为训练任务提供 gang scheduling 和队列管理
大数据运维团队：在 K8s 上运行 Spark、Flink 等批处理作业
云原生基础设施开发者：研究或扩展 K8s 调度器能力
科研与 HPC 用户：运行 MPI、基因组学等高性能计算负载

en.tag: Kubernetes-native batch scheduling system, a CNCF project
en.what: Volcano is a Kubernetes-native batch scheduling system that extends and enhances the standard kube-scheduler. It targets batch and elastic workloads such as AI/ML/DL, bioinformatics, genomics, and big data, offering job management, queues, and fair scheduling.
en.content: The repo contains core components like the scheduler, controllers, webhooks, and the vcctl CLI, plus extensive docs, design proposals, and example configs, forming a standalone deployable Go project.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it deeply relies on Kubernetes APIs and client libraries, and integrates with frameworks like Spark, Flink, Ray, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubeflow, and MPI.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Volcano is widely adopted for AI and big data batch scheduling, with nearly 6,000 stars and a #14 spot on today's Go trending list, showing steady community interest.
uses: AI/ML platform engineers: need gang scheduling and queue management for training jobs
Big data ops teams: run Spark, Flink and other batch jobs on K8s
Cloud-native infra developers: study or extend K8s scheduler capabilities
Research and HPC users: run MPI, genomics and other high-performance workloads

zh.tag: 受 Google Zanzibar 启发的高性能细粒度授权引擎
zh.what: OpenFGA 是一个高性能、灵活的授权与权限引擎，面向开发者设计，灵感来自 Google 的 Zanzibar 论文。它通过关系型元组模型（ReBAC）统一管理应用中的访问控制，支持细粒度、可扩展的权限判断。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务端、CLI 工具、Docker 镜像与 Helm Chart，以及完整的 API、SDK 和文档。还提供 playground、迁移工具和多种数据库适配器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC/HTTP API、OpenTelemetry 可观测性，并支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等存储后端。提供多语言 SDK 与 Kubernetes Helm 部署方案。
zh.hot: 凭借 Google Zanzibar 的权威设计理念和 CNCF 沙箱项目身份，OpenFGA 在权限管理领域持续受到关注，已获 5747 颗星，今日新增 11 星，登上 Go 日榜第 15 名。
uses: 需要为 SaaS 或企业应用实现细粒度权限控制的开发者
希望从零构建或替换现有授权系统的后端团队
使用 Kubernetes 并需要标准化授权服务的平台工程师
研究 ReBAC 与 Zanzibar 模型的安全架构师

en.tag: A high-performance, flexible authorization engine inspired by Google Zanzibar
en.what: OpenFGA is a high-performance, flexible authorization and permission engine built for developers and inspired by Google Zanzibar. It uses a relationship-based access control (ReBAC) model to manage fine-grained, scalable permissions across applications.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core server, CLI, Docker images, and Helm charts, plus full APIs, SDKs, and documentation. It also includes a playground, migration tools, and adapters for multiple databases.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, it relies on gRPC/HTTP APIs, OpenTelemetry observability, and supports storage backends like PostgreSQL and MySQL. It offers multi-language SDKs and Kubernetes Helm deployment.
en.hot: With its authoritative Google Zanzibar design and CNCF sandbox status, OpenFGA keeps drawing attention in the authorization space, boasting 5,747 stars with 11 added today and ranking 15th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Developers needing fine-grained permission control for SaaS or enterprise apps
Backend teams building or replacing an authorization system from scratch
Platform engineers using Kubernetes who need a standardized authorization service
Security architects studying ReBAC and the Zanzibar model

zh.tag: 开源点对点文件持续同步工具
zh.what: Syncthing 是一款开源的持续文件同步程序，可在两台或多台计算机之间实时同步文件。它强调数据安全、安全性和易用性，无需中央服务器，通过点对点技术直接连接设备。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心同步引擎、命令行工具、Web GUI 以及 Docker 支持，并提供详细的构建指南和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库及少量第三方库，支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 8.8 万星标，因其安全、去中心化的文件同步方案而广受信赖，长期活跃于 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 个人用户在多台设备间同步文件，替代云盘服务。
团队或组织在内部网络中同步数据，确保数据私密性。
开发者利用其 API 或命令行工具集成到自动化流程中。

en.tag: Open-source P2P continuous file synchronization tool
en.what: Syncthing is an open-source continuous file synchronization program that syncs files between two or more computers in real-time. It emphasizes data safety, security, and ease of use, operating without a central server via peer-to-peer technology.
en.content: The repository includes the core sync engine, CLI tools, web GUI, Docker support, and comprehensive build guides and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on the Go standard library and a few third-party libraries, with cross-platform build support.
en.hot: With over 88k stars, it is widely trusted for its secure, decentralized file sync solution and remains consistently popular on GitHub trending.
uses: Individual users syncing files across multiple devices, replacing cloud storage services.
Teams or organizations syncing data over internal networks to ensure privacy.
Developers integrating its API or CLI into automated workflows.

zh.tag: 拓竹官方 3D 打印切片软件，支持多机型与多材料
zh.what: Bambu Studio 是拓竹科技推出的开源切片软件，把 3D 模型转成打印机可执行的 GCode。它提供项目化工作流、优化过的切片算法和易用的图形界面，也兼容其他品牌 3D 打印机。
zh.content: 仓库为完整 C++ 桌面应用源码，含切片内核、GCode 查看器、多平台构建脚本与文档目录，并发布 Windows/macOS/Linux 预编译包。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，基于 PrusaSlicer/Slic3r 演进，使用 CMake 构建，依赖 wxWidgets 等库，采用 AGPLv3 许可。
zh.hot: 作为消费级 3D 打印头部厂商的官方软件，5006 颗星并登上 C++ 日榜第一，说明桌面 3D 打印社区活跃度极高。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：用官方切片软件获得稳定打印体验
拓竹打印机用户：远程控制、监控与多材料打印
开发者：基于 AGPL 源码定制切片功能或适配新机型

en.tag: BambuLab's official slicing software for 3D printers, multi-material ready
en.what: Bambu Studio is BambuLab's open-source slicing software that turns 3D models into printer-ready GCode. It offers project-based workflows, optimized slicing algorithms, and an easy-to-use GUI, and also works with other 3D printer brands.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ desktop app source, including the slicing core, GCode viewer, multi-platform build scripts, docs, and prebuilt Windows/macOS/Linux releases.
en.stack: Primarily C++, evolved from PrusaSlicer/Slic3r, built with CMake and wxWidgets, licensed under AGPLv3.
en.hot: As the official software of a leading consumer 3D printing brand, it has 5,006 stars and tops the C++ daily trending list, showing a highly active desktop 3D printing community.
uses: 3D printing hobbyists: get reliable prints with official slicing software
BambuLab printer owners: remote control, monitoring, and multi-material printing
Developers: customize slicing features or port to new printers from the AGPL source

zh.tag: 高性能内存图数据库，为 GraphRAG 与 AI 记忆提供实时图引擎
zh.what: Memgraph 是一个用 C/C++ 编写的高性能内存图数据库，专为实时 AI 上下文与图分析设计。它把向量/文本索引与图遍历放在同一查询层，让 GraphRAG、AI 记忆和智能体工作流能在单次原子查询中完成检索与多跳扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心数据库引擎、Cypher 查询层、内置向量/文本/地理索引，以及 MAGE 算法库（40+ 图算法，含 GNN、时序图网络与嵌入）。此外还有 AI Toolkit、MCP server 和主流智能体框架集成。
zh.stack: 核心用 C/C++ 实现，兼容 Neo4j Cypher，支持 ACID 与高可用；算法库覆盖 C++、Python 和 CUDA，并提供 MCP 与智能体框架集成。
zh.hot: GraphRAG 与 AI 记忆是当前热点，Memgraph 把向量检索与图遍历统一到单次查询，切中 RAG 多系统拼装的痛点。项目已获 4491 stars，今日新增 43，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 2。
uses: 构建 GraphRAG 与知识图谱检索管线的 AI 工程师
需要为智能体提供长期记忆与结构化上下文的开发者
做实时欺诈检测、网络分析或基础设施监控的数据团队
希望用 Cypher 快速搭建图分析应用的后端工程师

en.tag: High-performance in-memory graph database powering GraphRAG and AI memory
en.what: Memgraph is a high-performance in-memory graph database built in C/C++, designed for real-time AI context and graph analytics. It combines vector/text indexes with graph traversal in a single query layer, letting GraphRAG, AI memory, and agentic workflows run retrieval and multi-hop expansion as one atomic database operation.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ core database engine, a Cypher query layer, built-in vector/text/geospatial indexes, and the MAGE algorithm library (40+ graph algorithms including GNNs, temporal graph networks, and embeddings). It also ships an AI Toolkit, MCP server, and integrations with popular agentic frameworks.
en.stack: Core is implemented in C/C++, compatible with Neo4j Cypher, ACID-compliant and highly available; the algorithm library spans C++, Python, and CUDA, with MCP and agentic framework integrations.
en.hot: GraphRAG and AI memory are hot topics, and Memgraph unifies vector search with graph traversal in one query, addressing the pain of stitching RAG across multiple systems. It has 4,491 stars with 43 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending for C++.
uses: AI engineers building GraphRAG and knowledge-graph retrieval pipelines
Developers needing long-term memory and structured context for agents
Data teams doing real-time fraud detection, network analysis, or infra monitoring
Backend engineers who want to build graph analytics apps quickly with Cypher

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 回合制末世生存游戏，程序生成世界中的硬核求生
zh.what: 这是一款回合制末世生存游戏，玩家需要在严酷且持续演化的程序生成世界中挣扎求生。它常被称作“僵尸游戏”，但实际包含搜刮、制造、载具、变异等远超僵尸题材的深度系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整 C++ 游戏源码、JSON 数据文件、多套图块素材（如 Ultica）、文档与跨平台构建脚本，并提供稳定版与实验版下载。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 编写，采用 JSON 驱动的数据定义，支持 ncurses 与 SDL 两种前端，并提供 Arch、Fedora、Debian/Ubuntu、Flatpak 等打包。
zh.hot: 作为开源硬核生存游戏的代表，它已积累 13109 颗星，今日新增 10 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 第 4 名，社区长期活跃。
uses: 喜欢硬核生存、制造与探索的玩家，可投入数百小时
想研究大型 C++ 开源游戏架构与 JSON 数据驱动设计的开发者
希望参与开源游戏贡献、翻译或模组制作的社区成员

en.tag: A turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic, procedurally generated world
en.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is a turn-based survival game set in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Often called a 'zombie game', it actually offers far deeper systems: scavenging, crafting, vehicles, mutations and more.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ game source, JSON data files, multiple tilesets such as Ultica, documentation and cross-platform build scripts, with stable and experimental downloads.
en.stack: Written in C++ with JSON-driven data definitions, supporting both ncurses and SDL frontends, and packaged for Arch, Fedora, Debian/Ubuntu and Flatpak.
en.hot: As a flagship open-source hardcore survival game, it has gathered 13,109 stars, gained 10 today and ranked 4th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, backed by a long-active community.
uses: Players who enjoy hardcore survival, crafting and exploration, easily sinking hundreds of hours
Developers studying large-scale C++ open-source game architecture and JSON-driven design
Community members wanting to contribute code, translations or mods to an open-source game

zh.tag: 用 React 构建原生应用的跨平台框架
zh.what: React Native 让你用 React 编写 Android、iOS 等平台的原生应用，JavaScript 写逻辑、原生代码负责渲染。它把 React 的声明式 UI、组件、Hooks 和 Suspense 带到移动端，同时保留原生手势、文本缩放与无障碍体验。
zh.content: 仓库是 React Native 框架的官方主仓库，包含核心 JavaScript 与 C++ 渲染层、Android/iOS 平台代码、原生模块桥接、文档与示例，以及贡献指南和社区支持文件。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 实现跨平台渲染核心，JavaScript/TypeScript 作为开发语言，依赖 React、Yoga 布局引擎、Hermes 引擎与 JSI，通过 npm 包 react-native 分发。
zh.hot: 作为移动端跨平台开发的事实标准之一，它已积累 126,540 颗星，今日再增 19 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 5，长期热度来自庞大生态与持续的平台更新。
uses: 移动端开发者：用一套 React 代码同时交付 Android 与 iOS 应用
前端团队：希望复用 React 技能栈快速切入原生 App 开发
需要原生性能与原生 UI 体验的产品，如社交、电商与工具类应用
已有原生应用想渐进式引入 React Native 进行混合开发

en.tag: A framework for building native apps with React
en.what: React Native lets you build native apps for Android, iOS and more using React, with logic written in JavaScript and rendering handled by native code. It brings React's declarative UI, components, hooks and Suspense to mobile while keeping native gestures, text scaling and accessibility.
en.content: This is the official monorepo of the React Native framework, containing the core JavaScript and C++ rendering layers, Android/iOS platform code, native module bridges, docs and examples, plus contribution guides and community support files.
en.stack: The cross-platform rendering core is written in C++, with JavaScript/TypeScript as the development language, depending on React, the Yoga layout engine, Hermes and JSI, distributed as the npm package react-native.
en.hot: As one of the de facto standards for cross-platform mobile development, it has accumulated 126,540 stars, adding 19 today and ranking 5th on the C++ daily trending list, with lasting popularity driven by its huge ecosystem and continuous platform updates.
uses: Mobile developers who want to ship Android and iOS apps from a single React codebase
Frontend teams looking to reuse their React skills to move into native app development
Products needing native performance and native UI, such as social, e-commerce and utility apps
Existing native apps that want to adopt React Native incrementally for hybrid development

zh.tag: 开源列式实时分析数据库，海量数据亚秒级查询
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为在线分析处理（OLAP）设计，能在海量数据上实时生成分析报表。它支持标准 SQL，具备极高的写入与查询吞吐能力，常用于日志、指标与事件数据的实时分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的数据库内核源码（C++ 实现）、SQL 解析与执行引擎、多种表引擎、存储与压缩模块，以及测试、文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，采用列式存储与向量化执行引擎，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 Linux、macOS 与 FreeBSD，并提供官方 Docker 镜像与云服务。
zh.hot: 作为 OLAP 领域的标杆项目，ClickHouse 已积累近 5 万 star，今日新增 39 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 6，持续受到数据工程与实时分析社区的关注。
uses: 数据工程师与分析师，用于构建实时 OLAP 报表与仪表盘
后端与平台团队，用于日志、指标和事件数据的海量存储与查询
需要替换传统数据仓库、追求高吞吐低延迟查询的企业
学习数据库内核与列式存储实现的技术爱好者

en.tag: Open-source column-oriented database for real-time analytics at scale
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system built for online analytical processing (OLAP), generating analytical reports on massive datasets in real time. It supports standard SQL and delivers extremely high write and query throughput, making it a common choice for real-time log, metric, and event analytics.
en.content: The repo contains the full database core source code in C++, including the SQL parser and execution engine, various table engines, storage and compression modules, plus tests, documentation, and build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with columnar storage and a vectorized execution engine, built via CMake, supporting Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD, with official Docker images and a managed cloud service.
en.hot: As a benchmark project in the OLAP space, ClickHouse has accumulated nearly 50k stars, gaining 39 today and ranking 6th on the C++ daily trending list, reflecting sustained interest from the data engineering and real-time analytics community.
uses: Data engineers and analysts building real-time OLAP reports and dashboards
Backend and platform teams storing and querying massive log, metric, and event data
Enterprises replacing traditional data warehouses with high-throughput, low-latency querying
Developers curious about database internals and columnar storage implementation

zh.tag: 面向M5Stack设备的WiFi安全测试工具
zh.what: Evil-M5Project 是一个为道德黑客和 WiFi 网络探索而设计的创新工具。它兼容 Cardputer、Atoms3、Fire、Core2 等 M5Stack 设备，可以在受控环境中扫描、监控和交互 WiFi 网络。该项目旨在教育目的，帮助理解网络安全和漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含针对多种 M5Stack 设备的固件源代码、SD 卡文件、图像资源和文档，主要用 C++ 编写。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖 M5Stack 硬件平台（如 ESP32），可能使用 PlatformIO 或 Arduino 框架。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有 2607 颗星，今日新增 10 颗，登上 C++ 日榜第 7 名，因其针对热门硬件 M5Stack 的 WiFi 安全测试功能而受到关注。
uses: 网络安全爱好者 —— 用于学习 WiFi 协议和漏洞。
渗透测试人员 —— 在授权环境中进行安全评估。
M5Stack 设备用户 —— 扩展设备功能进行网络探索。
教育工作者和学生 —— 作为网络安全的实践教学工具。

en.tag: WiFi security testing tool for M5Stack devices
en.what: Evil-M5Project is an innovative tool developed for ethical hacking and exploration of WiFi networks. It is compatible with Cardputer, Atoms3, Fire, Core2, and other M5Stack devices, allowing you to scan, monitor, and interact with WiFi networks in a controlled environment. The project is designed for educational purposes, aiding in understanding network security and vulnerabilities.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code for various M5Stack devices, SD card files, image resources, and documentation, primarily written in C++.
en.stack: Built with C++, relying on the M5Stack hardware platform (e.g., ESP32), possibly using PlatformIO or Arduino framework.
en.hot: With 2,607 stars and 10 new stars today, it ranks 7th on the GitHub Trending daily list for C++, gaining attention for its WiFi security testing capabilities on popular M5Stack hardware.
uses: Cybersecurity enthusiasts — for learning WiFi protocols and vulnerabilities.
Penetration testers — for security assessments in authorized environments.
M5Stack device users — to extend device capabilities for network exploration.
Educators and students — as a hands-on teaching tool for network security.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 多 GPU 集合通信优化库，实现 all-reduce 等原语
zh.what: NCCL 是 NVIDIA 开发的独立 GPU 通信库，实现了 all-reduce、all-gather、reduce、broadcast、reduce-scatter 以及任意基于发送/接收的通信模式。它针对 PCIe、NVLink、NVSwitch 以及 InfiniBand Verbs 或 TCP/IP 网络进行了优化，可在单节点或多节点上支持任意数量的 GPU。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NCCL 库的完整源代码，主要用 C++ 编写，提供构建脚本（Makefile）以生成 deb、rpm、txz 和 Python wheel 等包。测试代码单独维护在 nvidia/nccl-tests 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 CUDA 编写，依赖 CUDA 工具链进行编译。支持通过 MPI 进行多进程应用集成，并利用 NVLink、NVSwitch、InfiniBand Verbs 和 TCP/IP 套接字等底层通信技术。
zh.hot: NCCL 是 NVIDIA GPU 生态中分布式训练和推理的关键组件，随着大模型训练需求增长而备受关注。目前获得 5064 颗星，今日新增 3 颗，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 8 名。
uses: AI 框架开发者 —— 集成 NCCL 以实现多 GPU 并行训练和推理。
高性能计算工程师 —— 优化跨节点 GPU 通信性能。
系统管理员 —— 在集群中部署和调优 NCCL 以支持大规模 AI 工作负载。
研究人员 —— 研究 GPU 通信原语和分布式算法。

en.tag: NVIDIA's optimized library for multi-GPU collective communication primitives
en.what: NCCL is a stand-alone library from NVIDIA for GPU communication, implementing all-reduce, all-gather, reduce, broadcast, reduce-scatter, and any send/receive based communication pattern. It is optimized for high bandwidth on PCIe, NVLink, NVSwitch, and networks using InfiniBand Verbs or TCP/IP sockets, supporting arbitrary numbers of GPUs in single or multi-node setups.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the NCCL library, primarily written in C++, with build scripts (Makefiles) to produce deb, rpm, txz, and Python wheel packages. Tests are maintained separately in the nvidia/nccl-tests repository.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and CUDA, requiring the CUDA toolkit for compilation. It supports integration with MPI for multi-process applications and leverages low-level communication technologies such as NVLink, NVSwitch, InfiniBand Verbs, and TCP/IP sockets.
en.hot: NCCL is a critical component in NVIDIA's GPU ecosystem for distributed training and inference, gaining attention as demand for large model training grows. It currently has 5,064 stars, with 3 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list.
uses: AI framework developers — integrate NCCL for multi-GPU parallel training and inference.
HPC engineers — optimize cross-node GPU communication performance.
System administrators — deploy and tune NCCL in clusters for large-scale AI workloads.
Researchers — study GPU communication primitives and distributed algorithms.

zh.tag: 多用途模拟框架，保存数十年软件历史
zh.what: MAME 是一个多用途的模拟框架，旨在通过记录硬件及其工作原理来保存数十年的软件历史。它最初是街机模拟器，现已涵盖大量（主要是复古的）计算机、游戏机和计算器。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 MAME 源代码、构建系统（支持 make 和 Windows 项目）、文档、CI 配置以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SDL2 等库，支持跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为经典的开源模拟器项目，持续维护且拥有庞大社区，今日新增 4 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。
uses: 复古游戏爱好者：在 PC 上重温街机、家用机等经典游戏。
软件历史研究者：通过模拟器了解早期硬件和软件的工作原理。
开发者：学习大型 C++ 项目的架构与跨平台构建。

en.tag: Multi-purpose emulation framework preserving decades of software history
en.what: MAME is a multi-purpose emulation framework that aims to preserve decades of software history by documenting hardware and how it functions. Originally an arcade emulator, it now covers a wide variety of vintage computers, consoles, and calculators.
en.content: The repository contains the full MAME source code, build system (make and Windows projects), documentation, CI configurations, and community links.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, relies on SDL2 and other libraries, cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: As a classic open-source emulator with active maintenance and a large community, it gained 4 stars today, ranking #3 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Retro gaming fans: replay classic arcade and console games on PC.
Software history researchers: understand early hardware and software through emulation.
Developers: learn architecture and cross-platform build from a large C++ project.

zh.tag: 以太坊智能合约的官方编程语言与编译器
zh.what: Solidity 是一门静态类型、面向合约的高级编程语言，用于在以太坊虚拟机上编写智能合约。它让开发者可以实现代币、所有权、投票等去中心化逻辑，由 Solidity 编译器编译为 EVM 字节码后部署运行。
zh.content: 仓库是 Solidity 编译器的官方源码，包含编译器各阶段实现、标准库、测试套件、文档与构建脚本，并附带 Hello World、投票、盲拍等示例合约。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，依赖 Boost、CMake 等构建工具，可编译为原生二进制或 Emscripten/WASM 版本，配套 solc-js 与 Remix 等工具链。
zh.hot: 作为以太坊生态最核心的语言实现，Solidity 拥有约 2.57 万 star，今日仍登上 C++ 日榜第 10，说明智能合约开发者的持续关注与稳定需求。
uses: 区块链与智能合约开发者，用于编写和编译部署在 EVM 上的合约
安全审计与研究人员，分析编译器行为与合约漏洞
编译器/语言爱好者，研究静态类型语言与字节码生成实现
Web3 教学与原型开发，配合 Remix 快速上手 Solidity

en.tag: The official smart contract programming language and compiler for Ethereum
en.what: Solidity is a statically-typed, contract-oriented high-level language for writing smart contracts that run on the Ethereum Virtual Machine. It lets developers implement tokens, ownership, voting and other decentralized logic, compiled by the Solidity compiler into EVM bytecode for deployment.
en.content: The repo hosts the official Solidity compiler source, including compiler stages, standard library, test suites, docs and build scripts, plus sample contracts like Hello World, Voting and Blind Auction.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with Boost and CMake, buildable as native binaries or Emscripten/WASM, and paired with tooling such as solc-js and Remix.
en.hot: As the core language implementation of the Ethereum ecosystem, Solidity has about 25.7k stars and still ranks 10th on the daily C++ trending list, reflecting steady demand and attention from smart contract developers.
uses: Blockchain and smart contract developers writing and compiling contracts for the EVM
Security auditors and researchers analyzing compiler behavior and contract vulnerabilities
Compiler and language enthusiasts studying statically-typed language and bytecode generation
Web3 educators and prototypers using Remix to quickly get started with Solidity

zh.tag: 开源计算机视觉库，图像与视频处理的行业标准
zh.what: OpenCV 是一个跨平台的开源计算机视觉与机器学习库，提供图像处理、视频分析、特征检测、目标识别等数千个优化算法。它支持 C++、Python、Java 等多语言接口，可在桌面、服务器、移动端和嵌入式设备上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心模块（core、imgproc、video、dnn、calib3d 等）、构建脚本、测试与文档；扩展功能（如 contrib 模块、SIFT 等）位于配套仓库 opencv_contrib。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 编写，提供 Python、Java、MATLAB 等绑定；依赖 CMake 构建，可选 CUDA、OpenCL、IPP、TBB 等加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为计算机视觉领域的基石项目，OpenCV 已积累 90,777 颗星，今日再增 18 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 11 名，持续受益于 AI 视觉应用的普及。
uses: 计算机视觉与机器人方向的学生和研究者，用于课程实验与算法原型验证
AI 工程师在目标检测、图像分割等项目中做预处理与后处理
嵌入式与移动端开发者，在边缘设备上部署实时视觉功能
需要快速搭建图像/视频处理流水线的软件团队

en.tag: The open-source computer vision library, the industry standard for image and video processing
en.what: OpenCV is a cross-platform open-source computer vision and machine learning library offering thousands of optimized algorithms for image processing, video analysis, feature detection and object recognition. It provides bindings for C++, Python, Java and more, running on desktop, server, mobile and embedded devices.
en.content: The repo contains core modules (core, imgproc, video, dnn, calib3d, etc.), build scripts, tests and docs; extra functionality such as contrib modules and SIFT lives in the companion opencv_contrib repository.
en.stack: Written in C++ with Python, Java and MATLAB bindings; built with CMake and optionally accelerated by CUDA, OpenCL, IPP and TBB.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of computer vision, OpenCV has accumulated 90,777 stars, gaining 18 more today and ranking 11th on the C++ daily trending list, fueled by the spread of AI vision applications.
uses: Students and researchers in computer vision and robotics for coursework and algorithm prototyping
AI engineers doing preprocessing and postprocessing in detection and segmentation projects
Embedded and mobile developers deploying real-time vision on edge devices
Software teams needing to quickly build image and video processing pipelines

zh.tag: Telegram 官方桌面客户端完整源码
zh.what: 这是 Telegram 官方桌面客户端的完整源代码和构建说明，基于 Telegram API 和 MTProto 安全协议。它提供了 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上的原生桌面体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含客户端全部源码、构建脚本、第三方依赖和 CI 配置，支持多平台编译。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架（Qt 6 和 Qt 5.15），依赖 OpenSSL、WebRTC、zlib 等库。
zh.hot: 作为官方客户端，拥有 32,879 颗星，今日新增 11 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 第 12 名，持续受到关注。
uses: C++/Qt 开发者——学习大型跨平台桌面应用架构与实现
Telegram 用户——获取官方客户端或自行编译定制版本
安全研究人员——审计 MTProto 协议实现与客户端安全性
开源贡献者——参与官方客户端开发与问题修复

en.tag: Official Telegram Desktop client source code
en.what: This is the complete source code and build instructions for the official Telegram desktop client, based on the Telegram API and MTProto secure protocol. It provides native desktop experiences on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repository contains the full client source code, build scripts, third-party dependencies, and CI configurations, supporting multi-platform compilation.

Telegram users — get the official client or compile a customized version
Security researchers — audit MTProto protocol implementation and client security
Open-source contributors — participate in official client development and bug fixes

zh.tag: 微软官方 WSL 仓库，在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 工具链
zh.what: WSL 是微软提供的 Windows 子系统，让用户无需传统虚拟机或双系统，就能直接在 Windows 上原封不动地运行 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序。只需在 Windows 命令行执行 wsl --install 即可安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源码、开发者文档（doc/docs/dev-loop.md）、贡献指南、行为准则、隐私与遥测说明（DATA_AND_PRIVACY.md）以及品牌图片资源，并链接到 WSL2-Linux-Kernel、WSLg 和文档仓库。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主要实现语言，深度依赖 Windows 内核与虚拟化能力，并配套 Linux 内核（WSL2-Linux-Kernel）和 GUI 支持组件 WSLg。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方核心项目，WSL 已积累 33,659 颗 star，今日仍新增 14 星并登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 13 名，说明 Windows 开发者对原生 Linux 环境的持续刚需。
uses: Windows 开发者：需要 Linux 命令行工具却不想装虚拟机或双系统
运维与 DevOps 工程师：在 Windows 上调试脚本、容器与部署流程
数据科学与 AI 开发者：在 Windows 主机上跑 Linux 生态的 Python/CUDA 工具链
学生与教学场景：低成本学习 Linux 命令与开发环境

en.tag: Microsoft's official WSL repo: run Linux tooling natively on Windows
en.what: WSL is Microsoft's Windows Subsystem for Linux, letting you run unmodified Linux command-line tools, utilities and apps directly on Windows without a traditional VM or dual-boot setup. You can install it right away by running wsl --install in a Windows command line.
en.content: The repo holds WSL source code, developer docs (doc/docs/dev-loop.md), a contributor guide, code of conduct, privacy/telemetry notes (DATA_AND_PRIVACY.md) and branding images, plus links to the WSL2-Linux-Kernel, WSLg and docs repositories.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, deeply integrated with the Windows kernel and virtualization stack, paired with the shipped Linux kernel (WSL2-Linux-Kernel) and the WSLg GUI component.
en.hot: As a core Microsoft project, WSL has accumulated 33,659 stars, still gaining 14 today and ranking 13th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, reflecting steady demand from Windows developers for a native Linux environment.
uses: Windows developers who need Linux CLI tools without a VM or dual boot
Ops and DevOps engineers debugging scripts, containers and deploy flows on Windows
Data science and AI developers running Linux-based Python/CUDA toolchains on a Windows host
Students and educators seeking a low-cost Linux command-line learning environment

zh.tag: 可扩展的分布式对象、块与文件存储系统
zh.what: Ceph 是一个统一的分布式存储平台，提供对象、块和文件三种存储接口。它通过 CRUSH 算法实现去中心化数据分布，支持大规模扩展和高可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ceph 核心组件（MON、OSD、MDS、MGR）的 C++ 源码，以及构建脚本、测试套件和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake、Ninja 构建系统，以及 Boost、RocksDB 等库。
zh.hot: 作为开源分布式存储的标杆，Ceph 拥有 17k+ stars，今日新增 7 星，持续受到存储领域关注。
uses: 云平台和私有云构建者，需要统一存储后端
企业 IT 团队，寻求可扩展的块、对象和文件存储解决方案
存储工程师和开发者，研究分布式存储系统实现

en.tag: Scalable distributed object, block, and file storage system
en.what: Ceph is a unified distributed storage platform offering object, block, and file storage interfaces. It uses the CRUSH algorithm for decentralized data distribution, enabling massive scalability and high availability.
en.content: The repository contains C++ source code for core Ceph components (MON, OSD, MDS, MGR), along with build scripts, test suites, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with CMake and Ninja build systems, and dependencies like Boost and RocksDB.
en.hot: As a benchmark in open-source distributed storage, Ceph has 17k+ stars with 7 added today, maintaining steady interest in the storage community.
uses: Cloud platform and private cloud builders needing a unified storage backend
Enterprise IT teams seeking scalable block, object, and file storage solutions
Storage engineers and developers studying distributed storage system implementations

zh.tag: 在ARM64 Linux上快速运行x86/x86-64程序的用户态模拟器
zh.what: FEX允许你在ARM64 Linux设备上运行x86应用程序，类似于qemu-user和box64。它广泛兼容32位和64位二进制文件，并可与Wine/Proton配合玩Windows游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含FEX模拟器的源代码，主要用C++编写，并提供文档如源码大纲和中文README。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++开发，依赖ARMv8.0+硬件，支持多种Linux发行版如Arch、Fedora、openSUSE、Ubuntu。
zh.hot: FEX在GitHub上拥有7934颗星，今日新增8颗，登上C++日榜第15名，因其在ARM64上高效运行x86程序的能力而受到关注。
uses: ARM64 Linux用户想要运行x86应用程序或游戏
开发者需要在ARM设备上测试x86软件兼容性
游戏玩家希望通过Wine/Proton在ARM设备上玩Windows游戏

en.tag: A fast usermode x86 and x86-64 emulator for Arm64 Linux
en.what: FEX allows you to run x86 applications on ARM64 Linux devices, similar to qemu-user and box64. It offers broad compatibility with both 32-bit and 64-bit binaries, and it can be used alongside Wine/Proton to play Windows games.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of the FEX emulator, primarily written in C++, along with documentation such as a source outline and a Chinese README.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, requires ARMv8.0+ hardware, and supports various Linux distributions such as Arch, Fedora, openSUSE, and Ubuntu.
en.hot: FEX has 7,934 stars on GitHub, with 8 new stars today, ranking 15th on the C++ daily trending list, gaining attention for its ability to efficiently run x86 programs on ARM64.
uses: ARM64 Linux users who want to run x86 applications or games
Developers who need to test x86 software compatibility on ARM devices
Gamers who want to play Windows games on ARM devices via Wine/Proton

zh.tag: 实验性 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，跨平台运行 PSV 游戏与自制程序
zh.what: Vita3K 是一个实验性的 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android 四大平台。它能够运行大多数自制程序以及部分商业游戏，让玩家在 PC 和手机上重温 PSV 经典作品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源码（C++ 实现），以及兼容性列表、构建脚本、CI 配置和 README 中的游戏截图展示（如《女神异闻录4 黄金版》《VA-11 HALL-A》）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Unicorn 等外部库，采用 GPLv2 许可证；支持 OpenGL/Vulkan 渲染，并针对 Android 提供 Adreno 驱动适配。
zh.hot: 作为少有的开源 PSV 模拟器，Vita3K 已积累 5701 颗星，今日新增 5 星并登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 16 名，持续吸引着模拟器爱好者和 PSV 玩家的关注。
uses: 想在 PC 或手机上重温 PSV 经典游戏的玩家
对游戏机模拟器开发感兴趣的技术研究者
需要测试自制程序兼容性的 PSV 自制软件开发者
希望为开源模拟器项目贡献代码的 C++ 开发者

en.tag: Experimental PlayStation Vita emulator running PSV games and homebrew cross-platform
en.what: Vita3K is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android. It can run most homebrew programs and a growing number of commercial games, letting players revisit PS Vita titles on PC and mobile.
en.content: The repo contains the full emulator source code in C++, plus compatibility lists, build scripts, CI configuration, and README screenshots of games like Persona 4 Golden and VA-11 HALL-A.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on external libraries such as Unicorn, licensed under GPLv2; supports OpenGL/Vulkan rendering and includes Adreno driver support for Android.
en.hot: As one of the few open-source PS Vita emulators, Vita3K has gathered 5,701 stars, gained 5 today, and ranked 16th on GitHub Trending's C++ daily list, continuously drawing attention from emulator enthusiasts and PS Vita fans.
uses: Players who want to revisit classic PS Vita games on PC or mobile
Technical researchers interested in console emulator development
PS Vita homebrew developers testing compatibility of their programs
C++ developers looking to contribute to an open-source emulator project

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 面向真实工程实践的轻量可组合 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是 Matt Pocock 日常使用的 AI 代理技能（skills）集合，面向真实软件开发而非“氛围编程”。它刻意保持小而可改、可组合，兼容任意模型，并基于多年工程经验沉淀。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本形式的技能文件为主，放在 .agents 目录下，包含安装说明、ADR 决策记录，以及通过 Claude Code 插件或 skills.sh 分发的技能集合。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 脚本为核心，依赖 Claude Code 插件市场与 npx skills 安装器，可搭配 Codex 等任意编码代理使用。
zh.hot: 本周新增 13143 星、总数超 25 万，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 5；在 AI 代理技能热潮中，它以“反框架、可掌控”的定位吸引大量工程师关注。
uses: 希望用 AI 代理做真实工程而非氛围编程的开发者
想按自己需求改造、组合代理技能的高级工程师
在 Claude Code、Codex 等代理间切换、追求模型无关方案的用户

en.tag: Small, composable agent skills for real engineering, not vibe coding
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills Matt Pocock uses daily for real software engineering rather than vibe coding. They are intentionally small, easy to adapt, composable, model-agnostic, and grounded in decades of engineering experience.
en.content: The repo mainly contains Shell-based skill files under the .agents directory, plus installation docs, ADR decision records, and skills distributed via the Claude Code plugin or skills.sh.
en.stack: Built around Shell scripts, relying on the Claude Code plugin marketplace and the npx skills installer, and usable with any coding agent such as Codex.
en.hot: It gained 13,143 stars this week, surpassing 257k total and ranking 5th on GitHub Trending weekly; amid the AI agent skills boom, its anti-framework, stay-in-control positioning draws heavy engineer interest.
uses: Developers who want AI agents for real engineering, not vibe coding
Senior engineers who want to fork, adapt, and compose agent skills themselves
Users switching between Claude Code, Codex, and other agents who need a model-agnostic setup

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，可通过 skills CLI 或手动安装到任何支持技能指令的代理框架中。支持全局或项目级安装，并可作为 Claude Code 插件使用。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 技能文件，无外部依赖，可在任何支持技能指令的代理框架中运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1504 星，总星数 31573，排名 Python 周榜第 16。因其解决了 AI 写作“一眼假”的痛点，且安装使用极其简单，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 将 AI 草稿润色为自然的人类风格，避免被检测
开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 自我进化的 AI 代理，跨平台、跨会话持续学习
zh.what: Hermes Agent 是一款由 Nous Research 构建的自我进化 AI 代理，内置学习循环，能从经验中创建技能、在应用中改进技能，并持续构建用户模型。它支持在多种平台（Telegram、Discord、Slack 等）和多种模型提供商之间无缝运行，且不锁定特定环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理代码库、终端 TUI 界面、跨平台网关、技能创建与改进机制、记忆管理、定时自动化（cron）、以及多语言 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖包括 FTS5 搜索、LLM 集成（支持 Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等）、以及 Honcho 用户建模库。
zh.hot: 凭借 24 万+ 星标和日增 774 星，其独特的自我改进学习循环和跨平台、跨会话的持久记忆能力引发了广泛关注，成为 AI 代理领域的热门项目。
uses: 开发者和 AI 爱好者希望部署一个能自主学习和适应用户行为的个人 AI 代理。
需要跨平台（如 Telegram、Discord）与 AI 交互并保持对话连续性的团队或个人。
研究者探索代理记忆、技能自动化和用户建模等前沿方向。

en.tag: Self-improving AI agent that learns from experience across sessions and platforms
en.what: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research, featuring a built-in learning loop that creates skills from experience, improves them during use, and builds a deepening model of the user. It runs seamlessly across platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.) and model providers without lock-in.
en.content: The repository contains the full agent codebase, a terminal TUI, cross-platform gateway, skill creation and improvement mechanisms, memory management, scheduled automations (cron), and multilingual READMEs and docs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with dependencies on FTS5 search, LLM integrations (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.), and the Honcho user modeling library.
en.hot: With over 240K stars and 774 stars added today, its unique self-improving learning loop and persistent cross-session memory have captured attention, making it a trending project in the AI agent space.
uses: Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a personal AI agent that autonomously learns and adapts to user behavior.
Teams or individuals needing cross-platform AI interaction (e.g., Telegram, Discord) with conversation continuity.
Researchers exploring cutting-edge topics like agent memory, skill automation, and user modeling.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程助手直接操控 Chrome 的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: chrome-devtools-mcp 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor、Copilot）实时控制并检查 Chrome 浏览器。它提供性能洞察、高级调试和可靠自动化能力，并附带 CLI 供非 MCP 场景使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器实现、CLI 工具、文档（工具参考、故障排除、设计原则等）以及贡献指南。核心功能包括性能追踪、网络请求分析、截图和 console 消息检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 puppeteer 实现浏览器自动化，依赖 Chrome DevTools 前端进行性能追踪，并集成 Google CrUX API 获取真实用户体验数据。
zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ star 成为 AI 代理工具链的明星项目，本周新增 738 star 登上 TypeScript 周榜。它让 AI 编程助手获得浏览器级调试能力，极大提升自动化与排错效率。
uses: AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor）需要自动化浏览器操作或调试前端代码的开发者
需要分析网页性能、网络请求和 console 错误的 QA 或性能工程师
希望为自定义 AI 工作流集成浏览器控制能力的 MCP 用户
对 Chrome DevTools 自动化感兴趣，想扩展其能力的开发者

en.tag: MCP server that lets coding agents control and inspect Chrome
en.what: chrome-devtools-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets coding agents (like Claude, Cursor, Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It provides performance insights, advanced debugging, and reliable automation, with a CLI for non-MCP use.
en.content: The repo contains the MCP server implementation, a CLI, docs (tool reference, troubleshooting, design principles), and contributing guidelines. Key features include performance tracing, network analysis, screenshots, and console message inspection.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses puppeteer for browser automation, leverages Chrome DevTools frontend for performance tracing, and integrates Google CrUX API for real-user experience data.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars, it's a star in the AI agent toolchain, gaining 738 stars this week and ranking #18 on TypeScript weekly. It gives coding agents browser-level debugging, boosting automation and troubleshooting efficiency.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to automate browser tasks or debug frontend code
QA or performance engineers needing to analyze page performance, network requests, and console errors
MCP users who want to integrate browser control into custom AI workflows
Developers interested in extending Chrome DevTools automation capabilities

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂

zh.tag: 模块化可复用的编译器与工具链基础设施
