zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: Windows 桌面环境深度定制工具
zh.what: Seelen UI 是一个 Windows 桌面环境替代品，不是主题包或皮肤，而是对桌面外观和交互的彻底重构。用户可替换任务栏、Dock、应用启动器、窗口管理器、通知中心、虚拟桌面等所有日常元素，并通过 CSS/JSON 主题引擎和插件系统实现个性化。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面环境源代码，包括主题引擎、插件系统、文档、截图和安装包配置。支持 70+ 语言，提供 Microsoft Store 下载和 Discord 社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，利用 Windows API 和 Web 技术（如 CSS/JSON）进行主题定制。
zh.hot: 凭借 17.7k stars 和今日新增 15 星，Seelen UI 在 Rust 趋势榜排名第 6。其高度可定制性和深度 Windows 集成吸引了追求个性化桌面的用户。
uses: Windows 用户希望完全定制桌面外观和交互，从任务栏到窗口管理器。
开发者或高级用户想要通过 CSS/JSON 主题和插件系统扩展桌面功能。
追求极简或高效工作流的人士，需要可定制的虚拟桌面和窗口布局。

en.tag: Fully customizable desktop environment for Windows 10/11
en.what: Seelen UI is a full desktop environment replacement for Windows, not a theme pack or skin, but a complete rethink of how your desktop looks and works. Every element you interact with daily—taskbar, dock, app launcher, window manager, notification flyouts, virtual desktops—can be replaced, restyled, and extended to match your vision and workflow.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop environment, including theming engine, plugin system, documentation, screenshots, and installer configurations. It supports 70+ languages and provides Microsoft Store download and Discord community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, leveraging Windows APIs and web technologies (CSS/JSON) for theming and customization.
en.hot: With 17.7k stars and 15 new stars today, Seelen UI ranks #6 on the Rust trending list. Its high customizability and deep Windows integration attract users seeking personalized desktops.
uses: Windows users who want to fully customize their desktop appearance and interaction, from taskbar to window manager.
Developers or power users who want to extend desktop functionality via CSS/JSON themes and plugin system.
People seeking minimal or efficient workflows with customizable virtual desktops and window layouts.

zh.tag: 跨平台局域网鼠标键盘共享，开源软件 KVM
zh.what: Lan Mouse 是一款跨平台的鼠标键盘共享软件，类似苹果的 Universal Control，让你用一套键鼠同时操控多台电脑，也就是软件 KVM 切换器。目标是成为 Synergy、Share Mouse 等商业工具的开源替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的跨平台客户端与服务端代码，支持 GTK 前端界面，并配有 CI、Cachix、Release 等 GitHub Actions 工作流。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，网络流量通过 WebRTC.rs 提供的 DTLS 实现加密，前端基于 GTK。
zh.hot: 本周新增 48 star，总 star 达 5253，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 7 名；Rust 带来的高性能与跨平台特性，加上对 Synergy 等付费工具的开源替代需求，让它持续受到关注。
uses: 需要一套键鼠控制多台电脑的多设备用户
希望替代 Synergy 等商业软件 KVM 的用户
使用 GNOME、KDE、Sway、Hyprland 等 Linux 桌面的开发者
关注 Rust 跨平台网络与输入模拟实现的技术爱好者

en.tag: Cross-platform LAN mouse & keyboard sharing, an open-source software KVM
en.what: Lan Mouse is a cross-platform mouse and keyboard sharing tool, similar to Apple's Universal Control, letting you control multiple PCs with a single set of peripherals — a software KVM switch. It aims to be an open-source alternative to proprietary tools like Synergy and Share Mouse.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust implementation of the cross-platform client and server, a GTK frontend, plus CI, Cachix and Release GitHub Actions workflows.
en.stack: Written in Rust, with network traffic encrypted via the DTLS implementation from WebRTC.rs, and a GTK-based frontend.
en.hot: It gained 48 stars this week for a total of 5,253, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust chart; Rust's performance and cross-platform nature, plus demand for an open-source alternative to paid tools like Synergy, keep it in the spotlight.
uses: Multi-device users who want one keyboard and mouse for several computers
Users looking to replace commercial KVM tools like Synergy
Linux desktop users on GNOME, KDE, Sway, Hyprland and more
Developers curious about Rust cross-platform networking and input emulation

zh.tag: 一站式下载器：课程、视频、音乐、书籍，无需命令行
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，支持从 Udemy、Hotmart、YouTube 等 1800+ 网站下载课程、视频、音乐和电子书。内置播放器、PDF/EPUB 阅读器和音乐库，所有文件保存在本地，无需命令行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 后端、Svelte/Tauri 前端、桌面安装包及多语言 README。提供图形界面、快捷键下载、内置播放器等功能，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，使用 Svelte 作为前端框架，依赖 yt-dlp 进行下载。
zh.hot: 今日新增 102 星，总星数达 9480，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）排名第 10。其精准的 SEO 标签策略使其在多个下载器细分领域（如课程下载、YouTube 下载）中排名第一，吸引了大量用户。
uses: 在线学习者：需要下载 Udemy、Hotmart 等平台的付费课程以便离线观看。
内容创作者：希望保存 YouTube、TikTok 等平台的视频素材用于二次创作。
音乐与书籍爱好者：想要下载音乐和电子书并在应用内管理阅读。
技术小白：希望无需命令行即可轻松下载网络资源。

en.tag: All-in-one downloader for courses, videos, music & books — no terminal needed
en.what: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads courses, videos, music, and books from 1,800+ sites including Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It features a built-in player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library, keeping all files on your computer with no terminal required.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust backend, Svelte/Tauri frontend, desktop installers, and multilingual READMEs. It offers a GUI, hotkey downloads, built-in player, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri, using Svelte for the frontend, and powered by yt-dlp for downloads.
en.hot: Gained 102 stars today, reaching 9,480 total, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily. Its strategic SEO tagging makes it #1 in niche downloader categories (e.g., course-downloader, youtube-downloader), driving significant attention.
uses: Online learners who need to download paid courses from Udemy, Hotmart, etc. for offline viewing.
Content creators who want to save videos from YouTube, TikTok, etc. for remixing or reference.
Music and book enthusiasts who wish to download media and manage them within the app.
Non-technical users who prefer a GUI over command-line tools for downloading online content.

zh.tag: 超高效消息流平台，Rust 实现，主打极速与持久化
zh.what: Apache Iggy 是一个用 Rust 编写的持久化消息流平台，旨在提供极致的性能和效率。它支持流、主题、分区和消费者组，可实现高吞吐、低延迟的消息传递，并具备数据持久化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心服务器、命令行客户端（iggy-cli）、多种语言的 SDK（Rust、JavaScript、Python、Java、.NET），以及示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 Tokio 异步运行时，支持 TCP 和 QUIC 传输协议，并利用 Sled 或内存存储作为持久化后端。
zh.hot: 本周新增 194 星，总星数达 4792，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第一。其“激光速度”的定位和 Apache 背书吸引了大量关注，且多语言 SDK 降低了使用门槛。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟消息传递的实时数据管道和事件驱动架构。
作为微服务间通信的可靠消息中间件，替代 Kafka 或 RabbitMQ 的轻量级选择。
对数据持久化和流处理有严格要求的物联网、金融或游戏后端场景。

en.tag: Hyper-efficient persistent message streaming platform in Rust, laser-fast
en.what: Apache Iggy is a persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, designed for extreme performance and efficiency. It supports streams, topics, partitions, and consumer groups, enabling high-throughput, low-latency messaging with data persistence.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core server, a CLI client (iggy-cli), SDKs for multiple languages (Rust, JavaScript, Python, Java, .NET), plus examples and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Tokio async runtime, supports TCP and QUIC transport protocols, and uses Sled or in-memory storage for persistence.
en.hot: Gained 194 stars this week, reaching 4,792 total, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending Rust weekly. Its 'laser speed' positioning and Apache backing attract attention, and multi-language SDKs lower the adoption barrier.
uses: Real-time data pipelines and event-driven architectures requiring high throughput and low latency.
A lightweight alternative to Kafka or RabbitMQ for reliable messaging between microservices.
IoT, financial, or gaming backends with strict requirements for data persistence and stream processing.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的极速 Python 代码检查与格式化工具
zh.what: Ruff 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Python 静态检查（linter）与代码格式化工具，目标是比 Flake8、Black 等现有工具快 10-100 倍。它把 lint、import 排序、格式化等多种功能整合到单一接口下，可作为多个工具的一体化替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的 lint 与格式化核心引擎、900 多条内置规则、Python 绑定与 pip 安装包，以及 VS Code 等编辑器集成和文档、Playground。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，通过 PyPI 以 pip 安装，支持 pyproject.toml 配置，兼容 Python 3.14，并提供 VS Code 等编辑器插件。
zh.hot: 近 5 万 star 且本周仍新增 129，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 11 名，说明其极速性能与一体化替代方案持续吸引 Python 社区关注。
uses: Python 开发者用它在 CI 和本地快速完成代码检查与格式化
团队希望用单一工具替代 Flake8、Black、isort 等多个工具链
大型 monorepo 项目需要分层配置与缓存加速的场景
编辑器用户通过 VS Code 插件获得实时 lint 与自动修复

en.tag: An extremely fast Python linter and formatter written in Rust
en.what: Ruff is a Python linter and code formatter written in Rust, aiming to be 10-100x faster than existing tools like Flake8 and Black. It consolidates linting, import sorting, and formatting into a single unified interface, serving as a drop-in replacement for multiple tools.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust-based linting and formatting engine, over 900 built-in rules, Python bindings and a pip-installable package, plus editor integrations like VS Code, docs, and a playground.
en.stack: Core is written in Rust, distributed via PyPI for pip install, supports pyproject.toml configuration, is compatible with Python 3.14, and offers editor plugins like VS Code.
en.hot: With nearly 50k stars and 129 added this week, it ranks 11th on the GitHub Trending Rust weekly chart, showing its speed and all-in-one replacement appeal keep drawing Python community attention.
uses: Python developers wanting fast linting and formatting in CI and locally
Teams looking to replace Flake8, Black, isort and more with one tool
Large monorepo projects needing hierarchical config and caching
Editor users getting real-time lint and auto-fix via the VS Code plugin

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编程工具的 AI 技能统一管理桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一个轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 代理的技能（skills），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 多种编程工具。它提供一个集中的技能库，用户可以从 Git 仓库、本地文件夹、压缩包或 skills.sh 市场安装技能，并支持全局、代理、项目等多种工作区。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，提供技能库、市场浏览、全局/代理/项目工作区、备份与多设备同步等功能，并配有界面截图和概念图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架，依赖 Git 和文件系统操作，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 228 星，总星数达 4283，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 13 名。AI 编程工具激增，跨工具管理技能的需求旺盛，该应用填补了这一空白。
uses: AI 编程工具用户：统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的技能，避免重复配置。
开发者团队：通过备份与多设备同步，确保团队成员技能配置一致。
技能开发者：在市场中发布技能，并利用工作区测试和部署。

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified skill library, allowing users to install skills from Git repos, local folders, archives, or the skills.sh marketplace, with support for global, agent, and project workspaces.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with UI screenshots and a concept map.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar framework, with dependencies on Git and file system operations, supporting cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 228 stars this week, reaching 4,283 total, and ranked #13 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly. With the proliferation of AI coding tools, the need to manage skills across tools is high, and this app fills that gap.
uses: AI coding tool users: centrally manage skills for Claude Code, Cursor, etc., avoiding duplicate configurations.
Development teams: ensure consistent skill configurations across members via backup and multi-device sync.
Skill developers: publish skills to the marketplace and use workspaces for testing and deployment.

zh.tag: Git 兼容、简单强大的版本控制系统
zh.what: Jujutsu 是一款为软件项目设计的版本控制系统，旨在简化代码复制、变更跟踪和发布流程。它从底层设计上就注重易用性，无论新手还是经验丰富的开发者，都能轻松上手。其独特之处在于将用户界面和版本控制算法与存储系统解耦，从而支持多种后端存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Jujutsu 源代码、文档、安装指南、教程和开发路线图。项目使用 Rust 编写，并包含用于构建和测试的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Git 作为存储层，但扩展了自定义存储以保存书签等元数据。
zh.hot: 本周新增 185 颗星，总星数达 31,429，在 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）中位列第 13。其 Git 兼容性和创新的设计吸引了大量关注。
uses: 适合希望简化版本控制工作流的开发者，尤其是那些对 Git 复杂性感到困扰的用户。
适用于需要与现有 Git 工具链兼容，同时探索更高效 VCS 理念的团队。
对于研究版本控制系统的学生和研究者，Jujutsu 提供了独特的架构参考。

en.tag: A Git-compatible VCS that is both simple and powerful
en.what: Jujutsu is a version control system for software projects, designed to simplify copying code, tracking changes, and publishing changes. It is built from the ground up to be easy to use for both novices and experienced developers. Its key innovation is decoupling the user interface and version control algorithms from storage systems, enabling multiple backends.
en.content: The repository contains the full Jujutsu source code, documentation, installation guides, tutorials, and a development roadmap. The project is written in Rust and includes build and test configurations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it uses Git repositories as a storage layer but extends with custom storage for bookmarks and other metadata.
en.hot: With 185 new stars this week and a total of 31,429, it ranks #13 on the GitHub Trending weekly (Rust). Its Git compatibility and innovative design have attracted significant attention.
uses: For developers seeking a simplified version control workflow, especially those frustrated by Git's complexity.
For teams needing compatibility with existing Git tools while exploring more efficient VCS concepts.
For students and researchers studying version control systems, Jujutsu offers a unique architectural reference.

zh.tag: 基于 Nix 的快速声明式开发环境工具
zh.what: devenv 是一个基于 Nix 的开发环境管理工具，提供快速、声明式、可复现且可组合的开发环境。它通过简单的配置文件定义语言、包和服务，并自动处理依赖和构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含 devenv 的 Rust 实现、命令行工具、终端 UI、LSP 支持，以及用于定义环境的 devenv.nix 模块系统。还提供丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，底层依赖 Nix 和 Nixpkgs，支持 Linux、macOS 及 WSL2，集成 nixd 提供 LSP。
zh.hot: 凭借 Nix 生态的可靠性和 devenv 的易用性，star 数已达 7594，今日新增 41，登上 Rust 日榜第 10 名。
uses: 开发者希望用声明式配置快速搭建可复现的开发环境，避免手动安装依赖。
团队需要统一开发环境，确保所有成员使用一致的工具链和版本。
使用 Nix 但想要更友好、更快速体验的用户，可借助 devenv 简化配置。

en.tag: Fast, declarative developer environments powered by Nix
en.what: devenv is a Nix-based tool for managing developer environments that are fast, declarative, reproducible, and composable. It defines languages, packages, and services via a simple config file, handling dependencies and builds automatically.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust implementation, CLI, terminal UI, LSP support, and the devenv.nix module system for defining environments, along with extensive docs and examples.
en.stack: Written in Rust, built on Nix and Nixpkgs, supports Linux, macOS, and WSL2, integrates nixd for LSP.
en.hot: With Nix's reliability and devenv's ease of use, it has reached 7594 stars, +41 today, ranking #10 on the Rust daily trending.
uses: Developers who want to quickly set up reproducible dev environments with declarative config, avoiding manual dependency installation.
Teams needing consistent toolchains and versions across all members via a unified environment definition.
Nix users seeking a more user-friendly and faster experience, as devenv simplifies configuration.

zh.tag: 一键切换 Antigravity 账号的桌面管理工具
zh.what: Antigravity Tools 是一款专为开发者和 AI 爱好者设计的桌面应用，用于管理 Antigravity 账号并实现一键无缝切换。它还能将 Web 端 Session 转化为标准 API，充当本地 AI 中转站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri v2 + React 前端和 Rust 后端，提供图形界面进行账号管理、协议转换和请求调度。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React 和 Rust，使用现代桌面应用框架，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3 万+ Star 和日增 84 的热度，它解决了 AI 账号管理的痛点，提供高效便捷的本地中转方案。
uses: 需要管理多个 Antigravity 账号的开发者，可一键切换，提升效率。
希望将 Web Session 转为 API 的 AI 爱好者，用于本地集成和调用。
追求低成本、高稳定 AI 中转服务的用户，可结合赞助商服务使用。

en.tag: One-click Antigravity account manager & switcher desktop app
en.what: Antigravity Tools is a desktop app for developers and AI enthusiasts to manage Antigravity accounts and switch between them seamlessly with one click. It also converts web sessions into standard APIs, acting as a local AI relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri v2 + React frontend and Rust backend, offering a GUI for account management, protocol conversion, and request routing.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, and Rust, leveraging a modern desktop framework for cross-platform support.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 84 daily additions, it addresses AI account management pain points with an efficient local relay solution.
uses: Developers managing multiple Antigravity accounts can switch with one click for efficiency.
AI enthusiasts wanting to convert web sessions into APIs for local integration and calls.
Users seeking low-cost, stable AI relay services can leverage sponsor offerings.

zh.tag: macOS 上的开源容器与虚拟机运行时，纯 Rust 打造，支持 AI 代理沙箱。
zh.what: ArcBox 是一个面向 macOS 的快速开源容器和虚拟机运行时，旨在替代 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack。它支持四种工作负载：容器、沙箱、Linux 虚拟机和 macOS 客户机，全部运行在同一个运行时上。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的运行时核心、CLI 工具 abctl、Docker 兼容层、Kubernetes 支持以及桌面应用。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 1.96+ 从零构建，包括自研 VMM、VirtIO 设备、文件系统共享和网络数据通路，兼容 OCI 和 Docker。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3302 颗星，总星数 4154，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 18 名。作为开源替代方案，它解决了 macOS 上 Docker 性能与闭源的问题，并新增 AI 代理沙箱功能，吸引大量关注。
uses: macOS 上需要轻量级 Docker 替代方案的开发者。
AI 代理开发者，需要安全隔离的沙箱环境运行不可信代码。
需要本地 Kubernetes 或 Linux/macOS 虚拟机的运维和测试人员。
希望从本地沙箱无缝扩展到云端的团队。

en.tag: Open-source container and VM runtime for macOS, built in Rust, with AI agent sandboxes.
en.what: ArcBox is a fast, open-source container and VM runtime for macOS, positioned as an alternative to Docker Desktop and OrbStack. It supports four workload types—containers, sandboxes, Linux machines, and macOS guests—all on the same runtime.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based runtime core, the abctl CLI, Docker compatibility layer, Kubernetes support, and a desktop app.
en.stack: Built from scratch in Rust 1.96+, including its own VMM, VirtIO devices, filesystem sharing, and network datapath, with OCI and Docker compatibility.
en.hot: Gained 3,302 stars this week (total 4,154), ranking #18 on GitHub Trending (Rust weekly). As an open-source alternative addressing Docker performance and closed-source issues on macOS, plus new AI agent sandbox features, it's attracting significant attention.
uses: Developers on macOS seeking a lightweight Docker alternative.
AI agent developers needing secure sandboxes for untrusted code.
Ops and testers requiring local Kubernetes or Linux/macOS VMs.
Teams wanting seamless scaling from local sandboxes to the cloud.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 一键本地运行开源大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: Ollama 是一个让用户轻松在本地运行和管理开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供命令行界面、REST API 和多种编程语言库，方便集成到现有应用或作为 AI 助手使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的完整源代码，包括安装脚本、命令行工具、REST API 服务器、模型管理功能，以及 Python 和 JavaScript 客户端库的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 等推理后端，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。
zh.hot: Ollama 已获得 18 万星标，本月新增近 3000，因其让本地运行大模型变得极其简单，成为开发者和 AI 爱好者的首选工具。
uses: 开发者希望在本地快速测试或运行开源模型，无需复杂配置
需要将大模型集成到自己的应用或代理中的团队
关注隐私，希望数据不出本机的个人用户

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command
en.what: Ollama is a tool that lets users easily run and manage open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, and more. It provides a CLI, REST API, and libraries for multiple languages, making it easy to integrate into existing apps or use as an AI assistant.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ollama, including installation scripts, CLI tools, REST API server, model management features, and documentation/examples for Python and JavaScript client libraries.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging inference backends like llama.cpp, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker.
en.hot: With 180k stars and nearly 3k added this month, Ollama is the go-to tool for developers and AI enthusiasts due to its simplicity in running LLMs locally.
uses: Developers who want to quickly test or run open-source models locally without complex setup
Teams needing to integrate LLMs into their applications or agents
Privacy-conscious users who prefer to keep data on their own machines

zh.tag: 让 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理用「原始人语」输出，省下 65% token
zh.what: Caveman 是一个 AI 编码代理技能（skill），通过强制代理用极简的「原始人式」表达来压缩输出，从而减少 token 消耗。它保留代码、命令、文件路径和报错原文，只砍掉啰嗦的解释性废话，官方称可节省约 65% 的 token。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 本体、一个代理（proxy）实现，以及可包裹 10 种原生代理的 wrap 配置，另有文档、安装说明和 logo 等资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为技能/代理层接入 Claude Code 等 30+ 种代理，采用 MIT + BSL 双许可。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2195 star、总数突破 10 万，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 3；直击 AI 编码按 token 计费的痛点，加上原始人梗的传播力，让它迅速走红。
uses: 重度使用 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理、在意 token 账单的开发者
希望代理输出更简洁、减少阅读噪音的工程团队
想研究代理输出压缩与 prompt 技巧的 AI 工具开发者

en.tag: A Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by making agents talk like cavemen
en.what: Caveman is a skill for AI coding agents that forces them to answer in terse, caveman-style prose, cutting token usage by roughly 65%. Code, commands, file paths and exact error messages stay untouched — only the throat-clearing gets deleted.
en.content: The repo ships the installable skill itself, a proxy implementation, and wrap profiles for 10 native agents, plus docs, install instructions and branding assets.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it plugs into Claude Code and 30+ other agents as a skill/proxy layer, dual-licensed under MIT + BSL.
en.hot: It gained 2,195 stars this week to pass 100k total and hit #3 on GitHub's weekly Go trending list, riding both the real pain of token-based billing and a very shareable caveman meme.
uses: Developers who heavily use Claude Code and other coding agents and care about token bills
Engineering teams that want terser, lower-noise agent output
AI tooling builders studying output compression and prompt tricks

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: 统一聚合与分发多家大模型的 LLM 网关与 AI 资产管理系统
zh.what: new-api 是一个下一代 LLM 网关与 AI 资产管理系统，把各家大模型统一聚合并对外分发。它支持把不同厂商的模型跨格式转换为 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 兼容接口，为个人和企业提供集中式的模型管理与调用入口。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 后端为主，包含 Web 前端界面、Docker 部署配置和多语言 README（中/英/法/日等），提供完整的网关服务、管理后台与文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像与 DockerHub 发布，前端位于 web 目录，整体以容器化方式部署，依赖上游各家模型 API。
zh.hot: 凭借近 4.8 万 star 和本周 675 新增登上 GitHub Go 周榜第 5，多模型统一接入与格式转换的刚需让它在 AI 网关赛道持续走热。
uses: 需要统一接入多家大模型 API 的个人开发者
想自建企业级模型网关与用量计费的团队
希望把模型输出转换为 OpenAI/Claude/Gemini 兼容格式的集成方

en.tag: A unified LLM gateway for aggregating and distributing multi-vendor AI models
en.what: new-api is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management system that aggregates and distributes models from multiple vendors. It cross-converts various LLMs into OpenAI-, Claude-, or Gemini-compatible formats, offering a centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.
en.content: The repo centers on a Go backend with a web frontend, Docker deployment configs, and multilingual READMEs (Chinese, English, French, Japanese, etc.), shipping a full gateway service, admin panel, and docs.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, distributed via Docker and DockerHub, with a frontend under the web directory; it deploys in containers and depends on upstream model APIs.
en.hot: With nearly 47.7k stars and 675 added this week, it ranks 5th on GitHub's weekly Go trending list, fueled by strong demand for unified multi-model access and format conversion.
uses: Individual developers wanting unified access to multiple LLM APIs
Teams building an enterprise-grade model gateway with usage billing
Integrators needing to convert model outputs into OpenAI/Claude/Gemini-compatible formats

zh.tag: 把已有 AI 编程代理配置成完整工程环境的开源工具
zh.what: Gentle-AI 是一个开源配置层，为你已经在用的 AI 编程代理（Claude Code、Cursor、OpenCode、Codex、Pi 等）统一注入持久记忆、规范驱动开发（SDD）、精选技能、MCP 服务器、人格设定与可选的有界审查。它不绑定任何单一代理，让不同工具共享同一套工程化配置。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写，包含 CLI 配置器、各代理的适配模板、技能与 MCP 配置清单、人格定义，以及品牌文档与 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go 1.25.10+，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，采用 MIT 许可，依赖各 AI 代理的配置格式与 MCP 生态。
zh.hot: 本周新增 345 star，总数达 6560，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 6 名；多代理共存与免锁定配置切中开发者痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个 AI 编程代理、希望统一配置的开发者
想为代理加入持久记忆与规范驱动开发流程的团队
需要集中管理技能、MCP 服务器与人格设定的工程师
关注开源、避免厂商锁定的技术选型者

en.tag: Turn the AI coding agents you already use into a configured engineering environment
en.what: Gentle-AI is an open-source configuration layer that equips the AI coding agents you already use (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Pi, and more) with persistent memory, Spec-Driven Development, curated skills, MCP servers, personas, and optional bounded review. It avoids agent lock-in by letting different tools share one engineering setup.
en.content: Written in Go, the repo ships a CLI configurator, per-agent adapter templates, skill and MCP configuration manifests, persona definitions, plus brand docs and wiki links.
en.stack: Primary language Go 1.25.10+, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows under the MIT license, relying on each AI agent's config formats and the MCP ecosystem.
en.hot: It gained 345 stars this week for a total of 6,560, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart; its multi-agent, lock-in-free configuration hits a real developer pain point.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents who want unified configuration
Teams adding persistent memory and Spec-Driven Development to their agents
Engineers managing skills, MCP servers, and personas centrally
Open-source advocates avoiding vendor lock-in

zh.tag: 比 LiteLLM 快 50 倍的企业级 AI 网关，统一 1000+ 模型接入
zh.what: Bifrost 是一个高性能 AI 网关，通过单一 OpenAI 兼容 API 统一接入 OpenAI、Anthropic、AWS Bedrock、Google Vertex 等 23+ 供应商。它提供自动故障转移、负载均衡、语义缓存和企业级治理能力，让 AI 应用永不宕机。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的网关服务、内置 Web 配置与监控界面、Go SDK，以及 Docker/Helm 部署文件和完整文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 Go 编写，提供 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP API 与 Go SDK，支持 npx 一键启动、Docker 镜像和 Kubernetes/Helm 部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 175 star、总数达 7929，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 7。它以 5k RPS 下低于 100µs 的开销和比 LiteLLM 快 50 倍的性能，切中了企业 AI 网关的性能痛点。
uses: 需要统一管理多家 LLM 供应商、避免厂商锁定的平台团队
对延迟和吞吐有严格要求的高并发 AI 生产环境
希望快速搭建带故障转移与可观测性的 AI 网关的开发者
需要私有化部署、安全合规与治理能力的企业客户

en.tag: Enterprise AI gateway 50x faster than LiteLLM, unifying 1000+ models
en.what: Bifrost is a high-performance AI gateway that unifies access to 23+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex and more) through a single OpenAI-compatible API. It offers automatic failover, load balancing, semantic caching and enterprise-grade governance so AI apps never go down.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based gateway service, a built-in web UI for configuration and monitoring, a Go SDK, plus Docker/Helm deployment files and full documentation.
en.stack: Written in Go, it exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API and a Go SDK, with one-command npx startup, Docker images and Kubernetes/Helm deployment.
en.hot: It gained 175 stars this week for a total of 7,929, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's weekly Go list. Its sub-100µs overhead at 5k RPS and 50x speedup over LiteLLM hit the performance pain point of enterprise AI gateways.
uses: Platform teams needing to unify multiple LLM providers and avoid vendor lock-in
High-concurrency AI production environments with strict latency and throughput needs
Developers wanting a quick AI gateway with failover and observability
Enterprises requiring private deployment, security compliance and governance

zh.tag: 基于 eBPF 的云原生网络、安全与可观测性平台
zh.what: Cilium 是一个基于 eBPF 数据平面的网络、可观测性与安全解决方案，为 Kubernetes 等云原生环境提供扁平的三层网络，支持原生路由与 overlay 模式。它具备 L7 协议感知能力，可基于身份模型在 L3-L7 实施网络策略，并实现分布式负载均衡，能够完全替代 kube-proxy。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cilium 的核心 Go 源码、eBPF 程序、命令行工具、Kubernetes CRD 与 Operator，以及完整的文档、测试和示例。还提供 Helm charts、稳定版本分支和升级指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，核心数据平面依赖 Linux eBPF 技术，与 Kubernetes、容器运行时和 CNI 深度集成。项目采用 Apache-2.0/BSD/GPL 等多许可证，并包含大量 eBPF C 代码。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Cilium 是云原生网络与安全的事实标准之一，已获得超过 25,000 颗星。本周新增 65 星并登上 Go 趋势榜第 8 名，反映出社区对 eBPF 与 Kubernetes 网络方案持续高涨的关注。
uses: Kubernetes 平台工程师与集群管理员，用于构建高性能、可观测的容器网络
云原生安全团队，需要基于身份实施 L3-L7 网络策略与运行时安全
SRE 与运维人员，希望替代 kube-proxy 并实现大规模负载均衡
服务网格与可观测性开发者，利用 eBPF 获取深度网络洞察

en.tag: eBPF-based networking, security, and observability for cloud native
en.what: Cilium is a networking, observability, and security solution with an eBPF-based dataplane, providing a flat Layer 3 network for cloud native environments like Kubernetes, with native routing or overlay modes. It is L7-protocol aware, enforces L3-L7 network policies using an identity-based model, and implements distributed load balancing that can fully replace kube-proxy.
en.content: The repository contains Cilium's core Go source code, eBPF programs, CLI tools, Kubernetes CRDs and operator, plus comprehensive documentation, tests, and examples. It also includes Helm charts, stable release branches, and upgrade guides.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with the core dataplane relying on Linux eBPF technology, deeply integrated with Kubernetes, container runtimes, and CNI. The project uses Apache-2.0/BSD/GPL licenses and includes extensive eBPF C code.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Cilium is a de facto standard for cloud native networking and security, with over 25,000 stars. It gained 65 stars this week and ranked 8th on the Go trending list, reflecting sustained community interest in eBPF and Kubernetes networking.
uses: Kubernetes platform engineers and cluster admins building high-performance, observable container networking
Cloud native security teams needing identity-based L3-L7 network policies and runtime security
SREs and operators looking to replace kube-proxy and achieve large-scale load balancing
Service mesh and observability developers leveraging eBPF for deep network insights

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 推理引擎，无需 GPU 即可运行多模态模型
zh.what: LocalAI 是一个开源的 AI 推理引擎，允许用户在本地或自有基础设施上运行各种模型，包括 LLM、视觉、语音、图像和视频模型。它无需 GPU 即可运行，并兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 ElevenLabs 的 API，可作为这些服务的直接替代。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎、多个后端模块（如 llama.cpp、vLLM、whisper.cpp、stable-diffusion 等），以及用于 API 兼容、多用户认证、内置 AI 代理和文档的组件。后端按需拉取，保持核心轻量。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，后端集成 C++ 和 Python 的推理引擎（如 llama.cpp、vLLM、whisper.cpp 等），支持多种硬件加速（CUDA、ROCm、Vulkan、Apple Silicon 等）。
zh.hot: LocalAI 在 GitHub 上拥有近 5 万星标，今日新增 40 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第二。其吸引力在于无需 GPU 即可运行任意模型，同时提供与主流 API 的即插即用兼容性，满足了用户对数据隐私和本地部署的需求。
uses: 希望在本地或私有云中运行 AI 模型，避免数据外泄的企业和开发者
没有高端 GPU 硬件，但仍需运行 LLM 或多模态模型的个人开发者
需要兼容 OpenAI API 的本地替代方案，以降低成本和延迟的团队
对 AI 代理、RAG 和工具调用感兴趣，希望自主控制 AI 工作流的用户

en.tag: Open-source, local-first AI engine to run any model on any hardware without GPU
en.what: LocalAI is an open-source AI inference engine that lets you run various models—LLMs, vision, voice, image, and video—on your own hardware without needing a GPU. It offers drop-in API compatibility with OpenAI, Anthropic, and ElevenLabs, making it a privacy-preserving alternative to cloud AI services.
en.content: The repository includes the core engine, multiple backend modules (e.g., llama.cpp, vLLM, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion), and components for API compatibility, multi-user auth, built-in AI agents, and documentation. Backends are pulled on demand to keep the core lightweight.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with backends integrating C++ and Python inference engines like llama.cpp, vLLM, and whisper.cpp. Supports various hardware accelerations including CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, and Apple Silicon.
en.hot: With nearly 49k stars and 40 added today, LocalAI ranks #2 on the Go trending list. Its appeal lies in running any model without a GPU while offering drop-in API compatibility, addressing the growing demand for privacy and on-premises AI deployment.
uses: Enterprises and developers who want to run AI models locally or in private clouds to avoid data leakage
Individual developers without high-end GPUs who still need to run LLMs or multimodal models
Teams needing a local drop-in replacement for OpenAI API to reduce costs and latency
Users interested in AI agents, RAG, and tool use who want full control over their AI workflows

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的安全组网与访问控制平台
zh.what: NetBird 是一个开源的零配置组网工具，利用 WireGuard 创建加密的 P2P 覆盖网络，自动连接设备，无需开放端口或配置防火墙。它同时提供集中式访问控制，支持 SSO、MFA 和细粒度权限策略，适用于企业和家庭网络。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NetBird 客户端、服务端、管理面板（dashboard）、公共 API 以及 agent-network 子目录（用于 AI 代理的身份感知访问控制）。提供完整的文档、Slack 社区和自托管部署指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 WireGuard 内核模块，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 等平台。前端 dashboard 可能使用 React 等 Web 技术。
zh.hot: NetBird 以零配置、安全的 P2P 组网替代传统 VPN，在 GitHub 上获得近 3 万星标，今日新增 36 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 4。其独特的 AI Agent 网络功能（Beta）也吸引了关注。
uses: 企业 IT 管理员：快速搭建安全的远程访问网络，无需管理 VPN 网关和复杂防火墙规则。
开发者和 DevOps 团队：在云、本地或混合环境中自动连接服务器和容器，简化基础设施管理。
家庭用户：轻松组建家庭私有网络，安全访问 NAS 或智能设备。
AI 应用开发者：利用 Agent Network 功能为 AI 代理提供无密钥的 LLM API 访问控制。

en.tag: Secure WireGuard-based overlay network with SSO, MFA, and access control
en.what: NetBird is an open-source, zero-config networking tool that creates an encrypted P2P overlay network using WireGuard, automatically connecting devices without port forwarding or complex firewall rules. It also provides centralized access control with SSO, MFA, and granular policies for enterprise and home networks.
en.content: The repository includes the NetBird client, server, dashboard UI, public API, and an agent-network subdirectory for identity-aware access control for AI agents. It offers comprehensive docs, Slack community, and self-hosting guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging WireGuard kernel modules, with support for Linux, Windows, macOS, and other platforms. The dashboard frontend likely uses web technologies like React.
en.hot: NetBird's zero-config, secure P2P networking as a VPN alternative has earned nearly 30k stars, with 36 new stars today, ranking #4 on the Go trending list. Its unique AI Agent Network feature (Beta) also draws attention.
uses: Enterprise IT admins: quickly set up secure remote access networks without managing VPN gateways or complex firewall rules.
Developers and DevOps teams: automatically connect servers and containers across cloud, on-prem, or hybrid environments to simplify infrastructure management.
Home users: easily create a private home network to securely access NAS or smart devices.
AI application developers: leverage the Agent Network feature for keyless access control to LLM APIs for AI agents.

zh.tag: 可扩展的覆盖网络工具，兼顾性能、简单与安全
zh.what: Nebula 是一个可扩展的覆盖网络工具，旨在让分布在世界各地的计算机无缝连接。它基于 Noise 协议框架，使用证书认证节点身份，并通过灯塔节点实现 NAT 穿透，支持从少量到数万台设备的组网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nebula 的核心代码，包括证书管理、加密通信、安全组、灯塔节点等模块，以及适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的构建文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Noise 协议框架、椭圆曲线 Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换和 AES-256-GCM 加密。
zh.hot: Nebula 在 GitHub 上拥有 18k+ stars，今日新增 25 个，位列 Go 趋势榜第五，因其高性能、简单易用和安全性受到广泛关注。
uses: 适用于需要跨地域、跨云服务商安全组网的开发者和运维人员。
适合构建分布式系统或边缘计算场景，需要低延迟、高安全性的网络连接。
可用于个人或企业快速搭建虚拟专用网络，替代传统 VPN 方案。

en.tag: A scalable overlay networking tool focusing on performance, simplicity, and security
en.what: Nebula is a scalable overlay networking tool that enables seamless connection of computers worldwide. Built on the Noise Protocol Framework, it uses certificates for node authentication and lighthouse nodes for NAT traversal, supporting networks from a few to tens of thousands of devices.
en.content: The repository contains the core code of Nebula, including modules for certificate management, encrypted communication, security groups, lighthouse nodes, and build files for Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the Noise Protocol Framework, Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and AES-256-GCM encryption.
en.hot: With over 18k stars and 25 new stars today, ranking 5th on the Go trending list, Nebula gains attention for its high performance, simplicity, and security.
uses: For developers and operators needing secure networking across regions and cloud providers.
Ideal for distributed systems or edge computing requiring low-latency, high-security connections.
Can be used to quickly set up virtual private networks for individuals or enterprises, replacing traditional VPN solutions.

zh.tag: 自托管网页文件管理器，功能强大且免费
zh.what: FileBrowser Quantum 是一个自托管的网页文件管理器，让用户通过浏览器轻松访问和管理文件。它提供现代响应式界面，支持用户管理、访问控制、文件分享、预览和编辑等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文件浏览器应用，支持多源配置、OIDC/LDAP/JWT 等多种登录方式，以及实时搜索、缩略图（办公、视频、专辑封面、3D模型）等功能。提供 config.yaml 配置文件和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖前端技术（如 JavaScript/CSS）构建响应式界面，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种认证协议（OIDC, LDAP, JWT）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 488 星，总星数达 8168，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 21 名。作为 filebrowser 的大幅改进分支，它提供了更丰富的功能和更好的用户体验，且完全免费开源，吸引了大量自托管用户。
uses: 个人用户：在家庭服务器或 NAS 上部署，随时随地通过浏览器管理文件。
团队协作：利用用户管理和分享功能，实现文件的安全共享与协作。
开发者：作为自托管文件管理解决方案，可集成到现有系统中，支持多种认证方式。
运维人员：通过 Docker 快速部署，提供轻量级文件访问入口。

en.tag: Powerful free self-hosted web file manager
en.what: FileBrowser Quantum is a self-hosted web-based file manager that allows users to easily access and manage files through a browser. It offers a modern responsive interface with advanced features for user management, access control, sharing, file preview, and editing.
en.content: The repository contains a full-featured file browser application with multi-source configuration, multiple login methods (OIDC, LDAP, JWT), real-time search, and thumbnails for office, video, album art, and 3D models. It includes a config.yaml file and Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend technologies (JavaScript/CSS) for the responsive UI, supports Docker deployment, and integrates authentication protocols like OIDC, LDAP, and JWT.
en.hot: Gained 488 stars this month, reaching 8,168 total, ranking #21 on the Go trending list. As a massive fork of filebrowser with enhanced features and UX, it attracts many self-hosters due to being free and open-source.
uses: For individuals: deploy on home servers or NAS to manage files from anywhere via browser.
For teams: use user management and sharing features for secure file collaboration.
For developers: integrate as a self-hosted file management solution with multiple auth methods.
For admins: quick Docker deployment for a lightweight file access point.

zh.tag: 多协议多用户 Xray 可视化管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器高级 Web 控制面板，支持部署、配置和监控多种代理与 VPN 协议。它是 X-UI 项目的增强分支，提供更广泛的协议支持、改进的稳定性和按客户端流量统计等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 面板源码、多语言界面（英文、波斯语、阿拉伯语、中文等）、安装脚本、文档以及用于构建和发布的 GitHub Actions 工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Xray-core 和前端框架（如 Vue.js），依赖 SQLite 等数据库存储配置。
zh.hot: 凭借 46k+ 星标和持续更新，3X-UI 成为 Xray 用户首选的图形化管理工具，今日新增 44 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 9 名。
uses: 适合个人或小型团队在 VPS 上快速部署和管理多协议代理服务，无需手动编辑配置文件。
需要为多个用户分配独立流量配额、有效期和设备限制的代理服务提供者。
希望利用 AmneziaWG 或 MTProto 等抗审查协议的用户，可通过面板轻松配置。

en.tag: Multi-protocol, multi-user Xray web control panel
en.what: 3X-UI is an advanced open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, enabling deployment, configuration, and monitoring of various proxy and VPN protocols. As an enhanced fork of X-UI, it offers broader protocol support, improved stability, and per-client traffic accounting.
en.content: The repository contains the full web panel source code, multi-language UI (English, Persian, Arabic, Chinese, etc.), installation scripts, documentation, and GitHub Actions workflows for building and releasing.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, built on Xray-core and frontend frameworks like Vue.js, with SQLite for configuration storage.
en.hot: With 46k+ stars and active development, 3X-UI is the go-to GUI management tool for Xray users, gaining 44 stars today and ranking #9 on the Go trending list.
uses: Ideal for individuals or small teams to quickly deploy and manage multi-protocol proxy services on a VPS without manual config editing.
For proxy providers needing to assign per-user traffic quotas, expiry dates, and device limits.
Users who want to leverage anti-censorship protocols like AmneziaWG or MTProto with an easy panel setup.

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: 自主AI渗透测试代理系统
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主的 AI 代理系统，能够执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用先进的人工智能技术，为信息安全专业人员、研究人员和爱好者提供强大且灵活的安全测试解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的系统代码、架构文档、快速入门指南、LLM 提供商配置（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等）、Docker 镜像配置、开发与测试工具（如 ftester）以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock 等），集成 Docker 进行隔离，并支持 Langfuse 监控和知识图谱（Graphiti）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 与网络安全结合的热度上升，PentAGI 作为自动化渗透测试的领先项目，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 89 星，总星数达 22519，位居 Go 语言趋势榜第一。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 代理自动执行渗透测试，提高效率。
红队与蓝队：在授权环境中进行自动化安全评估。
AI 爱好者：探索 AI 在网络安全领域的实际应用。

en.tag: Autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. It leverages advanced AI technologies to provide a powerful and flexible security testing solution for infosec professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository includes full system code, architecture docs, quick start guides, LLM provider configurations (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), Docker image setup, development and testing tools (like ftester), and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, etc.), integrates Docker for isolation, and supports Langfuse monitoring and knowledge graph (Graphiti).
en.hot: With the rising intersection of AI and cybersecurity, PentAGI as a leading autonomous pentesting project has gained rapid traction on GitHub, adding 89 stars today to reach 22,519 total, ranking #1 in Go trending.
uses: Security researchers: leverage AI agents to automate penetration testing and improve efficiency.
Red and blue teams: conduct automated security assessments in authorized environments.
AI enthusiasts: explore practical applications of AI in cybersecurity.

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
教育场景：用于音频教学、学生录音作业或声音实验。
音频修复：去除噪音、剪辑对话或恢复历史录音。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Audacity, including the core editor, audio engine, effects plugins, and UI resources. It is currently undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4, with a brand-new UI and refactorings, while maintaining the 3.x branch.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on wxWidgets for UI, PortAudio for audio I/O, and other libraries. The build system uses CMake, with platform-specific build scripts.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source audio tool, Audacity has a stable user base. Recent attention is driven by the UI overhaul and updates for Audacity 4, gaining 272 stars today and ranking #2 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Podcasters: record and edit multi-track audio, add effects, and export episodes.
Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.
Educational settings: use for audio teaching, student recording assignments, or sound experiments.
Audio restoration: remove noise, edit dialogue, or recover historical recordings.

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具
zh.what: PrusaSlicer 是一款将 3D 模型转换为 3D 打印指令（G-code）的软件，支持 FDM 和 mSLA 打印机。它由 Prusa Research 开发，兼容多种品牌打印机，并提供丰富的打印参数设置和模型编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: 跨 GPU 的图形缩放与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一个允许在支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换原生缩放器的工具，并能管理帧生成，包括通过实验性的 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成。它支持 DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ 输入，并可将 DLSS 帧生成替换为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、预编译的稳定版和夜间版发布包、详细的 Wiki 文档、Discord 社区链接以及捐赠渠道。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖图形 API 如 DX12 和 Vulkan，以及 DLSS/FSR/XeSS 等缩放技术。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 10k+ 星标，今日新增 47 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。它解决了跨 GPU 缩放和帧生成的兼容性问题，受到游戏玩家和模组社区的广泛关注。
uses: 游戏玩家：在非原生支持的游戏中使用 FSR 或 XeSS 替换 DLSS，提升帧率或画质。
模组制作者：利用 Nukem 模组将 DLSS 帧生成转换为 FSR3，扩展硬件兼容性。
开发者：研究图形缩放和帧生成技术的实现，参考其跨平台兼容方案。

en.tag: Bridges upscaling/frame gen across GPUs, replacing native upscalers
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games that already support DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation, including enabling it in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG. It supports DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ inputs and can replace DLSS frame gen with FSR3.
en.content: The repository contains C++ source code, precompiled stable and nightly releases, a comprehensive Wiki, Discord community link, and donation channels.
en.stack: Developed in C++, relies on graphics APIs like DX12 and Vulkan, and upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and 47 new stars today, ranking #2 on the C++ trending list, it addresses cross-GPU upscaling and frame gen compatibility, gaining attention from gamers and modders.
uses: Gamers: Replace DLSS with FSR or XeSS in games that don't natively support them, improving FPS or quality.
Modders: Use the Nukem mod to convert DLSS frame gen to FSR3, extending hardware compatibility.
Developers: Study the implementation of upscaling and frame gen techniques, referencing its cross-platform compatibility approach.

zh.tag: 轻量极速的进程内向量数据库，为 AI 应用而生
zh.what: Zvec 是一个开源的进程内向量数据库，专为嵌入式应用设计，提供低延迟、可扩展的相似性搜索。它已在阿里巴巴集团内部经过实战检验，支持生产级使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 引擎、Python 和 Node.js 客户端库，以及 CLI 工具 zvec-grep，统一了 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜索。还集成了 ReMe 代理记忆管理工具，并支持 DiskANN 和 IVF-RaBit 等索引优化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python（3.10~3.14）和 npm 包，支持 Linux/macOS ARM64，采用 io_uring 异步 I/O，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 15,840 颗星（本周新增 301）登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因其轻量级、高性能和阿里背书而备受关注。最新版本引入了 zvec-grep 和 ReMe 集成，扩展了 AI 代理场景。
uses: 开发者需要在应用中嵌入向量数据库，实现低延迟相似性搜索。
AI 代理开发者需要本地优先的工作区搜索工具，结合关键词与向量检索。
需要轻量级、免运维的向量存储方案，用于原型验证或生产环境。

en.tag: A lightweight, lightning-fast, in-process vector database for AI applications
en.what: Zvec is an open-source, in-process vector database designed for embedding directly into applications, offering low-latency, scalable similarity search. It is battle-tested within Alibaba Group and production-ready.
en.content: The repository includes the core C++ engine, Python and Node.js client libraries, and a CLI tool zvec-grep that unifies ripgrep, BM25, and vector search. It also integrates with ReMe agent memory management and supports DiskANN and IVF-RaBit index optimizations.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with Python (3.10~3.14) and npm packages, supports Linux/macOS ARM64, uses io_uring async I/O, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: With 15,840 stars (301 added this week) and trending on GitHub, it gains attention for its lightweight, high-performance design and Alibaba backing. The latest release introduces zvec-grep and ReMe integration, expanding AI agent use cases.
uses: Developers needing an embedded vector database for low-latency similarity search in their applications.
AI agent developers requiring local-first workspace search combining keyword and vector retrieval.
Teams seeking a lightweight, zero-ops vector storage solution for prototyping or production.

zh.tag: Facebook 出品的高性能嵌入式持久化键值存储库
zh.what: RocksDB 是 Facebook 数据库工程团队开发维护的嵌入式持久化键值存储库，基于 Google LevelDB 的早期工作演进而来。它采用 LSM-Tree 设计，可在写放大、读放大和空间放大之间灵活权衡，特别适合在闪存上存储数据。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 源码为主体，公共接口位于 include/ 目录，examples/ 提供用法示例，另有完整的 GitHub Wiki 文档、构建脚本与测试套件。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake/Make 构建，支持多线程 compaction，采用 GPLv2 与 Apache 2.0 双许可证。
zh.hot: 作为 MyRocks、TiKV、CockroachDB 等众多数据库的底层存储引擎，RocksDB 长期保持高关注度，已积累 32075 颗星，本周新增 45 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 6。
uses: 数据库与存储引擎开发者，需要为自研数据库选型底层 KV 存储
后端工程师在闪存/SSD 场景下构建高吞吐持久化服务
需要单库存储数 TB 级数据并调优读写放大的系统架构师

en.tag: Facebook's embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage
en.what: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store library developed and maintained by Facebook's Database Engineering Team, building on earlier work on Google's LevelDB. It uses an LSM-Tree design with flexible tradeoffs between write, read, and space amplification, making it especially suited for storing data on flash drives.
en.content: The repo is primarily C++ source code, with the public interface in include/, usage examples in examples/, plus a full GitHub Wiki, build scripts, and test suites.
en.stack: Core is written in C++, built with CMake/Make, supports multi-threaded compaction, and is dual-licensed under GPLv2 and Apache 2.0.
en.hot: As the storage engine behind MyRocks, TiKV, CockroachDB and many others, RocksDB enjoys lasting attention with 32,075 stars, gaining 45 this week to rank 6th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Database and storage engine developers choosing a low-level KV store for their own database
Backend engineers building high-throughput persistent services on flash/SSD
System architects needing single-database storage of multiple terabytes with tunable read/write amplification

zh.tag: Google 开源的 C++ 通用库，补充标准库
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 内部 C++ 代码库的开源版本，旨在补充 C++ 标准库的不足。它提供标准库缺失的组件，或针对特殊需求提供替代实现，并已在 Google 生产环境中广泛测试和使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个库组件，如 base、algorithm、cleanup、container 等，每个组件位于独立的子目录中，并附有构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 C++17 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方开源库，拥有 18k+ stars，是 C++ 开发者的常用工具集，虽然今日新增不多，但长期稳定受欢迎。
uses: C++ 开发者需要标准库之外的实用工具时，可快速引入 Abseil 组件。
希望借鉴 Google 内部 C++ 最佳实践和代码风格的项目团队。
需要跨平台、高性能且经过生产验证的基础库的应用程序。

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries augmenting the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ library code from Google's internal codebase, designed to augment the C++ standard library. It provides missing pieces or alternatives for special needs, extensively tested in production.
en.content: The repository contains multiple library components such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, each in separate subdirectories with build configurations and documentation.
en.stack: Written in C++17, supports Bazel and CMake build systems, depends on the C++ standard library.
en.hot: As an official Google open-source library with 18k+ stars, it's a common toolkit for C++ developers. Although today's increment is small, it remains consistently popular.
uses: C++ developers needing utilities beyond the standard library can quickly adopt Abseil components.
Teams looking to follow Google's internal C++ best practices and coding style.
Applications requiring a cross-platform, high-performance, production-proven base library.

zh.tag: 为 Wayland 打造的原生桌面外壳，一体化定制 Linux 桌面
zh.what: Noctalia 是一个原生的 Wayland 桌面外壳，旨在替代由多个独立小工具拼凑而成的桌面环境。它提供统一的栏、部件、dock、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏等功能，并直接构建于 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES 之上，无 Qt 或 GTK 依赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面外壳实现，涵盖多显示器栏、任务栏、工作区、系统托盘、dock、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏、剪贴板历史、OSD 等组件。项目提供安装文档、用户指南和 ethos 理念说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，直接基于 Wayland 协议和 OpenGL ES 进行渲染，无 Qt/GTK 依赖。配置和 IPC 模型为一体化设计，支持脚本扩展部件。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 上表现强劲，月增 1089 星，总星数破万，反映出用户对一体化、可定制 Wayland 桌面外壳的强烈需求。其无 Qt/GTK 依赖的原生实现和统一设计理念吸引了大量关注。
uses: 希望摆脱零散工具、追求视觉统一和稳定体验的 Wayland 桌面用户
喜欢深度定制桌面外观和行为的 Linux 爱好者与开发者
需要多显示器支持和丰富部件（如天气、剪贴板历史）的生产力用户

en.tag: A native Wayland desktop shell for a cohesive, customizable Linux desktop
en.what: Noctalia is a native Wayland desktop shell that replaces the patchwork of separate tools for a cohesive desktop experience. It provides bars, widgets, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, and more, built directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES without Qt or GTK dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains a full desktop shell implementation, including multi-monitor bars, taskbar, workspaces, system tray, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, clipboard history, OSDs, and more. It includes installation docs, user guides, and an ethos page.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it renders directly via Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt/GTK dependencies. Configuration and IPC are designed cohesively, with support for script-backed widgets.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and a monthly gain of 1089, it's trending strongly, indicating high demand for a cohesive, customizable Wayland shell. Its native implementation without Qt/GTK and unified design philosophy are key attractions.
uses: Wayland desktop users seeking a unified, stable experience instead of scattered tools
Linux enthusiasts and developers who enjoy deep customization of desktop appearance and behavior
Productivity users needing multi-monitor support and rich widgets like weather and clipboard history

zh.tag: 全球最流行的开源文档型 NoSQL 数据库内核
zh.what: MongoDB 是一个面向文档的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，以 BSON/JSON 风格的灵活数据模型著称。本仓库是其官方核心源码，包含数据库服务器 mongod、分片路由 mongos 等组件。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 源码为主体，包含 mongod/mongos 等可执行程序、构建脚本 buildscripts、打包工具 packager.py、文档 docs 以及 Compass 安装脚本等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，配套 Python 构建与打包脚本，支持 Homebrew、Docker 等多种安装方式，并提供各语言官方驱动。
zh.hot: 作为数据库领域的常青树，MongoDB 拥有 28544 颗 Star，本周仍新增 28 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 9，说明其核心源码持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 后端工程师：需要为应用选型或深入理解文档型数据库内核
数据库/DBA 从业者：研究分片、复制集与存储引擎实现
开源贡献者：希望参与大型 C++ 数据库项目的开发与调试
架构师：评估 MongoDB 在分布式与云原生场景下的适用性

en.tag: The source code of the world's most popular open-source document NoSQL database
en.what: MongoDB is a document-oriented distributed NoSQL database known for its flexible BSON/JSON-style data model. This repository is its official core source code, containing the mongod database server, the mongos sharding router, and related components.
en.content: The repo is mainly C++ source code, including the mongod/mongos executables, build scripts under buildscripts, the packager.py packaging tool, docs, and the Compass install script.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, with Python build and packaging scripts, supporting Homebrew, Docker and other install methods, plus official drivers for most languages.
en.hot: A long-standing staple in the database world, MongoDB has 28,544 stars, gaining 28 this week and ranking 9th on the C++ weekly trending list, showing sustained developer interest in its core source.
uses: Backend engineers: choosing a database or diving into a document DB's internals
Database/DBA professionals: studying sharding, replica sets and storage engines
Open-source contributors: wanting to work on a large C++ database project
Architects: evaluating MongoDB for distributed and cloud-native scenarios

zh.tag: RE引擎游戏通用模组框架与VR支持工具
zh.what: REFramework 是一个针对卡普空 RE 引擎游戏的模组加载器、脚本平台和模组工具，支持 VR。它允许玩家在游戏中加载 Lua 脚本、插件和内置模组，并提供了大量游戏修复和增强功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 DLL 文件、Lua 脚本 API、插件系统、VR 支持、多种内置模组（如自由视角、FOV 调整等）以及开发者工具（如对象浏览器）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 11/12，支持 SteamVR/OpenXR，并集成 Lua 脚本引擎。
zh.hot: 作为 RE 引擎游戏模组的核心工具，它持续吸引大量玩家和模组作者，今日新增 16 星，总星数达 5408，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第 17。
uses: 模组作者：利用 Lua API 和插件系统为 RE 引擎游戏创建自定义模组和脚本。
VR 玩家：在支持的 RE 游戏中启用 VR 模式，获得沉浸式体验。
游戏玩家：使用内置修复和增强功能改善游戏体验，如解锁帧率或修复崩溃。

en.tag: Universal mod framework, scripting platform, and VR support for RE Engine games
en.what: REFramework is a mod loader, scripting platform, and modding tool for Capcom's RE Engine games, with VR support. It enables loading Lua scripts, plugins, and built-in mods, plus many fixes and enhancements.
en.content: The repository contains core DLLs, Lua scripting API, plugin system, VR support, various built-in mods (free camera, FOV slider, etc.), and developer tools like object explorer.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on DirectX 11/12, supports SteamVR/OpenXR, and integrates a Lua scripting engine.
en.hot: As a central tool for RE Engine modding, it consistently attracts players and modders, gaining 16 stars today to reach 5408 total, ranking #17 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Modders: Create custom mods and scripts for RE Engine games using the Lua API and plugin system.
VR enthusiasts: Enable VR mode in supported RE games for an immersive experience.
Gamers: Use built-in fixes and enhancements to improve gameplay, such as unlocking frame rate or fixing crashes.

zh.tag: 开源软件 KVM：一套键鼠无缝控制多台电脑
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键盘鼠标共享工具，让你用一台电脑的键鼠或触控板去控制旁边的其他电脑，在它们之间无缝切换工作。它相当于不带视频功能的软件 KVM，默认启用 TLS 加密，并支持 Wayland 与剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库是完整的跨平台桌面应用源码，包含核心共享逻辑、各平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）构建与打包配置，并提供稳定版、持续构建版以及 Flathub 与 Homebrew 等分发渠道。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主语言，面向 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 多平台构建，依赖系统图形与输入层（含 Wayland 支持），并内置 TLS 加密通信。
zh.hot: 作为 Synergy 的开源继任者，它解决了多机办公的刚需，累计已获约 2.87 万 star，本周再增 201，稳居 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 11 名。
uses: 同时使用笔记本与台式机的开发者，用一套键鼠跨屏操作
多系统办公用户（Windows/macOS/Linux 混用）需要无缝切换
想替代硬件 KVM 或 Synergy 的团队与个人，追求开源免费方案
注重隐私安全、希望默认加密并共享剪贴板的用户

en.tag: Open-source software KVM: share one keyboard and mouse across computers
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control nearby computers with one computer's keyboard, mouse, or trackpad and work seamlessly between them. It works like a software KVM without the video, with TLS encryption on by default, plus Wayland and clipboard sharing support.
en.content: The repo holds the full cross-platform desktop app source, including the core sharing logic, per-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) build and packaging configs, and distribution channels such as stable, continuous builds, Flathub, and Homebrew.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and built for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it relies on platform graphics/input layers (including Wayland) and uses TLS-encrypted communication.
en.hot: As the open-source successor to Synergy, it scratches a real multi-machine workflow itch, with roughly 28.7k stars total and 201 added this week, ranking 11th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list.
uses: Developers juggling a laptop and desktop who want one keyboard and mouse across screens
Multi-OS office users (Windows/macOS/Linux mix) needing seamless switching
Teams and individuals replacing hardware KVMs or Synergy with a free open-source option
Privacy-conscious users who want encryption by default plus clipboard sharing

zh.tag: 开源跨平台参数化 3D 建模软件 FreeCAD 官方源码
zh.what: FreeCAD 是一款免费开源的参数化 3D 建模软件，主要用于设计任意尺寸的真实物体。参数化建模让用户可以回溯模型历史、修改参数来调整设计，并支持从 2D 草图构建 3D 模型、再反向生成工程图纸。
zh.content: 仓库是 FreeCAD 的官方源代码，包含核心几何内核、GUI 界面、各功能工作台（如 PartDesign）以及大量 Python API 绑定，并配有图标、文档与构建脚本。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，依赖 OpenCASCADE 几何内核、Coin3D 场景库与 Qt 界面框架，并提供广泛的 Python API 用于脚本扩展。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源 CAD 项目，FreeCAD 本周新增约 197 star、总量突破 3.3 万，登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 12 名，反映出开源替代商业 CAD 的持续热度。
uses: 机械工程师与产品设计师，用参数化建模做零件与装配设计
建筑师与土木从业者，用于建筑信息建模与结构草图
学生和教师，作为免费教学工具学习 CAD 与工程制图
开发者与爱好者，通过 Python API 扩展自定义工作台

en.tag: Official source of FreeCAD, the open-source cross-platform parametric 3D modeler
en.what: FreeCAD is a free, open-source parametric 3D modeler for designing real-life objects of any size. Parametric modeling lets users go back into model history to change parameters, and it supports building 3D from constrained 2D sketches and producing production-ready drawings.
en.content: The repo holds FreeCAD's official source code, including the geometry core, Qt-based GUI, feature workbenches such as PartDesign, and extensive Python API bindings, plus icons, docs and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on the OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, Coin3D scene library and Qt GUI framework, with a broad Python API for scripting and extensions.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source CAD project, FreeCAD gained about 197 stars this week, passing 33k total and ranking 12th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list, reflecting steady demand for open-source CAD alternatives.
uses: Mechanical engineers and product designers doing parametric part and assembly design
Architects and civil professionals for building modeling and structural sketches
Students and teachers seeking a free tool to learn CAD and engineering drawing
Developers and hobbyists extending custom workbenches via the Python API

zh.tag: Google DeepMind 开源的高性能物理仿真引擎
zh.what: MuJoCo 是 Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact 的缩写，是一个通用物理引擎，用于机器人、生物力学、图形动画和机器学习等领域中关节结构与环境的快速精确仿真。它由 Google DeepMind 维护，提供 C API 和 Python 绑定，面向研究人员与开发者。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C 语言编写的核心仿真运行时、基于 OpenGL 的原生交互式查看器 simulate、XML 模型编译器、Python 绑定、Unity 插件，以及多个 Colab 教程笔记本（入门、模型编辑、rollout、LQR 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++/C 编写，依赖 OpenGL 进行可视化，提供 Python 绑定和 Unity 插件，构建系统基于 CMake，文档托管在 Read the Docs。
zh.hot: 作为机器人强化学习领域最常用的仿真器之一，MuJoCo 拥有超过 15000 颗星，本周新增 145 星，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 分类第 13 名，持续受到研究社区关注。
uses: 机器人强化学习研究者，用于训练和评估控制策略
生物力学与运动科学研究者，用于人体运动仿真
图形与动画开发者，用于物理逼真的关节结构模拟

en.tag: Google DeepMind's high-performance physics simulation engine
en.what: MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, a general-purpose physics engine for fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment, used in robotics, biomechanics, graphics, animation and machine learning. Maintained by Google DeepMind, it offers a C API and Python bindings for researchers and developers.
en.content: The repo contains the C-based core simulation runtime, a native OpenGL interactive viewer called simulate, an XML model compiler, Python bindings, a Unity plugin, and several Colab tutorial notebooks (intro, model editing, rollout, LQR, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++/C, it uses OpenGL for visualization, offers Python bindings and a Unity plugin, builds with CMake, and hosts documentation on Read the Docs.
en.hot: As one of the most widely used simulators in robot reinforcement learning, MuJoCo has over 15,000 stars, gaining 145 this week and ranking 13th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, drawing sustained attention from the research community.
uses: Robotics reinforcement learning researchers training and evaluating control policies
Biomechanics and movement science researchers simulating human motion
Graphics and animation developers needing physically realistic articulated structure simulation
Machine learning engineers requiring fast and accurate physics environments for experiments

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 Chromium 浏览器，无广告无噪音
zh.what: Helium 是一款基于 Chromium 的网页浏览器，强调隐私保护和无偏见广告拦截。它去除了 Google 相关服务，提供简洁、快速的上网体验，目前处于测试阶段。

开发者可参与贡献，基于 Chromium 的浏览器定制开发

en.tag: Privacy-first Chromium browser with unbiased ad-blocking, no bloat
en.what: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and unbiased ad-blocking. It removes Google services, offering a clean, fast browsing experience, currently in beta.

en.stack: Built on Chromium and ungoogled-chromium, developed in C++, integrates a modified uBlock Origin for ad-blocking.
en.hot: High demand for privacy browsers, Helium attracts users with unbiased ad-blocking and clean design, stars exceed 20k with 111 added today, trending in C++.

Developers interested in contributing to Chromium-based browser customization
Users seeking an ad-free, clean, and fast browsing experience

zh.tag: Google 跨语言数据序列化标准
zh.what: Protocol Buffers（protobuf）是 Google 开发的语言中立、平台中立、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。它通过 .proto 文件定义数据结构，并生成多种语言的代码，广泛应用于 RPC 系统和数据存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protobuf 的完整实现，包括 C++ 编写的编译器（protoc）、各语言运行时库（如 C++、Java、Python、Go 等）、测试和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写编译器，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，并依赖多种语言运行时。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，protobuf 拥有超过 7 万星标，今日新增 96 星，持续受到开发者关注，因其高效、跨语言特性成为微服务和分布式系统的基石。
uses: 后端开发人员：在微服务间定义高效、版本兼容的通信协议。
数据工程师：用于大数据管道和存储格式（如与 gRPC 结合）。
跨语言团队：需要统一数据交换格式，支持多语言生成代码。

en.tag: Google's cross-language data serialization standard
en.what: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It defines data structures in .proto files and generates code in multiple languages, widely used in RPC systems and data storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full implementation of protobuf, including the compiler (protoc) written in C++, runtime libraries for various languages (C++, Java, Python, Go, etc.), tests, and documentation.
en.stack: The compiler is primarily written in C++, supporting Bazel and CMake build systems, with dependencies on various language runtimes.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, protobuf has over 71k stars, with 96 added today, continuing to attract developers due to its efficiency and cross-language capabilities, making it a cornerstone of microservices and distributed systems.
uses: Backend developers: define efficient, version-tolerant communication protocols between microservices.
Data engineers: use in big data pipelines and storage formats (e.g., with gRPC).
Cross-language teams: need a unified data interchange format with multi-language code generation.

zh.tag: 明日方舟全自动日常助手，一键长草
zh.what: MAA 是一款基于图像识别的《明日方舟》游戏辅助工具，能自动完成游戏内的日常任务，如刷图、基建换班、公招等。它通过模拟操作和图像识别，让玩家实现“一键长草”，省时省力。

游戏自动化爱好者：对图像识别和模拟操作技术感兴趣，可学习其实现。

en.tag: One-click Arknights daily task assistant, auto-grind all clients
en.what: MAA is an image-recognition-based assistant for Arknights that automates daily tasks like auto-battles, base management, and recruitment. It simulates user operations to enable one-click idle farming, saving time and effort.

en.hot: As a popular Arknights assistant, MAA's high automation and active community updates have earned 22,988 stars, with 762 added this month, ranking #21 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Arknights players who want to automate daily tasks and save time with one-click farming.
Game automation enthusiasts interested in image recognition and simulated input techniques.
Developers seeking to integrate game assist features via provided multi-language APIs.

zh.tag: Windows 桌面网速与硬件监控悬浮窗
zh.what: TrafficMonitor 是一款 Windows 平台的小巧悬浮窗软件，实时显示网速、CPU 和内存利用率，支持嵌入任务栏、更换皮肤及历史流量统计。它提供标准版和 Lite 版，Lite 版无需管理员权限，适合日常使用。

zh.hot: 拥有 46k+ star，长期受 Windows 用户欢迎，因其轻量实用且持续更新，今日新增 19 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 20 名。

需要嵌入任务栏显示系统状态，保持桌面整洁的用户
喜欢自定义桌面皮肤，追求个性化监控界面的用户
开发者和技术爱好者学习 C++ 桌面应用开发与系统监控实现

en.tag: Desktop widget for network speed, CPU & memory monitoring on Windows
en.what: TrafficMonitor is a lightweight desktop widget for Windows that displays real-time network speed, CPU and memory usage. It supports taskbar embedding, custom skins, and historical traffic statistics. Available in Standard and Lite editions, the Lite version requires no admin privileges for everyday use.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, precompiled releases (Standard and Lite), detailed README and Wiki documentation, screenshots, and a plugin system, with automated builds via GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, depends on Microsoft Visual C++ runtime, targets Windows, and uses GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
en.hot: With over 46k stars, it remains popular among Windows users for its lightweight utility and active maintenance, gaining 19 stars today and ranking #20 on the C++ daily trending list.

Users who prefer a taskbar-embedded status display to keep the desktop clean
Enthusiasts who enjoy customizing desktop skins for a personalized monitoring interface
Developers and tech enthusiasts learning C++ desktop app development and system monitoring

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。

en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.

Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与插件集合
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方维护的插件规范与插件仓库，定义了 agent 插件如何以独立目录加 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单的形式组织。仓库同时收录了一批面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的官方插件，覆盖代码审查、任务编排、学习记忆等场景。

zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，插件以清单文件加目录结构的形式分发，部分插件依赖 Cursor SDK 与 CLI 能力。整体是围绕 Cursor agent 生态的插件化扩展方案。

uses: Cursor 深度用户：想用官方插件扩展 agent 的代码审查、编排与学习能力

en.tag: Cursor plugin spec and official plugin collection
en.what: This is Cursor's official plugin specification and plugin collection, defining how agent plugins are structured as standalone directories with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest. It also ships a set of official plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products, covering code review, task orchestration, and learning memory.
en.content: Each plugin lives in its own directory at the repo root with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, and the README tabulates name, author, category, and description. It already includes a dozen-plus plugins such as teaching, continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, thermos, create-plugin, ralph-loop, orchestrate, pstack, advisor, and grok-voice.
en.stack: The primary language is TypeScript, and plugins are distributed as manifest files plus directory structures, with some relying on the Cursor SDK and CLI capabilities. Overall it is a plugin-based extension scheme around the Cursor agent ecosystem.

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
