en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.

Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源 Palantir，图原生上下文与可问责基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它支持企业数据接入、上下文图与知识图谱构建，并提供图分析与因果推理，内置完整的决策溯源，确保可解释、可追踪和可信赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档与示例，支持 RDF 和 LPG 多语言图存储，遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理与决策智能模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.8+，依赖图数据库（如 RDF 三元组存储和属性图数据库），集成知识图谱与因果推理库，遵循 W3C 标准，提供开放 API 与 PyPI 分发。
zh.hot: 本月新增超 1 万 star，位居趋势榜第二，因其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，切中高监管领域对可解释、可溯源 AI 的迫切需求，同时强调开放、治理与零厂商锁定。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统提供可靠上下文与决策溯源，满足合规审计要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用 RDF/LPG 标准构建可互操作的知识模型，并进行图分析与推理。
高监管行业（金融、医疗、政务）：要求 AI 决策可解释、可追踪，降低风险并提升信任。
AI 基础设施研究者：探索图原生架构与因果推理在 AI 系统中的应用，构建可问责的智能体。

en.tag: Open-source Palantir for AI agents: graph-native context & accountable AI infrastructure
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds context and knowledge graphs, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance baked in, making AI explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples, supporting polyglot graph storage with RDF and LPG, W3C standards, ontology management, and decision intelligence modules.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.8+, leveraging graph databases (RDF triple stores and property graphs), integrating knowledge graph and causal reasoning libraries, following W3C standards, with open APIs and PyPI distribution.
en.hot: With over 10k stars added this month and ranking #2 on the trending list, it's hot because it positions as the 'open-source Palantir for AI agents', addressing the urgent need for explainable and traceable AI in regulated domains, while emphasizing openness, governance, and zero vendor lock-in.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing reliable context and decision provenance for agent systems to meet compliance and audit requirements.
Knowledge graph developers looking to build interoperable knowledge models using RDF/LPG standards with graph analytics and reasoning.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government) requiring explainable and traceable AI decisions to reduce risk and build trust.
AI infrastructure researchers exploring graph-native architectures and causal reasoning for accountable intelligent agents.

zh.tag: X 平台 For You 信息流核心算法开源
zh.what: 该仓库包含 X（原 Twitter）For You 信息流中决定用户看到哪些帖子的核心代码。它结合用户关注的内容（网络内）和通过机器学习检索发现的内容（网络外），经过过滤和排序后，使用 Transformer 模型对帖子进行排名。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统架构文档、请求路径和标注路径说明，以及多个组件目录，如 home-mixer（含评分器、过滤器、参数）、可见性过滤、模型训练代码和合成数据生成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，涉及机器学习模型（如 Transformer）、参数配置、过滤逻辑和实验框架。依赖包括用于模型训练的 Phoenix 模型相关代码。
zh.hot: 作为 X 平台核心算法的开源实现，吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标超过 3.2 万，月榜第 11 名。其透明化举措和近期更新（如巴西选举过滤）引发热议。
uses: 对推荐系统、信息流排序感兴趣的开发者，可研究其架构和实现细节。
希望了解 X 平台内容过滤和排名机制的研究者或记者。
需要参考大规模生产级算法工程实践的工程师。

en.tag: Open-source core algorithm powering X's For You feed
en.what: This repository contains the core code that determines which posts a viewer sees in the For You feed on X. It combines in-network content from followed accounts with out-of-network content discovered via ML-based retrieval, filters based on various inputs, and ranks posts using a transformer model.
en.content: The repo includes system architecture docs, request and labeling path explanations, and component directories like home-mixer (with scorers, filters, params), visibility filtering, model training code, and synthetic data generation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, involving ML models (e.g., Transformer), parameter configuration, filtering logic, and experimentation frameworks. Dependencies include Phoenix model training code and synthetic data generation.
en.hot: As the open-source implementation of X's core algorithm, it has attracted significant attention with over 32k stars, ranking 11th on the monthly trending. Its transparency and recent updates (e.g., Brazil election filter) spark discussions.
uses: Developers interested in recommendation systems and feed ranking can study its architecture and implementation details.
Researchers or journalists wanting to understand X's content filtering and ranking mechanisms.
Engineers seeking reference for large-scale production-grade algorithm engineering practices.

zh.tag: 一个菜单栏图标，替代十几个付费 Mac 应用
zh.what: Vorssaint 是一个免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具包，将音量控制、系统监控、窗口管理等多种实用功能整合到一个菜单栏图标中。它旨在替代多个付费应用，提供简洁统一的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Swift 项目源码，包括菜单栏面板（如混音器、系统监控、窗口控制）、文档、CI 配置和发布资源。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，面向 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon，采用 GPL-3.0 许可证，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1.1 万星，总星数达 1.5 万，因其免费开源、功能强大且替代多个付费应用而广受欢迎，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 希望减少付费 Mac 应用数量、追求性价比的用户
需要快速访问音量、系统监控和窗口管理的效率工作者
对开源和隐私保护有要求的 macOS 用户

en.tag: One menu bar icon replacing a dozen paid Mac apps
en.what: Vorssaint is a free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume control, system monitoring, window management, and other utilities into a single menu bar icon. It aims to replace multiple paid apps with a clean, unified experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full Swift project source, including menu bar panels (mixer, system monitor, window controls), documentation, CI config, and release assets.
en.stack: Built with Swift, targeting macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, licensed under GPL-3.0, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Gained 11k stars this month, reaching 15k total, popular for being free, open-source, and replacing multiple paid apps, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users wanting to reduce paid Mac apps and seek cost-effectiveness
Productivity workers needing quick access to volume, system monitoring, and window controls
macOS users who value open-source and privacy

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 开源基础模型研发框架，从数据到训练全流程开放
zh.what: Marin 是一个面向基础模型研发的开源研究计划、软件平台与社区，核心关注大语言模型的训练。它覆盖数据整理、转换、过滤、分词、预训练、后训练与评估的完整流程，并公开分享构建模型所需的全部过程知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含训练与数据处理代码、实验配置（如 marin/experiments）、预训练数据集管线（Nemotron-CC、StarCoderData、ProofPile 2 等），以及 Delphi 缩放套件的配方代码与检查点。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，围绕大模型预训练/后训练流程构建，依赖 Google TPU Research Cloud 等算力，检查点发布在 Hugging Face。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2360 star、总数达 3566，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 17 名，反映出社区对开放、可复现基础模型研发流程的高度关注。
uses: 基础模型研究者 —— 需要可复现的预训练与后训练实验框架
数据工程团队 —— 构建与复现大规模训练数据混合管线
开源 AI 社区成员 —— 学习并参与开放开发的前沿模型训练
缩放定律研究者 —— 使用 Delphi 套件做小模型预测大模型

en.tag: Open-source framework for end-to-end foundation model R&D
en.what: Marin is an open-source research program, software platform, and community for foundation model R&D, focused on training large language models. It spans data curation, transformation, filtering, tokenization, pretraining, posttraining, and evaluation, while openly sharing all process knowledge behind the models.
en.content: The repo contains training and data-processing code, experiment configs (e.g. marin/experiments), pretraining dataset pipelines (Nemotron-CC, StarCoderData, ProofPile 2), and recipe code plus checkpoints for the Delphi scaling suite.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built around LLM pretraining/posttraining workflows, leveraging compute such as Google TPU Research Cloud, with checkpoints released on Hugging Face.
en.hot: It gained 2,360 stars this month for a total of 3,566, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending monthly, reflecting strong community interest in open, reproducible foundation model R&D.
uses: Foundation model researchers — needing reproducible pretraining and posttraining experiment frameworks
Data engineering teams — building and reproducing large-scale training data mixture pipelines
Open-source AI community members — learning from and contributing to open frontier model training
Scaling law researchers — using the Delphi suite to predict larger models from smaller ones

zh.tag: 在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 利用 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施，在 macOS 上启动虚拟 iPhone。它自动化了从下载固件、修补引导链到 DFU 恢复和首次启动的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含命令行工具 vphone-cli、用于管理虚拟机的子命令（vm、fw、restore、cfw 等），以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 编写，依赖 Python、aria2、wget、openssl、libusb 等工具，通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 周榜排名第 8，本周新增近 2000 star，总 star 过万，因其能在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的突破性能力而备受关注。
uses: iOS 开发者和安全研究人员，希望在 Mac 上快速启动虚拟 iPhone 进行测试。
对 iOS 内部机制感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施。
需要多设备测试环境的人员，可通过克隆快速创建多个虚拟 iPhone。

en.tag: CLI tool to boot a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: vphone-cli leverages Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure to boot a virtual iPhone on macOS. It automates the entire pipeline from firmware download, boot chain patching, DFU restore, to first boot.
en.content: The repository includes the vphone-cli command-line tool, subcommands for VM management (vm, fw, restore, cfw, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Swift, with dependencies on Python, aria2, wget, openssl, libusb, etc., installed via Homebrew.
en.hot: Ranked #8 on GitHub Trending this week with ~2000 new stars, surpassing 10k total, it gains attention for its groundbreaking ability to run a virtual iPhone on a Mac.
uses: iOS developers and security researchers who want to spin up virtual iPhones on a Mac for testing.
Tech enthusiasts interested in iOS internals, exploring PCC research VM infrastructure.
Those needing multiple test devices, can quickly clone virtual iPhones for parallel testing.

zh.tag: 邮箱账号关联查询 OSINT 工具
zh.what: holehe 是一个 OSINT 工具，用于检查邮箱是否在 Twitter、Instagram 等 120 多个网站上注册过账号。它利用“忘记密码”功能来获取相关信息，且不会向目标邮箱发送任何通知。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包和命令行工具，支持通过 PyPI、GitHub 或 Docker 安装。提供 CLI 和 Python API，模块化设计，每个模块返回标准化的 JSON 格式数据。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3，使用 trio 和 httpx 进行异步 HTTP 请求，依赖少量第三方库。
zh.hot: star 数达 12k+，今日新增 195，因其在 OSINT 和隐私研究领域的高效性和隐蔽性而广受欢迎。
uses: 安全研究人员进行账号枚举和足迹分析
隐私保护者检查自己的邮箱暴露范围
调查记者或社工场景下的信息收集
开发者集成到自定义 OSINT 工具链

en.tag: OSINT tool to check email registrations across sites
en.what: holehe is an OSINT tool that checks if an email is registered on over 120 websites like Twitter and Instagram. It retrieves information via the forgotten password function without alerting the target email.
en.content: The repo contains a Python package and CLI tool, installable via PyPI, GitHub, or Docker. It offers both CLI and Python API, with modular design returning standardized JSON data.
en.stack: Built on Python 3, uses trio and httpx for async HTTP requests, with minimal third-party dependencies.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 195 new today, it's popular for its efficiency and stealth in OSINT and privacy research.
uses: Security researchers for account enumeration and footprinting
Privacy-conscious individuals checking their email exposure
Investigative journalists or social engineering info gathering
Developers integrating into custom OSINT pipelines

zh.tag: 数学视频动画引擎，3Blue1Brown 出品
zh.what: Manim 是一个用于创建精确编程动画的引擎，专为制作解释性数学视频而设计。它由 3Blue1Brown 的作者开发，用于制作其 YouTube 视频中的动画。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ManimGL 的源代码，包括核心动画模块、场景类、图形对象和渲染器。还提供了示例场景和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，依赖 FFmpeg、OpenGL 和可选的 LaTeX。Linux 系统需要 Pango。

uses: 数学教育者：制作教学视频中的动画演示
视频创作者：为科普内容添加精确的数学动画
开发者：学习或扩展动画引擎，定制自己的数学可视化

en.tag: Animation engine for explanatory math videos by 3Blue1Brown
en.what: Manim is an engine for precise programmatic animations, designed for creating explanatory math videos. It was developed by the author of 3Blue1Brown for animating those videos.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for ManimGL, including core animation modules, scene classes, mobjects, and renderers. It also includes example scenes and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, with dependencies on FFmpeg, OpenGL, and optional LaTeX. Pango is required on Linux.
en.hot: As the official tool of 3Blue1Brown, it has nearly 90k stars, with 381 stars added today, continuing to attract math educators and video creators.

Video creators: add precise math animations to science content
Developers: learn or extend the animation engine for custom math visualizations

zh.tag: 把人的思维方式蒸馏成 Agent 可复用的技能档案
zh.what: Distilly 是一个本地优先的工具，用于将一个人的原始材料、工作习惯、判断力和表达风格转化为带版本管理的“Agent 人物档案”。这些档案可以在运行期间临时调用，也可以作为长期的主机技能安装，存储权始终保留在本地，无需额外的模型 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、插件系统以及多个主机兼容层（如 Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes）。默认分支为 distilly-plugin，提供开发者预览版，包含五个 MCP 工具，并支持多语言文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，要求 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，构建后通过 CLI 与 MCP 协议集成到 Codex 等宿主。
zh.hot: 24k+ stars，本月新增 3741，因其将个人知识蒸馏为 Agent 技能的理念新颖，且本地优先、无需额外 API key，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 希望将个人工作方法沉淀为 AI 助手可复用技能的开发者或知识工作者
需要为团队或客户创建定制化 Agent 行为档案的 AI 应用构建者
对本地优先、数据自主可控的 AI 工具链感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Distill how people think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot
en.what: Distilly is a local-first tool that turns a person's source material, working habits, judgment, and voice into a versioned 'Person Profile for Agents'. The profile can be recalled temporarily during a run or installed as a long-lived host Skill, with storage authority staying local and no extra model API key required.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, plugin system, and compatibility layers for multiple hosts (Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes). The default branch is distilly-plugin, offering a Developer Preview with five MCP tools and multi-language docs.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js 22.19+ or 24, uses pnpm for dependencies, and integrates with hosts like Codex via CLI and MCP protocol.
en.hot: With 24k+ stars and 3,741 added this month, it's hot for its novel concept of distilling personal knowledge into Agent skills, plus local-first design and no extra API key needed.
uses: Developers or knowledge workers who want to turn personal working methods into reusable AI assistant skills
AI application builders who need to create customized agent behavior profiles for teams or clients
Tech enthusiasts interested in local-first, data-sovereign AI toolchains

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个一站式 AI 短视频生成工具，用户只需提供主题或关键词，它就能自动完成脚本撰写、素材匹配、字幕生成、背景音乐合成，最终输出高清短视频。它支持 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，适合快速批量制作视频内容。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 项目源码，提供 WebUI 图形界面和 API 服务，内置视频生成工作流，支持多种素材源和 AI 模型接入，并附带详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成，使用自动化工作流处理素材下载、字幕生成和视频合成，支持跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux）。
zh.hot: 凭借 12 万+ Star 和月增近 2 万的热度，它精准切中短视频创作者对高效内容生产的需求，将复杂的视频制作流程简化为一次点击，极大降低了创作门槛。
uses: 短视频创作者：快速将热点话题或关键词转化为成片，提升内容产出效率。
自媒体运营者：批量生成不同主题的视频，用于多平台分发和测试。
营销人员：制作产品宣传或广告短视频，无需专业视频编辑技能。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或流程中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI short video generator. Users only need to provide a topic or keyword, and it automatically handles script writing, footage matching, subtitle generation, background music synthesis, and outputs HD short videos. It offers both WebUI and API interfaces, enabling rapid batch video production.
en.content: The repository contains complete Python source code, offering a WebUI and API service with a built-in video generation workflow. It supports multiple footage sources and AI model integrations, along with detailed documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, leveraging AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script generation, and using automated workflows for footage downloading, subtitle creation, and video composition. Cross-platform support for Windows/macOS/Linux.
en.hot: With over 120K stars and nearly 20K monthly additions, it addresses the high demand for efficient short-video creation, simplifying complex production into one click and drastically lowering the barrier for creators.
uses: Short-video creators: Quickly turn trending topics or keywords into finished videos to boost productivity.
Social media managers: Batch-generate videos on various themes for multi-platform distribution and testing.
Marketers: Create promotional or ad videos without professional editing skills.
Developers: Integrate the API into custom applications or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 本地运行与训练大模型和扩散模型的桌面应用
zh.what: Unsloth 是一个本地优先的 AI 工具，允许用户在个人电脑上运行和训练大型语言模型（LLM）和扩散模型。它支持包括 Qwen3.8、Kimi K3、MiniMax-H3、Gemma 4、DeepSeek-V4 和 FLUX 在内的多种模型，并提供桌面应用和命令行安装方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）、命令行安装脚本、文档和示例笔记本。核心功能是模型运行、训练和部署，并支持与 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 等代理工具集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构。桌面应用可能使用 Electron 或类似技术打包。
zh.hot: Unsloth 因提供本地运行和训练 AI 模型的便捷方式而广受欢迎，star 数已达 7 万，日增 592，反映了用户对隐私和本地控制的需求。
uses: AI 开发者和研究者：在本地快速实验和微调模型，无需云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望数据不出本地，避免云端泄露风险。
教育者与学生：学习模型训练和推理，无需昂贵硬件。
代理工具用户：将本地模型与 Claude Code、Codex 等集成，构建自动化工作流。

en.tag: Local desktop app to run and train LLMs and diffusion models
en.what: Unsloth is a local-first AI tool that lets users run and train large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models on their own hardware. It supports a wide range of models including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, and FLUX, and offers a desktop app as well as command-line installation.
en.content: The repository contains desktop app installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux, command-line install scripts, documentation, and example notebooks. Core features include model running, training, and deployment, with integrations for agent tools like Claude Code, Codex, and MCP.
en.stack: Built with Python, relying on deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, supporting multiple model architectures. The desktop app is likely packaged with Electron or similar technology.
en.hot: Unsloth is popular for providing a convenient way to run and train AI models locally, with 70k stars and 592 new stars today, reflecting the demand for privacy and local control.
uses: AI developers and researchers: quickly experiment and fine-tune models locally without cloud services.
Privacy-conscious users: keep data on-device to avoid cloud leaks.
Educators and students: learn model training and inference without expensive hardware.
Agent tool users: integrate local models with Claude Code, Codex, etc., for automated workflows.

zh.tag: 双节点 DGX Spark 上跑 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的部署配方
zh.what: 这是一个在双节点 DGX Spark 上运行 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 模型的完整部署方案。它利用 vLLM 和张量并行（TP=2）以及 DSpark 投机解码，支持高达 1M token 的上下文，并原生支持图像输入。该项目提供了详细的配置、脚本和文档，帮助用户在特定硬件上实现高效推理。
zh.content: 仓库包含环境配置模板（.env.dspark）、启动脚本、结果记录（results/）以及模型和编码器的详细文档（docs/）。它基于 Anemll 的 dspark-vllm-gx10 容器镜像，并包含针对图像支持的启动热修复。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Python、vLLM、NCCL/RoCE 网络、Docker（Anemll 镜像），以及 DGX Spark 硬件。依赖项包括 HuggingFace 模型权重、NFS 挂载选项和特定的环境变量配置。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，月增 809 星，总星数达 1270，反映出社区对在消费级硬件上运行前沿视觉语言模型的浓厚兴趣。它提供了在双节点 DGX Spark 上部署 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的实用指南，填补了官方文档与实际操作之间的空白。
uses: 需要在 DGX Spark 集群上部署 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的开发者或研究人员
对 vLLM 和投机解码优化感兴趣的技术爱好者
希望利用多节点推理处理长上下文或图像输入的用户

en.tag: A deployment recipe for DeepSeek-V4-Flash on 2x DGX Spark nodes
en.what: This is a complete deployment recipe for running DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp on a two-node DGX Spark cluster. It leverages vLLM with tensor parallelism (TP=2) and DSpark speculative decoding to support up to 1M-token context and native image input. The project provides detailed configuration, scripts, and documentation for efficient inference on this specific hardware.
en.content: The repo contains environment config templates (.env.dspark), launch scripts, results logs (results/), and detailed docs on the model and encoder (docs/). It builds on Anemll's dspark-vllm-gx10 container image and includes a startup hotfix for image support.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Python, vLLM, NCCL/RoCE networking, Docker (Anemll image), and DGX Spark hardware. Dependencies include HuggingFace model weights, NFS mount options, and specific environment variable configurations.
en.hot: This project gained rapid traction with 809 stars added this month (total 1270), reflecting strong community interest in running cutting-edge vision-language models on accessible hardware. It offers a practical guide for deploying DeepSeek-V4-Flash on dual DGX Spark nodes, bridging the gap between official docs and real-world setup.
uses: Developers or researchers needing to deploy DeepSeek-V4-Flash on DGX Spark clusters
Tech enthusiasts interested in vLLM and speculative decoding optimizations
Users who want to handle long-context or image inputs with multi-node inference

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 全栈 AI 红队平台，守护 AI 生态安全

uses: 安全研究人员：用于评估 AI 系统的安全性，发现潜在漏洞。
AI 开发者：在开发过程中集成安全测试，确保 AI 应用合规。
企业安全团队：部署平台以监控和保护 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems
en.what: AI-Infra-Guard is a full-stack AI red teaming platform that scans and evaluates the security of AI ecosystems. It supports agent scanning, skills scanning, MCP scanning, AI infrastructure scanning, and LLM jailbreak evaluation to uncover potential vulnerabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code, including scanners, evaluation modules, documentation, and Docker images. It offers multi-language READMEs (Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, etc.) and integrates with tools like ClawHub and OpenClaw.

AI developers: to integrate security testing during development and ensure compliance.
Enterprise security teams: to deploy the platform for monitoring and protecting AI infrastructure.

产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码

Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: 面向企业的大规模 LLM/VLM 强化学习后训练框架

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端

en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.

Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。

需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。

开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.
en.hot: BookOrbit is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub with 248 stars today and 2,613 total, thanks to its self-hosted nature, cross-device sync, and rich feature set.
uses: Reading enthusiasts who prefer self-hosted services and want full control over their book data.
Users who need seamless reading progress sync across devices like Kobo and KOReader.
Privacy-conscious individuals who want to avoid relying on commercial cloud services.
Developers or tech enthusiasts looking to extend or customize their reading platform.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理轻松调用上万网页抓取工具的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Apify MCP 服务器是一个中间层，将 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor）与 Apify Store 上数千个现成的爬虫和自动化工具连接起来。它支持通过 OAuth 从 Claude.ai 或 VS Code 等客户端直接连接，并支持流式 HTTP 传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器的 TypeScript 源码、文档、配置示例，以及指向托管服务 mcp.apify.com 的说明。还支持代理支付（agentic payments）和多种客户端集成。

zh.hot: 本月新增 3473 星，总星数达 6086，跻身 TypeScript 趋势榜第 16 名。AI 代理需要实时网页数据，而 Apify 提供了现成的抓取工具，正好满足需求。

使用 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端的用户，需要从社交媒体、电商等网站提取结构化数据。
需要自动化数据采集流程，并希望与 AI 工作流集成的团队。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to use thousands of web scrapers via Apify
en.what: The Apify MCP server is a middleware that connects AI agents (like Claude, Cursor) to thousands of ready-made scrapers and automation tools on Apify Store. It supports OAuth for connecting from clients like Claude.ai or VS Code, and uses Streamable HTTP transport.

en.hot: Gained 3473 stars this month, reaching 6086 total, ranking #16 on TypeScript trending. AI agents need real-time web data, and Apify offers ready-made scrapers, perfectly meeting the demand.
uses: Developers who want to add web scraping capabilities to AI agents without writing crawlers themselves.
Users of MCP clients like Claude or Cursor who need structured data from social media, e-commerce, etc.
Teams that need to automate data collection and integrate it with AI workflows.

zh.tag: 本地 GPU 驱动的图像/文字转 3D 模型桌面应用
zh.what: Modly 是一款开源的桌面应用，利用本地 AI 模型将照片或文字提示转换为 3D 网格模型。所有处理均在本地 GPU 上完成，无需云端服务，支持 Windows、Linux 和 Apple Silicon macOS。

对数据隐私敏感的用户，希望本地处理而不上传云端
AI 爱好者和研究者，探索图像转 3D 模型技术

en.tag: Desktop app for local GPU-powered image/prompt to 3D mesh generation
en.what: Modly is an open-source desktop app that converts photos or text prompts into 3D mesh models using local AI models. All processing runs entirely on your GPU, no cloud needed, supporting Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS.

Privacy-conscious users who prefer local processing over cloud uploads
AI enthusiasts and researchers exploring image-to-3D model generation

en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.

Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript

zh.tag: 用稳定命名本地URL替代端口号，面向开发者和AI代理
zh.what: Portless 是一个开发工具，让你用像 https://myapp.localhost 这样的稳定命名 URL 替代 localhost:3000 之类的端口号。它自动管理 HTTPS、端口分配和代理，简化本地开发体验，尤其适合人类和 AI 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个命令行工具，通过全局或项目依赖安装。它生成本地 CA、绑定 443 端口并启动代理，自动将命名 URL 路由到分配的端口，支持多种框架和配置选项。
zh.stack: 主要用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 生态，通过 npm 分发。涉及 HTTPS/HTTP2、代理、进程管理等技术。
zh.hot: 今日新增 450 星，总星数 12052，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了开发中端口记忆和冲突的痛点，并迎合了 AI 代理对稳定 URL 的需求。
uses: 本地开发人员：告别端口号，使用易记的命名 URL 访问多个项目。
AI 代理开发者：为代理提供稳定的本地端点，便于自动化测试和交互。
团队协作：统一开发环境，减少端口冲突和配置问题。

en.tag: Replace port numbers with stable named local URLs for dev and agents
en.what: Portless is a dev tool that replaces port numbers with stable named URLs like https://myapp.localhost. It automatically handles HTTPS, port assignment, and proxying, simplifying local development for both humans and AI agents.
en.content: The repo contains a CLI tool installable globally or as a project dependency. It generates a local CA, binds port 443, and starts a proxy that routes named URLs to assigned ports, with support for many frameworks and configuration options.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, distributed via npm, leveraging Node.js ecosystem. Involves HTTPS/HTTP2, proxying, and process management.
en.hot: Gained 450 stars today, total 12052, trending on GitHub. It solves the pain of remembering and conflicting ports, and caters to AI agents needing stable URLs.
uses: Local developers: replace port numbers with memorable named URLs for multiple projects.
AI agent developers: provide stable local endpoints for agents to automate testing and interaction.
Team collaboration: unify dev environment, reduce port conflicts and configuration issues.

zh.tag: 浏览器内高性能 LLM 推理引擎，基于 WebGPU 加速
zh.what: WebLLM 是一个把大语言模型推理直接搬进浏览器的引擎，无需服务器支持，全部计算在本地完成并借助 WebGPU 硬件加速。它完全兼容 OpenAI API，让你用同一套接口在本地跑任意开源模型，支持流式输出、JSON 模式和函数调用等能力。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，核心是可在 npm 上安装的 @mlc-ai/web-llm 包，并附带 examples 示例目录、文档与配套的 WebLLM Chat 应用。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，底层依赖 WebGPU 做硬件加速，并包含 WebAssembly 模块用于高性能结构化 JSON 生成，是 MLC LLM 的配套项目。
zh.hot: 凭借“浏览器里直接跑大模型”的隐私友好与零服务器成本理念，加上 WebGPU 带来的性能突破，该项目已收获约 1.9 万 star，本月新增 535，稳居 TypeScript 月榜第 15 名。
uses: 想构建隐私优先、无需后端 AI 应用的 Web 开发者
需要在浏览器内本地运行开源模型的研究与原型团队
希望用 OpenAI API 兼容接口快速接入本地模型的产品团队
对 WebGPU 加速推理与端侧 AI 感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: High-performance in-browser LLM inference engine powered by WebGPU
en.what: WebLLM is an engine that brings LLM inference directly into the browser, running entirely client-side with no server support and accelerated by WebGPU. It is fully compatible with the OpenAI API, letting you run any open-source model locally with streaming, JSON mode, and function calling.
en.content: The repo is written in TypeScript and centers on the npm package @mlc-ai/web-llm, accompanied by an examples directory, documentation, and the companion WebLLM Chat app.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it relies on WebGPU for hardware acceleration and includes WebAssembly modules for high-performance structured JSON generation, as a companion project to MLC LLM.
en.hot: With its privacy-friendly, zero-server approach to running LLMs directly in the browser and WebGPU-driven performance gains, it has reached about 19k stars, adding 535 this month and ranking 15th on the TypeScript monthly trending list.
uses: Web developers building privacy-first AI apps without a backend
Researchers and prototypers who need to run open-source models locally in the browser
Product teams wanting to plug local models in via an OpenAI-compatible API
Enthusiasts interested in WebGPU-accelerated inference and on-device AI

zh.tag: 用属性在HTML中直接实现AJAX、CSS过渡、WebSocket和SSE的轻量库
zh.what: htmx 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 库，允许你直接在 HTML 中使用属性（如 hx-post、hx-swap）来发起 AJAX 请求、应用 CSS 过渡、使用 WebSocket 和服务器发送事件。它旨在通过扩展 HTML 的超文本能力，简化现代用户界面的构建，让你无需编写大量 JavaScript 代码即可实现动态交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含 htmx 的源代码、文档网站、示例、扩展（如 ws、sse）以及贡献指南。核心是一个约 14k min.gz'd 的 JavaScript 文件，可通过 CDN 或 npm 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，无外部依赖。开发依赖包括 Node.js 和 npm，用于本地开发和测试。
zh.hot: htmx 因其极简的编程模型而广受欢迎，让开发者无需编写复杂 JavaScript 即可实现现代交互。尽管今日新增 star 不多（32），但总星数已接近 5 万，反映出其在开发者社区中的持续热度。
uses: 后端开发者希望用简单方式增强 HTML 页面交互，而不想写大量前端 JS
全栈开发者寻求轻量级替代 React/Vue 的方案，用于快速原型或小型项目
喜欢 HATEOAS 和超媒体理念的开发者，希望构建符合 REST 架构的 Web 应用

en.tag: A lightweight library that lets you use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML with attributes
en.what: htmx is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library that allows you to use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML using attributes like hx-post and hx-swap. It aims to simplify building modern user interfaces by extending HTML's hypertext capabilities, enabling dynamic interactions without writing much JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of htmx, documentation website, examples, extensions (like ws, sse), and contribution guidelines. The core is a ~14k min.gz'd JavaScript file that can be installed via CDN or npm.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript with no external dependencies. Development dependencies include Node.js and npm for local development and testing.
en.hot: htmx is popular for its minimalist programming model, allowing developers to implement modern interactions without writing complex JavaScript. Although today's new stars are modest (32), the total star count is approaching 50k, reflecting its sustained popularity in the developer community.
uses: Backend developers who want to enhance HTML page interactions in a simple way without writing lots of frontend JS
Full-stack developers seeking a lightweight alternative to React/Vue for quick prototypes or small projects
Developers who embrace HATEOAS and hypermedia principles to build RESTful web applications

zh.tag: Spotify 客户端命令行定制工具
zh.what: 这是一个命令行工具，用于深度定制 Spotify 桌面客户端。它允许用户更改界面颜色、注入 CSS、扩展功能和自定义应用，从而完全掌控 Spotify 的外观和体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具本身，提供安装、基本使用和高级定制功能，如颜色主题、CSS 注入、扩展和自定义应用。
zh.stack: 主要用 JavaScript 编写，但底层使用 Go 语言（根据 Go Report Card 徽章），支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 拥有 24.4k 星标，今日新增 22 星，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。因其强大的定制能力和跨平台支持，长期受到 Spotify 高级用户的青睐。
uses: 希望个性化 Spotify 界面的普通用户，可以更改主题颜色和注入自定义 CSS。
开发者或高级用户，通过注入扩展和自定义应用来增强 Spotify 功能或集成其他服务。
对音乐流媒体定制感兴趣的技术爱好者，探索客户端深度定制可能性。

en.tag: Command-line tool to customize Spotify client
en.what: A command-line tool to deeply customize the official Spotify desktop client. It enables users to change UI colors, inject CSS, extend functionality, and add custom apps, giving full control over Spotify's look and feel.
en.content: The repository contains the CLI tool itself, offering installation, basic usage, and advanced customization features like color themes, CSS injection, extensions, and custom apps.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, but underlying Go language (per Go Report Card badge), supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With 24.4k stars and 22 new today, ranking #8 on JavaScript trending. Its powerful customization and cross-platform support keep it popular among power users.
uses: Regular users wanting to personalize Spotify's UI, by changing theme colors and injecting custom CSS.
Developers or power users who extend Spotify functionality or integrate other services via extensions and custom apps.
Tech enthusiasts interested in deep customization of music streaming clients.

zh.tag: 开源看板项目管理工具，实时协作
zh.what: PLANKA 是一款看板风格的项目管理工具，提供直观的拖拽界面来管理项目、看板、列表和卡片。它支持实时同步、Markdown 编辑和灵活的通知，适合团队协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的看板应用代码，包括前端界面、后端 API、数据库模型，以及 Docker 部署配置。还提供了文档、演示和 API 文档链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Node.js 和 React 构建，使用 PostgreSQL 作为数据库，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 12k+ 星标，本周新增 102，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜。其自托管、实时协作和丰富功能吸引了大量用户。
uses: 团队项目管理，使用看板视图跟踪任务进度
个人任务管理，自托管部署保护数据隐私
需要实时协作和 Markdown 支持的项目团队
希望替代商业看板工具的开源用户

en.tag: Open-source Kanban project management with real-time collaboration
en.what: PLANKA is a Kanban-style project management tool with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for managing projects, boards, lists, and cards. It features real-time sync, Markdown editing, and flexible notifications for team collaboration.
en.content: The repository contains the full Kanban app code, including frontend UI, backend API, database models, and Docker deployment configs. Links to docs, demo, and API docs are also provided.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js and React, uses PostgreSQL for database, supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 102 added this week, it's on GitHub Trending weekly. Its self-hosted, real-time collaboration and rich features attract many users.
uses: Team project management with Kanban view for tracking tasks
Personal task management with self-hosted deployment for data privacy
Teams needing real-time collaboration and Markdown support
Open-source users looking to replace commercial Kanban tools

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 在终端里运行的真实浏览器，让 AI 代理直接上网
zh.what: terminal-browser 是一个在终端内运行的真实浏览器，基于 Chromium 渲染，支持鼠标键盘交互。它允许 AI 编码代理与浏览器同处一个终端标签页，代理可完全控制浏览器进行网页操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、快捷键、命令面板、开发者工具等，并支持 SSH 远程浏览和分屏视图。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Electron 的离屏渲染 API，利用终端图形协议（如 kitty graphics protocol）显示像素。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1864 星，总星数达 2710，因其让 AI 代理无缝使用网络而迅速走红。
uses: AI 编码代理需要浏览网页或与网站交互的场景
开发者想在终端内快速预览网页或远程服务器上的站点
需要将浏览器与编码环境集成在同一界面的高级用户

en.tag: A real browser inside your terminal, giving AI agents full web access
en.what: terminal-browser is a real browser that runs inside your terminal, rendered by Chromium with full mouse and keyboard interaction. It enables AI coding agents to share the same terminal tab and fully control the browser for web tasks.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust CLI tool with installation scripts, keyboard shortcuts, command palette, devtools, SSH support, and split-pane views.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Electron's offscreen rendering API, using terminal graphics protocols like kitty to display pixels.
en.hot: Gained 1864 stars this month (total 2710), trending due to its unique capability of giving AI agents seamless web access.
uses: AI coding agents that need to browse the web or interact with websites
Developers who want to preview web pages or remote sites quickly inside the terminal
Power users who want a browser integrated into their coding environment

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时，秒级启动隔离环境
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的轻量级微虚拟机运行时，能在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不可信代码，如 AI 代理、用户脚本、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，同时保持 Docker 类似的工作流，启动时间平均低于 100 毫秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、示例、Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成，以及用于构建和发布的配置。核心是一个可嵌入的库，允许在代码中直接生成虚拟机，无需守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编程语言，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和不可信代码执行需求的增长，开发者需要快速、安全的隔离方案。Microsandbox 提供了低于 100 毫秒的启动时间和硬件级隔离，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，本月新增 959 星，总星数达 8021。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行用户代码或插件。
CI/CD 工程师：在隔离环境中运行测试或构建任务，防止恶意代码影响主机。
安全研究人员：分析不可信二进制或脚本，利用硬件隔离降低风险。
平台工程师：将微虚拟机嵌入应用，实现多租户隔离或动态代码执行。

en.tag: Fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads
en.what: Microsandbox is a lightweight microVM runtime written in Rust that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, CI jobs, and automation. It offers hardware-level isolation with Docker-like workflows and average boot times under 100 milliseconds.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, examples, integrations for Agent Skills and MCP server, and build/release configurations. The core is an embeddable library that spawns VMs directly in code without a daemon.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging microVM technology (like Firecracker), supports OCI container images, and is cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and untrusted code execution, developers need fast, secure isolation. Microsandbox offers sub-100ms boot times and hardware-level isolation, quickly gaining traction with 959 stars this month, reaching 8,021 total.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandboxes for agents to execute user code or plugins.
CI/CD engineers: run tests or build tasks in isolated environments to prevent malicious code from affecting the host.
Security researchers: analyze untrusted binaries or scripts with hardware isolation to reduce risk.
Platform engineers: embed microVMs into applications for multi-tenant isolation or dynamic code execution.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Rust 的高性能量化交易平台，采用确定性事件驱动架构，专为生产环境设计。它提供低延迟、高吞吐量的交易执行和回测能力，同时支持 Python 接口，便于策略开发和集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.
Developers: rapid prototyping via Python API or deep customization with Rust.

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，多语言绑定
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供多线程、向量化（SIMD）执行，支持惰性和急切执行，并能处理超过内存大小的数据集。它提供了丰富的表达式 API，支持 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 等多种语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Polars 的核心 Rust 实现、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档以及用于扩展的插件系统。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 编写，利用 Apache Arrow 列式格式实现零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性，Polars 在数据科学社区迅速走红，GitHub 上已获得近 4 万星标，本月新增 441 星，成为 Rust 语言中最受欢迎的 DataFrame 库之一。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师需要快速处理大型数据集，进行数据清洗和探索性分析。
数据工程师构建高效的数据管道，处理超过内存容量的数据。
希望利用 Rust 性能优势同时使用 Python 或 R 进行数据分析的开发者。
需要与 Apache Arrow 生态无缝集成，实现零拷贝数据共享的应用。

en.tag: Blazing-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, lazy and eager evaluation, and the ability to process datasets larger than RAM. It offers an expressive API and bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust implementation, bindings for Python, Node.js, and R, user guides, documentation, and a plugin system for extensibility.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leverages Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional GPU acceleration on NVIDIA GPUs.
en.hot: Polars has gained rapid popularity in the data science community due to its exceptional performance and ease of use, amassing nearly 40k stars on GitHub with 441 new stars this month, making it one of the most popular DataFrame libraries in Rust.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who need to process large datasets quickly for data cleaning and exploratory analysis.
Data engineers building efficient data pipelines that handle datasets larger than memory.
Developers who want to leverage Rust's performance while using Python or R for data analysis.
Applications that require seamless integration with the Apache Arrow ecosystem for zero-copy data sharing.

zh.tag: 为 git/diff/grep 输出提供语法高亮的终端分页器
zh.what: delta 是一个用 Rust 编写的终端分页器，为 git diff、git log、git blame、grep、rg 等输出提供语法高亮和更易读的排版。它通过配置 git 的 pager 即可无缝替换默认的 diff 显示，让代码审查和版本对比更直观。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、用户手册以及大量主题和配置示例，核心是 delta 可执行文件与配套的 git 配置片段。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 syntect 等库实现语法高亮，通过 git 的 pager 机制集成，支持跨平台安装（cargo、brew、apt 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 32k+ stars 和本月 475 的新增，delta 已成为开发者提升 git 体验的必备工具，在 Rust 月榜排名第 15，持续受到终端用户青睐。
uses: 经常进行代码审查、需要清晰查看 diff 的开发者
希望提升 git log/blame/grep 可读性的终端用户
喜欢自定义终端配色和主题的效率爱好者

en.tag: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep and blame output
en.what: Delta is a Rust-based terminal pager that adds syntax highlighting and cleaner formatting to git diff, git log, git blame, grep, rg and similar outputs. By configuring it as git's pager, it seamlessly replaces the default diff view and makes code review and version comparison far more readable.
en.content: The repository contains the full Rust source code, installation scripts, a user manual, and numerous themes and configuration examples, centered on the delta executable and accompanying git config snippets.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it relies on libraries like syntect for syntax highlighting and integrates via git's pager mechanism, with cross-platform installation through cargo, brew, apt and more.
en.hot: With over 32k stars and 475 added this month, delta has become an essential tool for developers improving their git experience, ranking 15th on the Rust monthly trending list and continuing to win over terminal users.
uses: Developers who frequently review code and need clear diff views
Terminal users wanting more readable git log, blame and grep output
Efficiency enthusiasts who enjoy customizing terminal colors and themes

zh.tag: 团队一体化工作空间：邮件、聊天、文档、任务、代理与 CRM 的 @ 链接共享 AI 记忆
zh.what: Macro 是一个面向团队的一体化工作空间，把邮件、消息、文档、任务、AI 代理、通话和 CRM 整合进一个快速界面。所有内容通过 @ 链接互相关联，并共享团队级 AI 记忆，让团队和代理无需切换工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Macro 的完整产品代码，由 Rust 后端与 SolidJS 前端组成，按「块」模块化设计：邮件、消息、任务、文档、Canvas 等，各表面共享同一后端，交叉引用以双向图原生存储。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建后端，前端采用 SolidJS，文档基于 CRDT 实现实时协作，支持 Markdown 原生编辑与 @ 提及。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3514 颗星，总星数达 4266，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 17 名，反映出市场对「一体化工作操作系统」和 AI 原生团队协作的高度关注。
uses: 初创公司或小团队，希望用一个工具替代 Slack、Notion、Linear、HubSpot 等多套软件
需要 AI 代理深度参与日常协作、并共享团队记忆的工程或产品团队
关注 Rust 与 SolidJS 技术栈、想研究高性能协作软件架构的开发者
希望将邮件、任务、文档和 CRM 数据打通、实现可计算工作流的企业

en.tag: Unified team workspace: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents & CRM @-linked with shared AI memory
en.what: Macro is an all-in-one workspace for teams that unifies email, messages, docs, tasks, AI agents, calls, and CRM into a single fast interface. Everything is @-linked and searchable with shared team-level memory, so teams and their agents never have to switch tools.
en.content: The repo contains Macro's full product code, built with a Rust backend and SolidJS frontend, organized as modular 'blocks': email, messages, tasks, docs, Canvas, and more. Each surface shares the same backend, with cross-references natively stored as a bidirectional graph.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust for the backend, with a SolidJS frontend; docs use CRDTs for real-time collaboration and are markdown-native with @mentions.
en.hot: Gained 3,514 stars this month for a total of 4,266, ranking #17 on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong interest in an all-in-one work OS and AI-native team collaboration.
uses: Startups or small teams wanting one tool to replace Slack, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, and more
Engineering or product teams that need AI agents deeply integrated into daily collaboration with shared memory
Developers interested in Rust and SolidJS who want to study high-performance collaboration software architecture
Companies aiming to connect email, tasks, docs, and CRM data into computable workflows

zh.tag: 一个 CLI 统一管理开发工具、环境变量与任务
zh.what: mise 是一个用 Rust 编写的开发环境管理工具，把工具版本、环境变量和项目任务统一到一个 mise.toml 配置文件中。它让 shell、编辑器和 CI 使用完全一致的开发环境，避免版本漂移。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档站点（docs/）、工具注册表与插件系统，以及用于安装、任务运行、环境加载和机器初始化的各模块。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，发布在 crates.io，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows（winget），通过插件/注册表机制管理数百种开发工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 33,714 颗星和本月新增 1,594 星，mise 登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 18 名，反映出开发者对统一、可复现开发环境的强烈需求。
uses: 希望在不同项目间切换 Node、Python、Go 等工具版本的开发者
需要让本地、CI 与团队环境保持一致的工程团队
想用一份配置同时管理环境变量、任务和机器初始化的用户

en.tag: One CLI to manage dev tools, env vars, and tasks
en.what: mise is a Rust-based development environment manager that unifies tool versions, environment variables, and project tasks in a single mise.toml file. It keeps your shell, editor, and CI on the exact same setup, eliminating version drift.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, a docs site (docs/), the tool registry and plugin system, plus modules for installation, task running, environment loading, and machine bootstrap.
en.stack: Written in Rust and published on crates.io, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows (winget), managing hundreds of dev tools via a plugin/registry system.
en.hot: With 33,714 stars and 1,594 added this month, mise ranks 18th on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for unified, reproducible dev environments.
uses: Developers switching between Node, Python, Go, and other tool versions across projects
Engineering teams needing consistent local, CI, and teammate environments
Users who want one config for env vars, tasks, and machine bootstrap

zh.tag: 零配置的终端 IDE，融合 VS Code 与 Sublime 的体验
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能全面的终端文本编辑器，主打零配置，提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，无需学习曲线。它专为处理超大文件而优化，性能卓越。

uses: 适合喜欢在终端中工作但不想学习复杂快捷键的开发者，如 Vim/Emacs 新手。
需要处理超大文件（如日志文件）的开发者，Fresh 能高效加载。
希望获得 IDE 级功能（如 LSP、多光标）但偏好轻量级工具的用户。
对 Rust 和终端 UI 开发感兴趣的贡献者。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE blending VS Code & Sublime UX
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor with zero configuration, offering familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features without a learning curve. It is optimized for handling huge files with high performance.
en.content: The repository includes the editor's core code, installation scripts, documentation, and demo GIFs, featuring command palette, multi-cursor editing, themes, LSP support, and the Orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP protocol, cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 607 stars this month, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending Rust. Its zero-config, ease of use, and high performance attract developers, especially terminal editor enthusiasts.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal work but dislike steep learning curves, e.g., Vim/Emacs beginners.
Those handling huge files (e.g., logs) that need efficient loading.
Users wanting IDE-level features (LSP, multi-cursor) in a lightweight tool.
Contributors interested in Rust and terminal UI development.

zh.tag: 本地优先的跨平台个人 AI 超级智能体
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一款面向 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 的开源个人 AI，强调本地优先的记忆能力、智能体编排与深度研究。它把「记住一切的大脑」、编排器和研究员三合一，让个人数据留在本地。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 实现核心，包含 GitBook 文档目录（gitbooks/）与演示截图，并配有 Discord、Reddit、X 等社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供跨平台桌面应用；文档基于 GitBook，社区与分发依托 GitHub Discussions、Discord 与 Product Hunt。

uses: 希望把个人 AI 助手跑在本地、数据不出设备的隐私敏感用户
需要长期记忆与深度研究能力的知识工作者和研究者
想用 Rust 构建或扩展桌面 AI 智能体的开发者

en.tag: A local-first personal AI superintelligence for Mac, Windows and Linux
en.what: OpenHuman is an open source personal AI for Mac, Windows and Linux, built around local-first memory, agent orchestration and deep research. It combines a brain that remembers everything, an orchestrator and a deep researcher into one local-first assistant.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core, a GitBook docs directory (gitbooks/) with demo screenshots, plus community links to Discord, Reddit and X.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust as a cross-platform desktop app; docs are built with GitBook, with community and distribution via GitHub Discussions, Discord and Product Hunt.
en.hot: It landed Product Hunt daily and weekly top-post badges, and has reached 39,586 stars with 3,715 added this month, ranking 20th on the Rust monthly trending list — its local-first privacy pitch rides today's wave.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want a personal AI assistant running locally with data kept on-device
Knowledge workers and researchers needing long-term memory and deep research capabilities
Developers who want to build or extend a desktop AI agent in Rust

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 漫画翻译工具
zh.what: Koharu 是一个基于机器学习的漫画翻译工具，完全在本地运行，保护隐私。它集成了目标检测、OCR、图像修复和 LLM，实现从识别到翻译再到嵌字的自动化流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用，支持多格式项目管理、选择性处理管道、多模态 OCR、本地 GGUF 推理和托管服务、生成式修复、校对、WebGPU 画布、多语言排版以及分层 PSD 导出。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 WebGPU 进行画布渲染，集成 GGUF 格式的本地模型和外部 LLM 提供商，支持多种视觉模型和 OCR 引擎。
zh.hot: 本月新增 510 星，总星数达 5494，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 7。其本地优先、注重隐私的 AI 翻译特性吸引了大量漫画爱好者和开发者。
uses: 漫画翻译爱好者：希望本地自动化翻译漫画，保护隐私且无需上传图片。
独立汉化组：需要高效工具处理批量图片、PDF 和压缩包，并支持校对和排版。
Rust 开发者：对 ML 应用、OCR 和图像处理感兴趣的开发者可学习其架构。

en.tag: Local-first AI manga translator with ML pipeline
en.what: Koharu is an ML-powered manga translator that runs locally for privacy. It combines object detection, OCR, inpainting, and LLMs to automate the translation workflow.
en.content: The repo contains a full desktop app with multi-format project management, selective pipelines, multimodal OCR, local GGUF inference and hosted providers, generative inpainting, proofreading, WebGPU canvas, multilingual typesetting, and layered PSD export.

en.hot: Gained 510 stars this month, reaching 5494 total, ranking #7 on Rust trending. Its local-first, privacy-focused AI translation appeals to manga fans and developers.

Independent scanlation groups needing efficient batch processing of images, PDFs, and archives with proofreading and typesetting.
Rust developers interested in ML applications, OCR, and image processing can learn from its architecture.

zh.tag: 自托管聚合仪表盘，把订阅源集中一处
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量级、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，用于集中展示 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、天气、YouTube 等订阅源。它通过美观简洁的界面，让用户在一个页面中快速浏览所有信息流。

开发者和技术爱好者：监控 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit 等技术社区动态。
追求效率的用户：通过自定义布局和主题，打造专属的极简仪表盘。

en.tag: Self-hosted dashboard aggregating all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates feeds like RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, weather, YouTube, and more. It presents all your information streams in a beautiful, streamlined interface for quick browsing.

uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: build a personal dashboard to aggregate RSS, news, weather, and more.
Developers and tech enthusiasts: monitor GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and other tech communities.
Productivity-focused users: create a minimal, personalized dashboard with custom layouts and themes.

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 默认 HTTPS 的极速可扩展 Web 服务器

Production web servers requiring automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 support
Reverse proxy and load balancer for microservices or containerized applications
Reference project for learning high-performance server development in Go

CI config maintainers or teams want to debug and optimize workflows without triggering remote resources.

en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.

en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架

学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
